title: Recruiter
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a Recruiter, you will be the strategic engine behind our engineering growth. This isn't just about managing a funnel; it’s about acting as a talent advisor to our Engineering leadership, helping them navigate a competitive landscape to find the builders of our future. You’ll own the full lifecycle—from deep\-dive calibration sessions with Hiring Managers to crafting high\-touch candidate experiences that reflect our culture of innovation. Whether you are hunting for niche Backend experts or scaling our Frontend teams, you’ll use your deep understanding of the tech stack and the talent market to close the best in the business. If you are passionate about the "art of the close" and thrive in a data\-informed, high\-growth environment, we want you on our team  

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the TA Manager, India.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
* Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of roles
* Source candidates from relevant networks, online and internal databases, employee referrals and passive candidates through networking and research
* Cultivate strong partnerships with hiring managers and key collaborators, providing strategic guidance on talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Collaborate with the wider HR team to enhance recruitment processes, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and a positive candidate experience
* Utilise market insights to tailor recruitment strategies, ensuring our approach remains competitive and aligned with the evolving needs of our organisation
* Track and report on key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, pass through rates \& offer acceptance rates

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**

* 4\+ years of full\-lifecycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years dedicated specifically to core technical roles (e.g., Backend, Frontend, Mobile, DevOps, or Data Engineering)
* Experience in partnering with Engineering leadership to define technical candidate personas, calibrate search parameters, and drive strategic alignment throughout the hiring lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g.,Smart recruiters Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, or Workday)
* Proven track record of sourcing passive technical talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and X\-ray search string
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

**Preferred**


* Experience recruiting for high\-growth product companies or top\-tier tech firms
* Ability to use recruiting metrics (e.g., pass\-through rates, time\-to\-fill, and source\-of\-hire) to influence hiring decisions and forecast pipeline needs
* Proven ability to enhance the recruitment lifecycle by optimizing interview loops, elevating the candidate experience, and implementing scalable process improvements to drive hiring efficiency
* Expertise in local and global tech talent markets, with a proven ability to translate market intelligence, salary benchmarks, and competitor mapping into actionable hiring strategies

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Basic Details:** ***Fill the required information about business, unit, location, position, reports to position and date of updation of JD***
===============================================================================================================================================

 **Business**

  

Financial Services

 **Unit**

  

Aditya Birla Capital Limited

 **Location**

  

Across branches in India

**1\) Job Purpose:** ***Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)*** **(Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance.

 **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*

 **New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition.

 **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management

 **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions

 **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards.

 **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric

**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section (Max 3975 Characters)**
======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**


Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

 **Business Context**


Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.

 **Job Context:**

  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls

  

Key Challenges:

* Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\-** **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)**

  

Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

 **Business Growth \& Acquisition**

* Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management**

* Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management**

* Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management**

* Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance**

* Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience**

* Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity**

* Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)**
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships: Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Relationship Type (Max 80 Characters)**
=========================================

**Frequency**
=============

**Nature (Max 1325 Characters)**
================================

 **Internal**

  

Regional / Cluster Heads

System issues, process enhancements, user support.

Local campaigns, lead generation, customer engagement programs.

 **External**

title: Project Coordinator – Fresher
description:
Project Coordinator – Fresher

**Company:** Source Integreta Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Project Coordinator – Fresher  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Travel:** Willingness to travel to project sites across India whenever required

About the Role

Source Integreta Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive, organized, and detail\-oriented **Project Coordinator – Fresher** with an **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)** background to support the planning, coordination, documentation, and execution of IT and Systems Integration projects.

The selected candidate will work closely with Project Managers, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ECE fresher who wants to build a career in **Project Coordination, Project Management, IT Infrastructure, Airport Systems, and Technology Operations**.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, basic technical knowledge, strong organizational abilities, and a willingness to learn and travel to project locations whenever required.

Key Responsibilities

* Support Project Managers in day\-to\-day project coordination and execution.
* Assist in project planning, scheduling, execution, and monitoring.
* Coordinate with engineering, software, networking, operations, and support teams.
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
* Assist in preparing project plans, trackers, MIS reports, status reports, and progress updates.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, checklists, trackers, and records.
* Prepare **Minutes of Meeting (MOM)** and follow up on action items.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding materials, deliveries, installations, testing, and project requirements.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, pending activities, and deadlines.
* Maintain regular communication with Project Managers, engineers, vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Assist in identifying project risks, issues, dependencies, and delays.
* Escalate project\-related issues to the Project Manager when required.
* Support site surveys, inspections, testing, commissioning, and implementation activities.
* Assist in monitoring material movement and availability of project resources.
* Maintain accurate project trackers and provide regular updates to the Project Manager.
* Support project documentation, handover, closure, and client sign\-off activities.
* Assist in coordinating client meetings and project review meetings.
* Travel to project locations for project coordination, implementation, inspections, testing, commissioning, and client meetings whenever required.

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)**.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* Basic understanding of electronics, IT systems, networking, or infrastructure.
* Basic understanding of project planning and execution.
* Good knowledge of **Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Strong willingness to learn new technologies and project management processes.
* Willingness to travel to project locations across India whenever required.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of **IT Infrastructure, Networking, Electronics, or Systems Integration**.
* Basic understanding of databases, APIs, and enterprise IT systems.
* Knowledge of **Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall** methodologies is an advantage.
* Familiarity with **Jira, Trello, Asana, MS Project, or similar project management tools** is an advantage.
* Academic/project experience in **IoT, Embedded Systems, Networking, Electronics, Automation, Robotics, or IT Systems** is preferred.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel formulas, data tracking, and reporting.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.

Technical Exposure

The selected candidate may get exposure to:

* Airport IT Systems
* Systems Integration
* IT Infrastructure
* Networking
* ELV Systems
* Enterprise IT Systems
* Software and Hardware Integration
* Testing and Commissioning
* Site Surveys and Inspections
* Vendor Coordination
* Client Coordination
* Project Documentation
* Project Planning and Tracking

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on large\-scale **Airport IT and Systems Integration Projects**.
* Practical exposure to enterprise technology and mission\-critical infrastructure.
* Training and mentorship from experienced project and technical teams.
* Career growth opportunities in **Project Coordination, Project Management, and Technology Operations**.
* Exposure to client coordination and vendor management.
* Exposure to project implementation, testing, commissioning, and site activities.
* Professional development and learning opportunities.
* Performance\-based career growth.
* Opportunity to work with cross\-functional technical teams.

Salary

**₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Salary will depend on the candidate's technical knowledge, communication skills, academic background, project exposure, and interview performance.

Benefits

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Performance\-based incentives
* Professional development opportunities
* Travel allowance for official site visits, as applicable

Work Location

**Chennai, Tamil Nadu – Hybrid**

The candidate should be willing to travel to project sites across India whenever required.

Application Questions

* Do you have a Bachelor's degree in **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)**?
* Are you a fresher or do you have up to 1 year of experience?
* Are you willing to travel to project sites across India whenever required?
* Are you comfortable working in a project coordination role involving technical and engineering teams?
* What is your expected monthly salary?
* What is your current location?
* Are you comfortable working from the Chennai office on a hybrid basis?
* What is your notice period / joining availability?
* Do you have knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint?
* Do you have any academic or personal projects related to Electronics, IoT, Networking, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or IT?

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an **ECE fresher with strong communication, coordination, documentation, and problem\-solving skills** who is interested in building a career in project management and technology operations.

The candidate should be willing to learn, take ownership of assigned tasks, coordinate effectively with different teams, and travel to project locations whenever required.

Pay: ₹15,953\.10 \- ₹25,334\.37 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

title: Operations Manager - International Voice and Chat Process
description:
**Job Title:** Operations Manager (B2C Customer Support \| Voice \& Chat)  

**Location:** Hyderabad  

**Shifts:** Rotational Shift including night shifts  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**About Us:**  

UnifyCX is a transformative AI platform that empowers and enables teams to deliver efficient, exceptional customer experiences. We engineer superhuman customer experiences through a powerful blend of strategy, omnichannel support, analytics, and AI\-driven tools like GoTalent.AI, Voice of Customer, and automatic QA. Our outcome\-based model prioritizes measurable results for more than 200 client programs serviced today. With a focus on automation, talent enablement, strategic partnerships, and strict data ethics, UnifyCX delivers scalable, personalized, and compliant solutions that create real business impact.  

UnifyCX is a certified minority\-owned business and an EOE employer who welcomes diversity.

**Job Summary**
The Operations Manager is responsible for end\-to\-end delivery of B2C Customer Support operations across voice and chat channels. This role ensures achievement of business KPIs, operational excellence, customer experience, people development, and compliance while managing Team Leads and support functions such as Quality and Training.
**Key Responsibilities**

About ArangoDB


Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.  

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key\-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.  

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens, Transient.AI, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at arango.ai, LinkedIn, and G2\.

  

Location: Hyderabad, India (new office), hybrid


Reports to: Initially reports to Site Manager, dotted line reports to Global Director of Human Resources

As the founding member of the new India office, you will be the right hand to the Site Manager during the critical launch phase of our India operations. This is a high\-impact, multifaceted role where you will manage the administrative backbone of the company—from coordinating office build\-outs and vendor relationships to executing the daily HR operations that support our growing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities:

#### **1\. Recruitment \& HR Coordination**

* Lead the day\-one orientation for new hires, ensuring all equipment, access badges, and "welcome kits" are ready.

* Assist the Site Manager in scheduling interviews, managing candidate pipelines to scale the engineering team.

* Manage relationships with local service providers (Internet, Utilities, Housekeeping, and Security).
* Arrange travel and accommodation for visiting guests, global leadership and local team events.
* IT equipment shipping and handling, and tracking

#### **3\. Compliance \& Legal Support**

* Assist the Site Manager in gathering documents required for MCA filings, GST registrations, and labor law compliance.
* Ensure the office remains compliant with local safety regulations and support the implementation of POSH Act awareness training.

  

Skills and Experience:

* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in HR Administration or Office Management, preferably within a fast\-paced tech startup or a multinational company.
* Fluent in English and Hind (both written and spoken)i; proficiency in the local regional language of the office site is a strong advantage.
* High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and familiarity with HRIS/Payroll software.
* A proven ability to juggle multiple operational tasks with high attention to detail and zero oversight.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the "Shops and Establishments Act" and basic Indian labor law compliance.
* Experience working in a global team environment.

**What Makes Arango Special?**
------------------------------


At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.


Working at Arango means:

* Contributing to cutting\-edge AI and data infrastructure
* Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
* Helping shape how enterprises build AI\-powered applications


If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

* Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, India and Australia

The Infrastructure and Operations organization embodies the hub of lifecycle engineering at TJX, delivering, maintaining, and optimizing our technology portfolio at cloud scale. We are a service\-oriented team focused on providing extraordinary experiences to thousands of TJX associates, business partners, and application delivery teams across the enterprise.


We are seeking an experienced Network Engineering Manager to lead India\-based network engineering capability within Global Network Services. This role will partner with global teams to deliver secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available network services across campus, data center, cloud connectivity, store, distribution center, and corporate network environments.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, enterprise network engineering depth, operational discipline, stakeholder management, and delivery execution. This role will build and develop a high\-performing India\-based engineering team, drive network modernization, and provide technical leadership across design, implementation, reliability, automation, observability, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.

Network Strategy \& Service Leadership

* Define and execute the enterprise network engineering roadmap aligned with business priorities, resilience goals, and global technology strategy.

* Drive modernization initiatives across network platforms, including automation, observability, segmentation, cloud connectivity, and service reliability.
* Support strategic planning for network services, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to global enterprise standards.

Engineering \& Technology Leadership

* Provide senior engineering oversight across a diverse technology ecosystem, including:
* LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, routing, and switching
* Wireless, campus, store, distribution center, and corporate network environments
* Data center networking, firewall connectivity, network segmentation, and secure access patterns
* DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN, load balancing, and network services integration

* Network observability, automation, telemetry, and operational tooling

Global Delivery \& Execution

* Ensure reliable, scalable, secure, and supportable network operations across regions, platforms, and business\-critical locations.
* Manage delivery risks, dependencies, timelines, communication, and stakeholder expectations across global and regional teams.

People \& Talent Leadership

* Lead and develop an India\-based team of network engineers and technical specialists.
* Oversee workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, hiring support, onboarding, and capability growth.
* Provide direct leadership, coaching, feedback, and technical direction across network engineering, operations, vendors, and matrixed global teams.
* Foster a high\-performance, inclusive, collaborative, and innovation\-driven culture.
* Encourage continuous learning, engineering excellence, ownership, and accountability within the team.

Financial \& Operational Management

* Support forecasting, budgeting, cost optimization, service planning, and financial discipline for assigned network services.

* Ensure effective use of internal resources, external partners, tools, licenses, and services across the network portfolio.

* Support HR partnership, performance management, engagement, onboarding, and capability growth for the India\-based network team.
* Act as a regional point of leadership for collaboration with India IT office stakeholders, global technology leaders, and enabling functions.

We seek creative, customer\-focused individuals with strong enterprise network engineering experience, people leadership capability, and a mindset for continuous improvement. This role requires the ability to lead globally distributed teams, drive technical outcomes, influence stakeholders, and improve service reliability across a complex enterprise technology environment.

Experience

description:
Who We Are
  
At Fossil Group, we are part of an international team that dares to dream, disrupt, and deliver innovative watches, jewelry, and leather goods to the world. If you are a forward\-thinker who thrives in a diverse, global setting, we want to hear from you.
  
  

MAKE AN IMPACT
  
We are seeking a talented and people driven Director – HR, FGSI to join our Human Resources team at Fossil Group in Bangalore, GBS. If you are passionate about strategic people leadership and enjoy shaping high\-performing organizations through talent, culture, and organizational transformation, this could be the perfect role for you. In this dynamic and global company, you will serve as a strategic partner to the FGSI leadership team, enabling business performance through an engaged, capable, and future\-ready workforce.

title: Partner Readiness Manager
description:
**Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning**

Pigment is the AI\-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature\-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600\+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top\-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.  

We are looking for a highly technical, business\-savvy **Partner Readiness Manager (PRM)** specializing in the EPM market. In this role, you will act as the technical backbone of our Partner Alliance organization, working hand\-in\-hand with Partner Account Managers (PAMs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs). Your mission is to enable, coach, and elevate our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), ensuring they have the architectural expertise required to design and deliver world\-class Pigment solutions for enterprise customers.
### **What You Will Do:**

### **Partner Strategy \& Enablement**


* Drive the technical execution strategy for assigned GSIs and RSIs, aligning Pigment product capabilities with partner industry practices.
* Lead the maturity of partner Centers of Excellence (CoEs) through technical health checks, architectural standards, and early access to the product roadmap.
* Design and deliver advanced enablement programs for partner Solutions Architects and Lead Model Builders, including bootcamps, architectural reviews, and hackathons.
* Design and scale a structured technical onboarding program for new implementation partners, ensuring proficiency in Pigment's platform and delivery standards.
* Publish reusable technical assets, integration guides, and model\-building best practices to accelerate time\-to\-value.
* Champion the adoption of Pigment's native AI capabilities and AI\-assisted modeling tools in partner implementations to ensure delivery quality and reduce time\-to\-value for customers.

### **Strategic Deal Support**


* Support partner\-led sales cycles on strategic accounts by leading discovery sessions, framing business value, and driving technical wins against legacy EPM competitors.
* Oversee high\-impact scoping workshops and POCs led by partners, ensuring models are structured for multi\-year scalability and performance.
* Act as the technical liaison between GSI delivery teams and Pigment's internal Product and Professional Services teams to unblock complex implementation hurdles.

### **Technical Depth**


* Serve as the subject matter expert on Pigment's core architecture, including advanced multi\-dimensional modeling, dependency mapping, and formula optimization.
* Guide partners on data pipelines connecting Pigment with ERPs (Workday, NetSuite, SAP), CRMs (Salesforce), HRIS (Workday, BambooHR), and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Enable and support partners on best practices for migrating customers off legacy EPM systems (Anaplan, Hyperion, Cognos, Adaptive) to Pigment's modern architecture.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to synthesize partner field feedback into actionable product recommendations
* Mentor internal Solutions Consultants and Technical Account Managers on GSI engagement models, delivery governance, and partner relationship management.
### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. An MBA or Master's in Finance/Data Science is a plus.
* 5\+ years in a highly technical consulting or solution architecture role within the EPM/Business Planning space (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Planful, OneStream, or Hyperion).
* Strong experience working directly with or within GSIs (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Slalom) to build technical capabilities and support complex delivery ecosystems.
* Proficiency in data modeling concepts, SQL, and API\-driven enterprise application integrations.

title: Indirect Tax Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**  

The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst at NIQ enhances the Indirect Tax team within the Global Finance Operations. This position involves performing the day\-to\-day activities across global indirect tax compliance, indirect tax provisions, and coordinating with external advisors and tax authorities to ensure compliance with applicable indirect tax laws and regulations. The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst is instrumental in maintaining the highest standards of efficiency and effectiveness for indirect tax activities and adhering to clear service level agreements (SLAs) with internal stakeholders. Reporting to the Indirect Tax Manager, this role is pivotal in upholding our company's compliance and operational excellence in the realm of indirect taxation.


Key Responsibilities:

* Indirect Tax Reporting: Execute day\-to\-day operations related to global indirect tax reporting, ensuring accurate and timely filings.
* Compliance: Ensure all global indirect tax activities comply with local, regional, and international tax regulations, mitigating risks associated with non\-compliance.
* Third\-Party Coordination: Collaborate with third\-party outsourced providers to ensure the efficient delivery of global indirect tax filings, maintaining quality and accuracy standards.
* SLA Management: Develop and maintain clear SLAs with internal stakeholders to ensure indirect tax activities align with organizational expectations and standards.
* Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements within the indirect tax function to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Regulatory Monitoring: Stay abreast of changes in indirect tax laws and regulations, ensuring NIQ's tax practices remain compliant and up to date.
* Collaboration: Work closely with the Indirect Tax Manager and other finance team members to support broader tax strategy and compliance efforts.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field. A professional certification in taxation or accounting (e.g., CA, CPA, CMA) is mandatory.

* Tax Knowledge: Knowledge of indirect tax regulations and reporting requirements across various jurisdictions.
* Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical skills with a keen attention to detail, capable of analyzing complex tax data and identifying compliance issues.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to effectively collaborate with team members, third\-party providers, and internal stakeholders.

description:

**Entity:** 
 Bobst India Pvt.Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Position Title:** 
 Manager – HR \[ HRBP]
 



**Reports To:** 
 Director – HR
 



  





**Position Summary** 



* Lead and manage an effective recruitment and selection process for senior, middle‑management, RD\&E and IT function roles.
* Analyse, forecast, and address organizational talent requirements in close coordination with management.
* Provide guidance and support across key HR domains including Performance Management, Rewards, and People Development.
* Conduct compensation analysis, evaluate job roles, and determine appropriate classifications and salary structures.



  





**Main Responsibilities** 



* Partner with line managers and advise on HR practices, programs, and policies.
* Assess HR metrics and trends to support informed decision‑making.

* Oversee workforce planning and succession management, including regular reporting.

* And everything else

* Experience in HR analytics and Compensation \& Benefits frameworks.
* Strong analytical, structured, and methodical approach.
* Excellent organizational and project management capabilities.

* Collaborative team player with a focus on achieving results through facts and data.
* High ethical standards and a strong sense of responsibility.

* Master in HR specialization.

* Excellent command of spoken and written English.

title: Human Capital – Assistant Manager (Employee Relations)
description:
**Job Type:** 
 Full Time Part Time
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Rajkot
   

  

**Preferred Experience:** 
 2\-3 Years
   

  

 Innovative Engineering Products Pvt. Ltd. (IEPPL) is a leading industrial services and supplier in India. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified organization by TUV Rheinland (India) Pvt. Ltd for our Quality Management Systems. IEPPL is associated with various well known and globally reputed principals to service the productivity, safety and automation needs of various industries.
   

  

 For our Human Capital Division we are looking for a Human Capital Assistant Manager who will be responsible for assisting the human capital team in recruiting top talent and and providing our employees with an exceptional work experience. From the moment of hire until the time they leave the organization, we want employees to be engaged in their jobs. Our ideal candidate will be skilled in managing compensation, benefits, recognition, training, performance management and employee relations in a manner that retains staff members long\-term and builds our employer brand. We are proud of the diversity in our workforce, and our Human Capital Manager is tasked with ensuring that our company culture welcomes a diverse population and supports each person in achieving career goals within the organization. The selected candidate will build long term employee relationships and manage resolution to specific employee needs and issues.
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full Time / Part Time / Freelance
   

  

**Job Code:** 
 IEPPL/HCI/01
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Remote / Work from Home / Rajkot / Ahmedabad / Vadodara
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Human Capital Assistant (Employee Relations)
   

  

**Preferred Experience:** 
 2\-3 Years in Human Resource role preferably in B2B markets.
   

  

**Preferred Education** 
**:** 
 MBA (HR) / Industrial Relations
   

  

**Job Accountabilities**
* Ensuring the Company’s treatment of employees is consistent with its core business values and objectives.
* Partnering with both senior business stakeholders and HR teams to develop and implement Employee Relations best practices and programs.
* Handling employee complaints, managing grievance procedures and facilitating counseling in conjunction with other stakeholders.
* Investigating and resolving complex or critical employee relations issues in a timely and effective manner.
* Collating and analyzing employee feedback across all levels on a regular basis and revising people programs and policies to generate more positive outcomes.
* Participating in and/or leading projects focused on continuous improvement.
* Manages talent acquisition process, including sourcing, testing, interviewing, hiring and onboarding
* Keeps job descriptions up\-to\-date, accurate and compliant with the needs of the organization.
* Develops training and performance management program that ensures all employees are familiar with their job responsibilities, as well as relevant legal and safety requirements
* Creates and updates compensation strategy through market analysis and pay surveys.
* Conducts individual and group psychometric surveys and feedbacks.
* Handles investigation and resolution of employee issues, concerns and conflicts.


**Preferred Skills**
* Excellent communicator. You have excellent verbal and written communications.
* Quality Assurance – Acute attention to detail, follows QA processes and procedures and is consistent and accurate with their deliverables.
* Detail oriented with strong organizational, multi\-tasking, time management, and project management skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.
* Strong computer knowledge with advanced knowledge of Excel including V lookup / Pivot charts / Data Validation / Conditional formatting, typeif, macros etc.
* Excellent project management skills, organizational skills, and the ability to collaborate productively with cross functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of B2B marketing strategies and tactics and their application in a professional services organization.
* Strong interpersonal and client service skills, consultative approach to working with marketing and client service professionals at all levels.
* Highly detail oriented with superb organizational skills.
* Possess outstanding ability to learn quickly, execute swiftly and accurately.


**Work Environment**
 Work in a home environment and or a remote location.
   

  

 Ensure a quiet and calm place throughout the designated area of operational responsibility.

description:

Positions in this function are responsible for development and interpretation of employment policies and practices, as well as consultation with the Employee Center and People Team on high\-risk, high\-level, or organization\-impacting workplace issues to ensure internal equity and legal compliance. Function is also responsible for risk mitigation and compliance activities, including responding to employment claims filed with external agencies, union avoidance and affirmative action requirements. In roles outside the United States, managers in this function may also be responsible for Employee relations. The ERES titles are intended to be used for these employees. Generally work is self\-directed and not prescribed.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* ERL\_Manage Employee Relations Cases
	+ Ensure appropriate and timely response to workplace issues (e.g., phone coverage, service requests)
	+ Ensure cases are opened and closed as required
	+ Manage case volume
	+ Ensure comprehensive documentation of ER cases (e.g., including all relevant information)
	+ Interpret, apply and ensure compliance with relevant company policies and applicable governmental laws/regulations for specific ER cases
	+ Identify appropriate actions for employees, managers and HCPs to take
	+ Escalate cases as appropriate (e.g., based on salary grade, issue complexity, legal/business risk)
* ERL\_Provide Consulting/Expertise on Employee Relations Issues
	+ Maintain knowledge of current best practices in the employee relations field (e.g., theories, frameworks, technologies, and trends)
	+ Provide leadership and direction to employees, managers and HCPs on handling workplace issues
	+ Establish personal trust and credibility with business partners and stakeholders (e.g., leaders, Human Capital Partners)
	+ Demonstrate a clear point of view about Human Capital activities as well as business needs
	+ Provide consulting to managers on Corrective Action issues (e.g., CAPs)
	+ Provide consulting on involuntary employee terminations issues, and process involuntary employee terminations
	+ Administer/support coordination for a variety of ER processes/initiatives/programs (e.g., I\-9, personnel file fulfillment, legal requests)
	+ Incorporate industry best practices into employee relations practices/programs (e.g., CLC, gOEbase, Bersin)
	+ Leverage and build upon current best practices to create industry\-leading employee relations practices/processes
	+ Manage/support Employee Relations programs/initiatives
	+ Provide support for RFPs
	+ Provide training on HRdirect/Employee Relations model and topics
* ERL\_Conduct/Support Investigation of Workplace Issues and Programs
	+ Investigate complex workplace issues (e.g., wage/hour, discrimination, harassment)
	+ Provide tools and coaching to managers and HCPs to help them conduct workplace investigations
	+ Manage/support Employee Relations programs/initiatives (e.g., random drug testing, background investigations)
	+ Manage the IDR process (e.g., meeting coordination/facilitation, review responses, obtain legal review)
	+ Identify the need to update/revise existing policies and create new policies based on company needs or legal/regulatory requirements
	+ Communicate and implement new/updated/revised policies
* ERL\_Conduct Reporting/Analysis of ER Activities
	+ Identify appropriate metrics and data collection approaches to support business needs (e.g., IDR volume, case volume, case types)
	+ Provide reporting to applicable stakeholders to meet business or legal needs
	+ Identify/communicate trends and information related to current business issues/needs (e.g., areas of concern, volume of employee complaints, management issues, financial impacts, training needs)
	+ Research complaints by location and/or manager as needed for investigations
	+ Analyze data/reports to help improve performance of the ER function
* ERL\_Manage/Support Auditing Activities
	+ Manage/support OFCCP audits
	+ Respond to OCFFP data requests
	+ Manage/support on\-site audit activities
	+ Provide policy support as needed for various auditing activities (e.g., CMS)
	+ Respond to Dept of Labor requests as needed (e.g., answer questions, provide data)
* ERL\_Manage the Downsizing Process
	+ Provide manager training on how to complete the business case, DA and notification training
	+ Coordinate/support communication strategies (e.g., employee notification, benefit impact calls)
	+ Work with managers to develop the business case
	+ Identify the impacted group
	+ Conduct competency and adverse impact analysis
	+ Prepare job title and age list
	+ Prepare severance agreements and outplacement packets
	+ Process payments and terminations
	+ Provide reports to finance on downsizing costs
	+ Works with less structured, more complex issues
	+ Serves as a resource to others
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of experience in Employee Relations, Human Resources or Employment Legal
* Experience in conducting investigations and advising on or supporting local disciplinary and investigation processes
* Experience in establishing cross\-functional relationships at all levels and geographies

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Job Description: Assistant Manager – Employee Relations**


**Role :** Assistant Manager – Employee Relations


**Function Description:**



Employee Relations function is a Centre of Excellence function within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). Employee Relations CoE works in close partnership with Strategic Talent Consultant function, GDS Ethics Office as well as GDS General Counsel’s Office and is primarily responsible for managing complex/sensitive ER incidents. The function continuously monitors the ER risk profile of the Firm and develop/deploy strategies to manage the same. ER CoE is also responsible to project manage Talent special projects and is the custodian of all Talent Policies.

  


**Job description:**


* Conduct workplace investigations into sensitive Employee Relations matters. This involves facilitating and documenting Investigation interviews, analysing evidence and drafting investigation findings reports.
* Partner with Senior ER professionals in providing guidance to Talent Consultants and Business Leaders in managing wide range of Employee Relation issues, including Code of conduct breaches, Performance lapses, Discrimination allegations, Workplace harassment allegations, Integrity issues etc., and ensure resolution of the same with minimal risk exposure to the Firm and its professionals.
* Maintain ER Incident data base, identify trends and thereby assist Talent leadership in developing appropriate strategies and initiatives to proactively mitigate ER risk exposures.
* Actively participate in special projects undertaken by EY GDS Employee Relations Centre of Excellence

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**


* **Education** : Master’s Degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration with HR specialisation or Bachelor in Legislative Law (LLB)
* **Experience** : 6 \- 10 years of experience of Human Resources, with at least 4 years experience in Employment Law, preferably in Big Fours or Leading IT services/Consulting Firms.
* Should have strong knowledge of Indian employment law and regulations, especially related to conduct of disciplinary procedures, work\-place investigations, employment litigation procedures etc.
* Should possess exceptional written skills, specifically legal writing, as well as oral communication skills.
* Should have the capability to apply discretion and make sound judgement, even in highly stressful and emotional scenarios.
* Should have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Should be able to navigate through complex, difficult, and ambiguous situations.

  


**What we offer**



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. * **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

**Nomura Overview:**

  

Nomura is an Asia\-headquartered financial services group with an integrated global network spanning over 30 countries. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Retail, Asset Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Merchant Banking. Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

  

Nomura Services India, (Powai) supports Nomura’s businesses around the world. Powai’ s world class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support have played a key role in facilitating Nomura’s global operations and are an integral part of Nomura’s global expansion plans. The Powai operation is a critical part of the platform to support the growth of Nomura’s global business.

  

**Division Overview:**

  

The Operations division provides the support and control infrastructure that enables the Firm to develop and deliver financial products throughout the world. Working with the Sales, Trading and Information Technology Divisions, Operations professionals are responsible for the management and execution of transactions in a manner which maximizes profitability and minimizes risk. Our division is responsible for the management and execution of millions of securities transactions on a daily basis. Our responsibilities include trade processing, confirmation, settlement, fails management, margin, asset servicing, risk management, reference data management and various other client services. In partnership with sales, trading, prime services, information technology and other teams from across the bank, we apply a continual focus on improving productivity and efficiency, while seeking new and innovative ways to support our clients' changing needs.

  

**Business Unit Overview:**

  

The role of Shared Services is to support the activities of the Global Markets and IBD businesses. The division operates across a large number of global legal entities in order to perform a diverse range of client servicing, risk management and regulatory functions, as well as the more traditional clearing and settlement responsibilities. Specifically India Shared Services provides a level of support for all the regions and entities that the above services are provided in locally. It is further subdivided into the following highly specialized teams.

Analyst

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Syndicate Loan Operations Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the operational aspects of syndicate loans, ensuring accurate processing, compliance with regulatory requirements, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders. This role requires a strong understanding of loan syndication processes, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment and we have openings for AEJ, EMEA and US shifts.

* Loan Processing: Manage the lifecycle of syndicate loans from origination to settlement, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate or understanding with various internal departments (credit, legal, compliance) to facilitate the timely execution of loan agreements.
* Documentation Management: Review and verify loan agreements, term sheets, and other related documents for accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Maintain organized records of all syndicate loan documentation and ensure proper filing and retrieval.
* Communication and Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders, including lenders, borrowers, and agents.
* Facilitate communication between syndicate participants to ensure smooth operations and address any issues that may arise.
* Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and distribute regular reports on syndicate loan performance, including interest payments, principal repayments, and outstanding balances.
* Analyse loan data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvements.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process enhancements and contribute to the development of best practices in syndicate loan operations.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced setting.

description:
Accounts Assistant

**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Position:** Accounts Assistant  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Finance \& Accounts Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized **Accounts Assistant** to support the Finance \& Accounts team in day\-to\-day accounting operations. The role involves invoice processing, accounting data entry, record maintenance, reconciliations, payment processing, statutory compliance support, audit assistance and preparation of financial reports.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of accounting principles, strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate financial records while meeting deadlines.

Key Responsibilities1\. Financial Document Processing

* Receive, verify and process invoices, bills, expense claims and payment requests.
* Check supporting documents and ensure proper authorization before processing.
* Maintain systematic records of financial transactions and documents.

2\. Accounting \& Data Entry

* Enter financial transactions accurately into accounting software and spreadsheets.
* Maintain purchase, sales, expense, receipt and payment records.
* Ensure proper classification and accounting of transactions.
* Assist in maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date books of accounts.

3\. Record Keeping \& Documentation

* Maintain digital and physical financial records.
* Organize invoices, vouchers, receipts, bills and other supporting documents.
* Ensure proper filing and retrieval of accounting documents whenever required.

4\. Reconciliation

* Assist in **bank reconciliation, ledger reconciliation and vendor/customer account reconciliation**.
* Identify discrepancies and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution.
* Support periodic review of outstanding balances and accounting records.

5\. Payment \& Billing Support

* Prepare payment vouchers, bills, receipts and other payment\-related documents.
* Assist in processing vendor and employee payments.
* Maintain and monitor petty cash transactions.
* Ensure appropriate supporting documents are available for all payments.

6\. Vendor \& Customer Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors and customers regarding invoices, payments, outstanding balances and account\-related queries.
* Follow up for missing invoices, supporting documents and payment confirmations.
* Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

7\. Audit Support

* Assist in preparing documents and working papers required for internal and statutory audits.
* Provide supporting documents and information for audit queries.
* Coordinate with auditors and the Finance team for required records and clarifications.

8\. Statutory Compliance

Assist the Finance \& Accounts team in ensuring timely and accurate statutory compliance, including:

* **GST returns and related compliance**

title: GTM Intern — Sales & Business Development
description:
**Hiring for: Proverse Talent — a proof\-led talent network for engineering, AI, product and go\-to\-market hiring.**  
**Role:** GTM Intern – Sales \& Business Development  
**Positions:** 1  
**Experience:** 0–1 Years / Freshers  
**Location:** Remote  
**Type:** Internship – 3–6 Months, with potential for Full\-Time conversion  
**Focus:** Lead Generation, Sales Pipeline, Business Development \& GTM Automation  
**Tools:** Claude, Notion, NotebookLM, MCPs

**About us**  
Proverse Talent is a recruiting company that runs on software we build ourselves. We place engineers and specialists for fast\-growing companies, and we're building the platform that makes that placement faster and more evidence\-based than a traditional agency can manage.

**Job Description**

That gives us three ways to make money, and this role touches all three.  
What you'd actually be doing  
**1 · Vendor empanelment — the one that unlocks everything**  
Getting Proverse onto a company's approved recruitment\-vendor list is the gate before any agency revenue exists. You'd research target companies, find who owns vendor decisions in TA and procurement, prepare empanelment documentation, manage submissions, and chase them to a decision. **This is a real, learnable, valuable skill, and most people your age have never been taught it.**  
**2 · Agency business development**  
Build and work a pipeline of companies hiring for roles we can fill. Research, outreach, qualification, and getting the right conversation into the founder's calendar.  
**3 · Marketplace and platform demand**  
Bring companies onto our marketplace to post roles, and recruiters onto our platform. Different audiences, different messaging — you'd help work out which lines land.  
Across all three, you'd own

* Building and maintaining the pipeline so nothing is lost and every lead is traceable
* Research on target companies, hiring signals, and the people who make the decision
* Tracking follow\-ups and activity — being the reason nothing goes cold
* Building simple automations so the same manual work doesn't get done twice
* Writing down what works, so the second month is easier than the first

What we're honest about  
You won't be closing deals in month one — the founder closes. **Your job is to create and qualify the opportunities that make closing possible**, and to build the process that lets us do it repeatably. If you're good at that, you'll be closing before the internship ends.

**What Good Looks Like**  
**30 Days**

* Build a clean pipeline and identify the top 50 target companies.

**60 Days**

* Get empanelment submissions moving and establish a consistent outreach process.

**90 Days**

* Identify which channels work best using response and conversion data, and help build a repeatable GTM process.

**Required**

* Genuinely strong research skills — you can find the right person and a reason to contact them
* Clear written English; most of this job is written
* Organised by instinct. A pipeline you don't maintain is worse than no pipeline
* Comfortable with AI tools as everyday leverage, not as a novelty
* Willing to hear "no" repeatedly and keep going

**Preferred**

* Any exposure to B2B sales, recruitment, or staffing
* Hands\-on with Claude, Notion, NotebookLM, or MCP\-based automation
* Understanding of how Indian enterprises procure vendors

**Not required:** a sales background, or a technical one. We'll teach the process.  
Why this is worth your time  
You'd be the first commercial hire, building the sales function rather than inheriting one — with direct access to the founder and real ownership of what gets tried. If it works, this becomes a full\-time role owning GTM.

Work Location: Remote

description:

**Job Title :** IT Support Engineer

**Experience :** Freshers / 0–2 Years

**Job Location:** Ernakulam

PURPOSE

The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing day\-to\-day technical support to employees, maintaining IT infrastructure, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting network and system operations, and ensuring smooth functioning of IT services across the organization.

The position is suitable for a **fresher or candidate with up to 2 years of relevant experience** who has a strong interest in IT support, troubleshooting, networking, and end\-user support.

KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

IT Helpdesk \& User Support

* Provide first\-level technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, printer, and other IT\-related issues.
* Receive, record, troubleshoot, and resolve user IT support requests.
* Assist users with computer, laptop, printer, scanner, projector, and other IT equipment.
* Support employees in installation and configuration of required software and applications.
* Provide remote and on\-site technical assistance as required.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the IT Manager / IT \& ERP Coordinator or external service providers.

Hardware \& Software Support

* Assist in operating system installation, configuration, updates, and troubleshooting.

* Maintain records of IT hardware, software, accessories, and assigned assets.
* Assist in identifying hardware requirements and replacement needs.
* Coordinate with vendors for warranty, repairs, and technical support when required.

C. Network \& Connectivity Support

* Troubleshoot basic IP address, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity\-related problems.
* Assist in maintaining network devices such as switches, routers, access points, and related equipment.
* Monitor and report recurring network issues.
* Coordinate with internet/network service providers for connectivity\-related problems.
* Email \& User Account Support
* Assist users with official email account configuration and troubleshooting.
* Support password resets and basic user account\-related issues as authorized.
* Assist with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace or other organizational applications, as applicable.
* Ensure user access is provided according to approved requirements and company procedures.

ERP \& Business Application Support

* Provide basic technical support to users for the organization's ERP and other business applications.
* Assist users with login, access, system configuration, and basic application\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the IT \& ERP Coordinator / ERP vendor for unresolved issues.
* Record and follow up on ERP\-related support tickets and issues.
* Assist in user training and basic guidance on IT applications whenever required.

IT Asset Management

* Maintain an updated IT asset register covering computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, accessories, and other IT assets.
* Record issue, allocation, transfer, repair, replacement, and return of IT assets.
* Ensure IT equipment is properly tagged and assigned to employees.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets.
* Report damaged, missing, or malfunctioning equipment to the concerned authority.

* Follow company IT security policies and procedures.
* Assist in maintaining antivirus/endpoint security and system updates.
* Ensure systems are protected with appropriate passwords and security controls.
* Report suspected malware, phishing, unauthorized access, or other security incidents immediately.
* Ensure company data and user information are handled confidentially.
* Assist in implementing backup and data protection procedures as directed by the IT team.

Support for Project Sites

* Provide IT support to project/site offices when required.
* Assist with installation and maintenance of computers, printers, internet connectivity, Wi\-Fi, CCTV/network\-related equipment, and other IT infrastructure at project locations.
* Coordinate with site personnel and external vendors for resolving technical issues.
* Travel to project sites as required for IT support and maintenance.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain records of IT complaints, service requests, and resolutions.
* Maintain documentation related to IT assets, software, licenses, network equipment, and user access.
* Prepare periodic IT support reports as required.
* Maintain a record of recurring technical issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Ensure proper documentation of IT procedures and troubleshooting activities.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.

* Provident Fund

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (NOC)
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**

We’re looking for people who:


* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description:**

**Join Pitney Bowes as a Graduate Engineer Trainee**

**Location:** **Pune (Hybrid)**

**Role: Contractual(Third\-party)**

**Years of experience: 0\-2 years**

**About the Role**

We are seeking enthusiastic and self\-driven engineers with strong fundamentals, curiosity and automation mindset in Network Operations, Automation, DevOps, and Infrastructure Monitoring.


This role is focused on building a modern, automation\-first Network Operations Center (NOC) rather than a traditional helpdesk environment.


The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, networking fundamentals, and an interest in scripting, observability, and automation technologies.


**1\. Responsibilities**

**DevOps (Modern NOC \- Automation \& Continuous Improvement)**

* Assist in automation of monitoring and operational workflows through basic scripting.
* Support infrastructure and network change monitoring as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana)
* Contribute to infrastructure improvements using automation/orchestration principles.
* Develop basic scripts (Python / PowerShell) to reduce manual effort.
* Work with APIs and structured data formats (JSON)
* Support automation initiatives and process optimisation efforts.
* Build foundational understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD practices.

**Network Operations \- Incident Management \& Coordination**

* Monitor network, systems, and infrastructure (LAN/WAN, Wireless, VPN, firewalls, cloud) in a 24x7 environment using standard NOC tools.
* Detect, triage, and respond to alerts, incidents, and outages with defined SLAs.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting across network and system components (routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, circuits)
* Log, track, and manage incidents via ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow etc.)
* Follow established SOPs for troubleshooting and escalation to L2/L3 teams.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Network, Security, Application, Cloud) and external vendors/ISPs for issue resolution.
* Perform routine operational tasks such as configuration backups, patching, upgrades, and health checks.
* Support network changes, validation, and implementation activities.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate incident records, RCA documentation, and network artefacts.
* Generate periodic reports on uptime, alerts, and performance trends.
* Update SOPs, runbooks, and internal knowledge base consistently.

**2\. Key Skills \& Background**

**DevOps / Automation (Must\-Have)**

* Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
* Awareness of automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, GitHub) and CI/CD concepts.
* Understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Basic working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
* Awareness of REST API, Webhook, CSV, Jason etc.

**Networking Fundamentals (Must\-Have)**

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing \& Switching
* Basic understanding of firewall and network security concepts
* Familiarity with WAN, VPN, and Internet connectivity
* Exposure to enterprise network devices (routers, switches, firewalls)
* Experience or exposure to monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ManageEngine, etc.)

**Troubleshooting \& Analytical Skills**

* Ability to perform initial fault isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability and willingness to learn.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift\-based NOC environment.
* Good documentation discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to perform under pressure during incidents and outages.

**3\. Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science / IT / Electronics or equivalent
* 0–2 years of experience (freshers with relevant certifications can be considered)

**Preferred Certifications (Not mandatory)**

* CCNA / Network\+
* DevNet Associate
* ITIL Foundation
* Entry\-level Cloud or DevOps certifications (optional)

**The Team**

**Pitney Bowes** (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500\. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com .


**We will:**

  

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(** **PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs** )

Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.
  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.
