title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At Prodigal, we are building AI Agents for loan servicing and collections. Founded in 2018 by IITB alumni, our journey began when our founders Shantanu and Sangram faced the antiquated the $13B\+ lending/collections industry was mostly using pen and paper and decided to build the first real intelligence layer for debt recovery.
   

  

 Today, we stand at the forefront of a seismic shift in the industry, building Agentic AI applications for loan servicing and collections. Powered by our cutting\-edge platform, Prodigal’s Intelligence Engine (PIE), we’re creating the next\-generation agentic workforce \- one that empowers companies to achieve unprecedented levels of operational excellence and intelligence.
   

  

 With over 100\+ enterprise customers across North America and backing from Y Combinator, Accel and Menlo Ventures, we are the fastest growing AI company in consumer finance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PIE team and work on the systems that power our autonomous AI agents in live financial conversations. You'll work alongside a small, high\-agency team where you will have real ownership over features and components from day one.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll be deep in the code \- building ML models, designing the ML system, finetuning and integrating LLMs, tuning prompts, and debugging gnarly real\-time issues. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you need to be the kind of engineer who figures things out fast, takes feedback well, and ships.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work across a range of ML problems \- Voice, Data, Recommendations, Infrastructure, LLMs, Product.
* Train LLMs for AI agents used for consumer finance.
* Develop evals, harnesses, and monitoring systems.
* Own major technical areas with significant autonomy, from problem definition to production deployment


**What You Bring**
* 2 – 5 years of hands\-on engineering experience, with good exposure to building or working with ML or AI systems in production.
* Solid Python fundamentals \- you are comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and debugging production issues.
* Some experience working with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integrations, or building simple pipelines or agents.
* High bias for action \- you don't wait to be told exactly what to do, and you push yourself to ship rather than over\-engineer.
* Eager to learn in a fast\-moving environment, take ownership of your work, and ask good questions.


**Why This Role**
* Real ownership from day one: ML team is a small pod. You won't be a cog \- you'll own components, ship features, and see your work in live consumer conversations within weeks.
* Frontier work: AI that reasons, decides, and acts is one of the hardest problems in applied AI. You'll be learning by doing on problems most engineers never touch.
* Strong mentorship: you'll work directly with senior engineers and the ML Lead who will invest in your growth \- this is a place to level up fast.
* High leverage early career: the decisions you make and the code you write will impact millions of financial conversations. Rare for an early\-career role.


 From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast\-paced, intellectually\-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.
   

  

 To learn more about us \- please visit the following:
   

  

 Our Story \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/our\-story
   

  

 What shapes our thinking \- https://link.prodigaltech.com/our\-thesis
   

  

 Our website \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Position Title** 
 : Data Analyst
 



**Experience Required** 
 :
 


* Overall Experience 4\-7 years
* Minimum 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience in BI/dashboarding tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, or equivalent)
* Experience working with ERP/CRM data (SAP SD/MM or equivalent) strongly preferred



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Data Analyst will be responsible for translating the Group’s data \- spanning customer/stakeholder data (Teachers, Schools, Retailers, Distributors, Vendors, Partners) and factory operations data (production, dispatch, inventory, material movement) \- into actionable business insights. The role owns dashboard and report development across CRM and ERP systems, surfacing coverage metrics, campaign engagement, operational efficiency, data health scores, and compliance status for SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management.
 



 The position works closely with the Data Management Lead, Governance Lead, Marketing Automation Lead, and SBU stakeholders to ensure data is structured, accurate, and presented in a way that drives decision\-making across the organisation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Dashboard \& Reporting** 



* Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports (Power BI / Looker Studio / equivalent BI tools) covering coverage metrics, campaign engagement, operational performance, data health, and compliance status across customer and factory datasets.
* Translate raw CRM, ERP, and factory operations data into business\-ready KPI views for SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management.
* Build and maintain a Master Dashboard consolidating departmental views into a single navigation hub for organisation\-wide visibility.
* Apply DAX, Power Query, and data modelling best practices (star schema, row\-level security) to ensure dashboards are scalable, secure, and performant.



**Data Analysis \& Insights** 



* Conduct customer/stakeholder segmentation analysis across Teachers, Schools, Retailers, Distributors, Vendors, and Partners to identify trends, inactivity, and engagement patterns; present findings and recommendations to leadership.
* Analyse factory operations data \- production output, dispatch, material movement, and inventory \- to identify inefficiencies, optimisation opportunities, and cost\-saving areas (e.g. slow\-moving stock, process bottlenecks, vendor price variations).
* Sanitise and centralise data from disparate CRM, ERP, and factory systems into a single, governed source of truth \- ensuring consistent definitions, eliminating duplicate/conflicting records, and enabling unified reporting across the organisation.
* Perform data cleansing, deduplication, and validation across CRM, ERP, and factory systems to maintain data quality and integrity.
* Conduct exploratory and variance analysis to flag anomalies, policy violations, or process gaps for resolution by the relevant function (Data Management Lead, Governance Lead, SBU teams, or plant operations).
* Support ad\-hoc analytical requests from SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management with quick\-turnaround data pulls and visualisations.



**Data Integration \& ETL** 



* Build and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, cleanse, and load data from CRM, ERP, marketing automation, and factory operations systems into reporting tools.
* Maintain unique key mapping and data integration logic across systems to eliminate data silos and ensure a single source of truth for stakeholder data.
* Coordinate with the Data Management Lead on data quality rules, validity standards, and master data structure to ensure reporting reflects the governed data model.



**Stakeholder Support \& Coordination** 



* Gather reporting requirements from SBU heads, departmental teams, and leadership; translate business questions into dashboard and KPI specifications.
* Support the Marketing Automation Lead with campaign performance reporting and ROI analysis across WhatsApp, email, and SMS channels.
* Document dashboard logic, data definitions, and reporting SOPs to ensure consistency and ease of handover.
* Train SBU users on self\-service dashboard usage where applicable.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; preference for Engineering, Statistics, Commerce, or Computer Applications
* MBA or equivalent specialisation in Business Analytics / Data Science is an advantage
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* Power BI / Power BI Developer
* SQL / MySQL
* Python for Data Analysis



**Required Skills** 




 Strong proficiency in:
 


* Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modelling, RLS, Incremental Refresh)
* SQL / MySQL
* Google Looker Studio and/or other BI/analytics platforms
* Working knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation
* Experience integrating and reporting on ERP/CRM and factory/production data (SAP SD/MM or equivalent)
* Strong understanding of KPI design, MIS reporting, and data storytelling for senior leadership audiences
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across SBUs and translate business requirements into reporting solutions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to data accuracy and detail
* Process orientation: ability to document SOPs and maintain reporting consistency at scale



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Dashboard Coverage \& Adoption: Core KPI dashboards live and actively used by SBU heads and plant leadership; usage/adoption tracked monthly.
* Reporting Turnaround: Standard reports delivered on defined refresh cycles; ad\-hoc analytical requests turned around within agreed SLA.
* Data Quality \& Accuracy: Data health score maintained above target threshold across CRM, ERP, and factory datasets; duplicate/erroneous records identified and flagged for correction.
* Operational Insights Delivered: Number and impact of actionable insights surfaced (e.g. inventory optimisation, cost savings, process inefficiencies identified) and adopted by business/plant teams.
* Customer/Stakeholder Insights Delivered: Segmentation and engagement analyses delivered on schedule, with measurable follow\-through on recommendations (e.g. re\-engagement campaigns, coverage improvement).
* Automation Impact: Manual reporting effort reduced through automation of recurring reports/alerts, tracked as hours saved.

title: Junior Malware Analyst — Adware & Extension Research (QA)
description:
About BrandLock

BrandLock is a revenue\-protection platform for e\-commerce merchants. We stop unwanted browser extensions and injected scripts — ads, coupon overlays, competitor price comparisons — from hijacking our clients’ online stores and leaking their revenue.

The Role

You will identify and classify the adware, malware and unwanted extensions that inject content into our clients’ websites, and help work out how to block them. This is a research and reasoning role: investigating unfamiliar domains, inspecting pages in DevTools, testing extension behaviour in the browser, and then working with QA to make sure what you found is genuinely blocked in production.

Ideal for freshers who are curious, analytical and want to build a career across security research, web technology and product quality.

What You’ll Do

* Analyse and categorise adware, malware and unwanted extensions by behaviour, type and risk level
* Classify resources collected from client sites at the domain and subdomain level — legitimate, unwanted, malicious or unknown
* Research unfamiliar domains in depth: who runs them, how they make money, and whether they belong on a client’s site
* Propose ways to block injected content — HTML/CSS selectors, DOM mutation detection, domain\-level blocking, or new approaches you research yourself
* Investigate extensions that stop being blocked or start evading detection, and find the root cause
* Perform QA testing on our blocking product and work with the QA team to validate every rule before release
* **Produce manual reports and visual evidence for clients and the Sales team** — visiting client and prospect websites, reproducing injections, capturing and annotating screenshots, and compiling the findings into shareable reports and trackers
* Write scripts and SQL queries to automate parts of the classification workflow, and document findings clearly

What You’ll Need

* 0–2 years of experience — **freshers are encouraged to apply**. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Strong analytical and logical reasoning — you can reach a defensible conclusion from partial evidence and explain how you got there
* A genuine research instinct and real attention to detail
* Fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Basic Python or equivalent scripting, and familiarity with SQL / databases
* Understanding of QA and testing fundamentals
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* Clear written and verbal communication — your findings go to Engineering, QA and Sales

Nice to Have

* Exposure to browser extensions, DOM APIs such as MutationObserver, or browser automation (Selenium / Playwright)
* Basic understanding of malware and adware categorisation
* Awareness of digital advertising, affiliate marketing or the coupon ecosystem
* Any internship or project work in web research, QA, data annotation or security

Please Note

This is **not** an antivirus or reverse\-engineering role. You will not be analysing binaries, writing YARA rules or publishing threat intelligence. You will be classifying browser extensions, scripts and domains, and researching new ways to block them.

title: AI-Augmented Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**If it's down, it's on you. If it stays up, that's on you too.**
 This isn't a ticket\-queue DevOps gig where you spin up infra and wait for the next request. At Techdome, you own production — for real Healthcare, FinTech, AI, and SaaS products, with real users depending on uptime that isn't negotiable.
   

  

 You'll build the pipelines, own the incidents, ship the zero\-downtime releases, and be the person the team trusts when something breaks at 2am. If automation, Kubernetes, observability, and AI\-powered ops genuinely excite you — not just as buzzwords on a resume — keep reading.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* Keep production up, fast, and stable — availability, reliability, scalability, and performance across every environment you touch.
* Run the cloud like it's yours — manage and optimize environments across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Build deployment pipelines that don't break things — CI/CD engineered for zero\-downtime, with Blue\-Green, Rolling, and Canary strategies as your default toolkit, not a slide in a deck.
* Codify the infrastructure — Terraform and Ansible, so nothing important lives only in someone's head.
* See problems before they become incidents — observability with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and centralized logging.
* Own the numbers that matter — define and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, not just watch dashboards.
* Lead when things go wrong — incident management, RCA, and post\-incident reviews that actually prevent the repeat.
* Watch the bill, not just the uptime — cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.
* Automate the boring and the risky — scripting and AI\-powered tooling for alert triage, incident summarization, and operational workflows.
* Carry the pager — join the on\-call rotation, because ownership doesn't stop at 6pm.


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years as an SRE, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or Cloud Engineer.
* Real hands\-on cloud experience — AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Docker and Kubernetes fluency — not "I've used it once," but production experience under real load.
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code expertise — Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent.
* CI/CD pipelines built from scratch — Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Solid Linux, networking, and distributed\-systems fundamentals — the stuff that doesn't show up in a tutorial.
* Scripting chops — Python, Go, or Bash.
* Experience running large\-scale production environments where "it's fine" isn't good enough.
* Working knowledge of Blue\-Green, Canary, and Rolling deployments — in practice, not just in theory.
* Time in FinTech, Payments, Healthcare, or another high\-availability environment where downtime has real consequences.
* A working AI toolkit — Copilot, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar — used to actually move faster, not just talk about it.


**Extra credit**
* You've built AI\-powered operational workflows — monitoring, alert triage, incident summarization, automation — not just used AI to write scripts faster.
* You speak fluent SRE: SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, chaos engineering, and reliability engineering are habits you practice, not terms you've heard.


**Why Techdome?**
* No narrow lane — work across real\-world AI, Healthcare, Payments, and SaaS products, not one domain for years on end.
* Ownership from day one — critical production infrastructure is yours, not something you inherit after two years of proving yourself.
* Scale that matters — systems supporting thousands of users and business\-critical workflows, not internal tools nobody depends on.
* Direct access to the top — work with founders and senior engineering leadership, no six layers of management between your idea and a decision.
* An AI\-first culture that's actually real — modern tooling and real automation, not a mandate to "use AI more" with no support behind it.
* Speed and real ownership — fast decisions, real stakes, and growth that isn't stuck waiting for a title change.

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Infra Tech Support Practitioner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Site Reliability Engineering
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, whether remotely or onsite. The practitioner follows established operational procedures to maintain service reliability and quality, ensuring smooth functioning of various technology platforms. Collaboration with different teams and adherence to defined processes are key aspects of the daily routine, aimed at sustaining optimal infrastructure performance and user satisfaction.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Infrastructure as Code \& Automation


 Automate Everything: Eliminate manual interventions by designing and implementing end\-to\-end infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Ansible.
   

  

 CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build, optimize, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless, automated software delivery and infrastructure deployments.
   

  

 Configuration Management: Define and manage system configurations via code to maintain consistency across Development, Staging, and Production environments.
   

  

* Reliability, Scalability \& Performance


 Architecture Design: Partner with development teams to architect scalable, fault\-tolerant, and high\-performance cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Proactively monitor system resource utilization and plan capacity upgrades to handle traffic spikes and growth.
   

  

 Chaos Engineering: Introduce controlled failures into systems to test resilience and proactively identify architectural weaknesses.
   

  

* Monitoring, Observability \& Incident Response


 Observability Stack: Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Newrelic ) to establish deep system visibility.
   

  

 On\-Call \& Incident Management: Participate in an on\-call rotation. Lead the triage and resolution of critical production incidents.
   

  

 Blameless Post\-Mortems: Conduct thorough root\-cause analysis (RCA) for infrastructure failures and formulate actionable plans to prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Site Reliability Engineering.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure components including servers, storage, and network devices.
* Experience in troubleshooting operating systems and application platforms in complex environments.
* Ability to work with monitoring tools and incident management systems to ensure prompt issue resolution.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual interventions.
* Understanding of service management frameworks and best practices to support IT operations.


**Category Required Skills \& Tools**
 Cloud Platforms:\- Advanced expertise in AWS (Cloud networking, IAM, security, compute, and storage services).
   

  

 Containers \& Orchestration:\- Deep operational knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or AKS), including Helm charts and service meshes.
   

  

 Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Strong proficiency in Terraform or CloudFormation.
   

  

 Programming \& Scripting:\- Proficiency in Python, or Bash for building internal tooling and automation scripts.
   

  

 CI/CD Tools Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
   

  

 Observability Experience configuring in New Relic.
   

  

 OS \& Networking Strong Linux administration skills and a solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, and HTTP/S.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer based in India.**
 This is a hands\-on cybersecurity role focused on strengthening product and enterprise security across a modern technology environment.
   

  

 You will combine penetration testing, threat modeling, secure architecture reviews, and security automation to identify and reduce risk.
   

  

 The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, and Operations teams throughout the SDLC.
   

  

 You will help embed security\-by\-design principles and DevSecOps practices into development and deployment workflows.
   

  

 Your work will span web applications, APIs, cloud environments, infrastructure, containers, and modern distributed architectures.
   

  

 The position offers significant opportunity to influence security strategy while remaining deeply involved in technical execution.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a security\-minded engineer who enjoys thinking like an attacker while enabling teams to build resilient products.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Conduct manual and automated penetration testing across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and supporting infrastructure, validating security controls and identifying vulnerabilities.
* Lead threat modeling exercises for new and existing products, identifying attack paths, risks, and appropriate mitigations using methodologies such as STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent frameworks.
* Perform secure design and architecture reviews and promote security\-by\-design principles throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.
* Evaluate application, cloud, and infrastructure security controls and translate findings into practical, actionable remediation recommendations.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to prioritize, track, and remediate security findings while promoting secure coding practices.
* Integrate security testing and validation into CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated security checks and continuous risk identification.
* Develop and maintain security tooling, scripts, and automation to improve the efficiency, scalability, and coverage of security assessments.
* Support vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment, validation, remediation guidance, and verification of fixes.
* Contribute to security standards, secure development guidelines, governance processes, and product security initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams on secure design, threat mitigation, and security best practices.
* Support security audits, compliance initiatives, and evidence collection related to product and application security controls.
* Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and apply relevant developments to improve security capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement across Product Security and DevSecOps practices through automation, innovation, and adoption of industry\-leading approaches.
* Be available to work a European shift from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, application security, product security, security engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience with manual and automated penetration testing of web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and infrastructure.
* Strong experience in threat modeling and security architecture reviews using STRIDE, PASTA, ATT\&CK, or equivalent methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of secure software development, common attack techniques, OWASP Top 10, and API Security Top 10\.
* Experience identifying, validating, prioritizing, and communicating security risks to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C\#, PowerShell, or Go.
* Experience working in Agile development environments and embedding security practices into the SDLC.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps and experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience assessing and securing cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of modern architectures including microservices, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless technologies.
* Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code security tools.
* Experience developing security automation, custom tooling, or pipeline integrations.
* Knowledge of secure architecture patterns, identity and access management, cryptography, and zero\-trust concepts.
* Experience supporting regulatory, compliance, or audit requirements, particularly in highly regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or financial services.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to independently lead security initiatives while working effectively across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Operations.
* A security\-first mindset with the ability to think like an attacker while partnering constructively with development teams.
* Curiosity, self\-motivation, and a commitment to continuous learning in emerging security technologies and attack techniques.
* Experience building or operating Product Security programs, leading enterprise\-wide threat modeling initiatives, conducting adversarial assessments, or creating secure coding standards and developer enablement programs is highly valued.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted security analysis, remediation workflows, or security engineering automation is an advantage.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, GWEB, CISSP, CCSP, or AWS/Azure/GCP security certifications are valued.

* Provident fund.
* Medical insurance.

title: Officer – Compliance & Audit
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------


Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading IT Infrastructure and Digital Transformation company with over 36 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Mumbai, Swan is a ₹1,749\+ Crore organization delivering innovative IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, and Managed Services to leading BFSI, PSU, Enterprise, and Corporate customers. We are technology partners with HP, Cisco, Microsoft, VMware, NetApp, and other global OEMs.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Chartered Accountant (CA)** to join our Finance team as an **Officer – Compliance \& Audit**. The role involves managing statutory compliance, supporting internal audits, overseeing accounts payable activities, maintaining financial records, and assisting with financial reporting and analysis.


The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a sound understanding of taxation, audit, compliance, and financial operations.


**Location:** Chandivali, Mumbai


**Department:** Finance \& Accounts


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Permanent


**Experience:** CA Fresher / 2–3 Years of relevant experience


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Compliance \& Taxation**


* Ensure timely compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Manage and support compliance related to:
	+ GST
	+ TDS
	+ Income Tax
	+ ROC Filings
	+ Other applicable statutory requirements
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for statutory compliance.
* Coordinate with external consultants and regulatory authorities as required.

### **Internal Audit \& Controls**


* Conduct and support internal audit activities across business and financial processes.
* Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, and areas of financial risk.
* Recommend and support implementation of process improvements.
* Monitor internal controls and ensure adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Assist in audit documentation, reporting, and closure of audit observations.

### **Accounts Payable \& Financial Operations**


* Manage the end\-to\-end Accounts Payable cycle.
* Review and process vendor invoices.
* Perform vendor reconciliation and resolve discrepancies.
* Support timely vendor payment processing.
* Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

### **Financial Reporting \& Analysis**


* Assist in the preparation of financial statements and management reports.
* Support budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Assist with financial analysis and provide relevant insights to management.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data.

### **Audit \& Stakeholder Coordination**


* Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, and other financial stakeholders.
* Provide required information and documentation during audits.
* Support regulatory and statutory audit requirements.
* Ensure timely closure of audit\-related queries and observations.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
* Strong knowledge of statutory compliance, taxation, and audit processes.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC compliance.
* Knowledge of internal audit and internal control processes.
* Experience or strong understanding of Accounts Payable and financial operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet defined deadlines.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Experience with ERP and accounting systems, particularly Tally.
* Exposure to multi\-entity accounting and financial operations.
* Experience in financial reporting and analysis.
* Exposure to process improvement and internal control frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification**
---------------------------


**Chartered Accountant (CA)** – Qualified.


CA Freshers and candidates with **2–3 years of relevant experience** are encouraged to apply.


**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Opportunity to work across compliance, audit, taxation, and financial operations.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end finance and accounting processes.
* Opportunity to work with experienced finance professionals and external stakeholders.
* Exposure to multi\-functional and multi\-entity financial operations.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.
* Career growth through continuous learning and challenging assignments.

**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------


If you are a qualified Chartered Accountant looking to build your career in compliance, audit, taxation, and financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.


**Apply today and become a part of Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd.**

title: BUSINESS SUPPORT EXECUTIVE
description:
We are looking for a **Business Support Executive** to provide administrative, operational, and coordination support to management and various departments. The role involves assisting teams with day\-to\-day business activities, tracking tasks and deliverables, coordinating meetings, preparing reports and presentations, and ensuring timely communication and follow\-up on important requirements.



#### **Requirements**


* + Provide day\-to\-day administrative and operational support to management and different departments.
	+ Assist teams in coordinating and completing assigned business activities, tasks, and initiatives.
	+ Track ongoing tasks, requirements, and deliverables and ensure timely follow\-up with respective teams.
	+ Support internal and external meetings by coordinating schedules, preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes, and tracking action items.
	+ Assist in communicating with clients, partners, vendors, and other stakeholders regarding business\-related requirements.
	+ Gather, organize, and maintain business information, reports, records, and documents for management review.
	+ Support basic research on business trends, competitors, customers, and industry developments as required.
	+ Prepare and maintain professional reports, presentations, spreadsheets, proposals, and other business documents.
	+ Assist management and teams in planning and executing business meetings, events, and organizational initiatives.
	+ Ensure timely follow\-up and coordination on important business requirements, approvals, and deliverables.
	+ Identify operational or coordination gaps and communicate them to the concerned stakeholders.
	+ Assist in resolving routine business and operational requirements by coordinating with the relevant teams.
	+ Maintain proper organization and confidentiality of business and organizational information.
	+ Provide general business and administrative support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.
	+ Perform other business support, coordination, and operational responsibilities as assigned by management.
#### **What we Expect from you?**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, BCA, B.Sc. IT, B.Tech, BE, MCA**, or a related IT discipline.
* **Freshers are also encouraged to apply.**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Basic understanding of IT, business, and organizational concepts.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook**.
* Strong organizational, coordination, follow\-up, and time\-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to prepare professional reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and business documents.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Proactive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with different teams.
* Willingness to travel when required for official business activities.
#### **What you've got?**

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content \| Financial Services

**Roha Associates LLP \| Pune \| Full\-Time \| In\-Office**

Build Your Marketing Career in the World of Wealth \& Finance

Are you an MBA in Marketing who doesn't want to spend your first few years doing repetitive corporate marketing work?

Do you enjoy **Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, content creation, video editing, research and storytelling**?

And would you like to learn how marketing actually works inside a growing **wealth management and portfolio management business**?

If yes, this opportunity could be for you.

**Roha Associates LLP** is a fast\-growing Portfolio Management \& Wealth Management firm based in Pune. We work with investors and high\-net\-worth individuals to help them build and grow their wealth through research\-driven and performance\-oriented investment strategies.

We are looking for an ambitious **Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content** who can help us build a powerful digital presence and take our content and social media growth to the next level.

This Is Not a Typical Marketing Job

This is a **hands\-on, ownership\-driven role**.

You won't just be preparing reports or coordinating with agencies.

You will actually be involved in:

**Research → Ideas → Scripts → Content → Video Editing → Publishing → Analytics → Growth**

You will have the opportunity to work across **Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube** and directly contribute to the growth of a financial\-services brand.

What You Will Do

**Social Media Management**

* Manage and grow Roha Associates LLP's Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube channels.
* Develop and maintain a consistent social media content calendar.
* Plan and execute campaigns to increase reach, engagement and followers.
* Monitor social media trends, algorithms and emerging content formats.
* Track content performance and identify what is working and what needs improvement.

**Content Creation**

* Research topics around stock markets, investing, personal finance, wealth creation and financial markets.
* Identify trending topics and convert them into relevant content opportunities.
* Develop content ideas for Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn posts and other formats.
* Write video scripts, hooks, captions and social media posts.
* Convert complex financial topics into simple, interesting and engaging content.
* Research competitors, financial creators and successful brands for content inspiration.

**Video \& Creative**

* Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other short\-form videos.
* Work with tools such as Canva, CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro or similar platforms.
* Select appropriate visuals, music, captions, graphics and transitions.
* Help improve the quality and consistency of the company's visual content.
* Coordinate the complete process from raw idea/video to final published content.

**Growth \& Marketing**

* Experiment with different content formats, hooks and distribution strategies.
* Analyze reach, engagement, watch time, followers and other relevant metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic social\-media growth.
* Support digital marketing, lead\-generation and brand\-building initiatives.
* Continuously test, learn and improve the company's content strategy.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hungry to learn, willing to take ownership and genuinely interested in marketing.**

You could be a great fit if you:

* Have completed or are completing an **MBA / PGDM in Marketing**.
* Are a fresher or have 0–2 years of relevant experience.
* Regularly consume content on Instagram, LinkedIn or YouTube and understand what makes content engaging.
* Enjoy writing, researching, creating and experimenting.
* Have an interest in business, investing, entrepreneurship or financial markets.
* Have basic knowledge of the **stock market, mutual funds or financial services**.
* Can communicate clearly in English.
* Are comfortable learning new tools and technologies.
* Have a creative mindset but are also comfortable working with numbers and analytics.
* Take initiative instead of waiting for instructions.
* Want responsibility and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

Advantage if You Have

Candidates with any of the following will have an additional advantage:

* Social media management experience
* Content creation experience
* Instagram/Reels/YouTube experience
* Video editing skills
* Canva / CapCut / Premiere Pro knowledge
* Copywriting or script\-writing experience
* Personal social\-media page or content portfolio
* Internship in digital marketing
* Basic understanding of stock markets and investing
* Experience creating finance, business or educational content

**Freshers with strong skills, a good portfolio and the right attitude are absolutely welcome.**

What You Will Learn

This role gives you an opportunity to develop skills across multiple areas:

**Digital Marketing \+ Social Media \+ Content Strategy \+ Video Marketing \+ Personal Branding \+ Financial Services \+ Stock Market \+ Lead Generation \+ Analytics**

You will not be restricted to one small part of marketing.

If you perform well, your responsibility and scope will grow with the company.

Compensation

**Expected CTC: ₹4\.0 – ₹7\.0 LPA**

The final package will depend on your **skills, MBA profile, relevant experience, content portfolio and interview performance**.

For exceptional candidates with strong content, social\-media or digital\-marketing skills, compensation can be discussed based on capability.

**Performance\-based increments and growth opportunities** will be available based on contribution and results.

Job Details

**Position:** Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content  
**Industry:** Wealth Management / Financial Services  
**Company:** Roha Associates LLP  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| In\-Office  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Qualification:** MBA / PGDM – Marketing preferred  
**Freshers:** Yes, encouraged to apply

Women Candidates Encouraged to Apply

We are committed to building a diverse and high\-performing team.

**Women candidates are especially encouraged to apply.**

Why Join Roha Associates LLP?

If you are looking for a job where you simply execute instructions, this may not be the right role.

If you want to **learn, experiment, create, take ownership and see the direct impact of your work**, this could be a great opportunity.

You will get exposure to:

* A growing financial\-services business
* Real\-world digital marketing
* Content strategy and social\-media growth
* Financial markets and investing
* High\-value client marketing
* Brand building
* Lead generation
* Video content
* Performance analytics

**Your work will be seen. Your ideas will be heard. And your growth will depend on the value you create.**

How to Apply

Please apply with your **updated CV/resume**.

Candidates who have created content, managed social\-media pages, edited videos or completed relevant marketing projects are encouraged to **share their portfolio, LinkedIn profile, Instagram page, YouTube channel or examples of their work along with their application.**

**Freshers:** If you don't have professional experience, don't worry. Show us what you can do.

A college project, internship project, personal Instagram page, YouTube channel, content portfolio or sample Reel can be enough to demonstrate your ability.

Screening Questions

**1\. Have you completed an MBA/PGDM in Marketing?**

* Currently pursuing

**6\. Share one social\-media account/creator/brand whose content you think is excellent. Why do you think it works?**

**9\. Why are you interested in working in marketing for a financial\-services/wealth\-management company?**

**10\. What would you do in your first 30 days if you were given responsibility for growing our Instagram and LinkedIn presence?**

What We Will Look For

We will primarily evaluate:

title: Support Technician L1
description:
**About our Client:** 




 Our client has been developing point of sale (POS) software and payment solutions since 2006 and is an Australian market leader in delivery of end\-to\-end software, hardware, payment and integration solutions for the Hospitality industry. Their services include all hospitality venue types including high\-end restaurants, wineries, bars, pubs, hotels and bottle shops. Our client remains a fast and nimble business that moves quickly to provide innovative solutions, including their own payments platform designed to enhance the customer experience at every touchpoint. They now provide a one\-stop\-shop POS and Payments solution allowing us to eradicate outdated monthly fees.
   





**About Teamified** 




 Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day
   





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a customer\-focused 
 **Level 1 Support Technician** 
  to provide high\-quality remote, telephone, email, and chat support to clients using business\-critical Point of Sale (POS) systems.
 



 As a Level 1 Support Technician, you will be one of the first points of contact for customers experiencing technical issues. You will be responsible for understanding the problem, troubleshooting according to established processes, resolving issues within your technical capability, and ensuring more complex cases are appropriately documented and escalated.
 



 This role combines technical troubleshooting with excellent customer service. You will work closely with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Account Management, Customer Success, installation and training teams, and after\-hours support teams to ensure customers receive timely and effective assistance.
 



 A key measure of success will be your ability to resolve customer issues efficiently, increase first\-contact resolution, reduce repeat calls, and maintain clear communication with customers throughout the support process.
 



 The role operates 
 **5 days per week on a rotating roster, including weekends** 
 , with normal working hours of 
 **11:00 AM\-7:00 PM AEST** 
 . There may also be a requirement to provide 
 **after\-hours coverage** 
 , including 12\-hour shifts with appropriate breaks, when required to support team leave coverage.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Act as the first point of contact for customers across phone, SMS, email, chat, and other support channels.
* Respond to incoming POS software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues and troubleshoot them according to established support guidelines and internal processes.
* Diagnose and resolve Level 1 technical issues within your capability and escalate more complex incidents to the appropriate technical team.
* Ensure all customer calls, incidents, and support requests are accurately logged, prioritised, updated, and escalated when necessary.
* Work within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensure customers receive timely updates throughout the resolution process.
* Deliver a high standard of customer service and maintain clear, professional, and empathetic communication in every interaction.
* Aim to maximise first\-contact resolution and reduce repeat customer calls and tickets.
* Provide customers with basic system and product training over the phone or through remote support channels when required.
* Create sales orders for additional software or hardware requirements identified through customer interactions.
* Escalate customer complaints and significant service concerns to the Level 1 Team Leader or appropriate manager.
* Collaborate effectively with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Customer Success, Account Management, installation and training teams, and after\-hours support teams.
* Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting activities, customer communications, resolutions, and escalations.
* Participate in training, coaching, knowledge\-sharing, and professional development opportunities.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge across POS software, hardware, networking, and related technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve support processes, customer experience, and team efficiency.
* Follow company security, workplace health and safety, operational, and customer service policies and procedures.
* Demonstrate the company's values through teamwork, accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, open communication, and pride in the quality of your work.



**Qualifications:** 



* Previous experience in a 
 **Level 1 Help Desk, Service Desk, Technical Support, Application Support, POS Support** 
 , or similar customer\-facing technical support role.
* Demonstrated Level 1 technical troubleshooting knowledge and the ability to diagnose common software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues.
* Experience supporting 
 **Point of Sale (POS) systems** 
  or hospitality/retail technology is highly desirable.
* Intermediate computer skills with a good understanding of software and hardware; basic networking knowledge would be an advantage.
* Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical customers.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tickets, systems, and customer interactions while meeting competing deadlines and service\-level requirements.
* Ability to accurately document technical issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations.
* Strong initiative, self\-motivation, and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision.
* Proven ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and internal teams.
* Comfortable working within structured processes while using sound judgement to identify when an issue requires escalation.
* Willingness and ability to work 
 **11:00 AM\-7:00 PM AEST on a rotating 5\-day roster, including weekends** 
 .
* Flexibility to provide 
 **after\-hours coverage when required** 
 , including extended shifts to cover team member leave.
* Commitment to continuous learning and developing technical knowledge as products, systems, and support processes evolve.
* Diploma or Degree in 
 **Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems** 
 , or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential.



**Benefits:** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident  Fund
* Gratuity



 If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

title: Software Development Engineer - Mobile & Commerce (Apprentice)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer \- Mobile \& Commerce (Apprentice) based in India.**
 This is a 12\-month remote apprenticeship designed for an emerging software engineer who wants hands\-on experience building production\-grade systems.
   

  

 You will work alongside experienced engineers on real engineering charters that contribute directly to a large\-scale commerce and business platform.
   

  

 Depending on your team, you may work across domain services, accounting and ledger systems, payment infrastructure, document rendering, or developer tooling.
   

  

 The role offers meaningful ownership from early in the programme, including designing, implementing, testing, instrumenting, and shipping production code.
   

  

 You will develop practical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, reliability, and software design practices.
   

  

 Mentorship, technical reviews, design discussions, and structured progression will support your development throughout the apprenticeship.
   

  

 The programme also provides an opportunity to demonstrate your capabilities for potential full\-time conversion after successful completion.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Join an engineering team with a defined charter and contribute to production\-facing software development initiatives.
* Design and implement domain services using technologies such as Go, protobuf, and ConnectRPC, taking services from architectural decisions through production deployment.
* Contribute to ledger and accounting systems, including commerce\-event processing, double\-entry accounting, chart\-of\-accounts translation, and journal APIs.
* Work on payment infrastructure, including provider integrations, capability registries, idempotency, retries, and replay mechanisms designed to prevent duplicate transactions.
* Contribute to document\-rendering systems and cross\-runtime conformance testing across Go, JavaScript, and Dart implementations.
* Work on developer tooling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) initiatives, including protobuf\-based code generation, manifest generation, and governance mechanisms for safe AI\-agent API access.
* Write architectural decision records (ADRs), design documentation, technical proposals, and clear engineering notes.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design reviews while incorporating feedback and communicating engineering trade\-offs.
* Develop, test, instrument, and ship production\-quality software with increasing levels of ownership.
* Build practical knowledge of distributed systems concepts, including consistency, retries, idempotency, fault handling, and network reliability.
* Work with containers and Kubernetes and troubleshoot deployment and runtime issues.
* Take ownership of the operational context of the systems you contribute to, including supporting production services when required.

description:
**Job Title:** Junior Product Design Engineer (3D CAD / Plastics) – Fresher Friendly

**Pay:** ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

**Location:** Thane, India (On\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role:**

SYINRO is developing next\-generation service robots for the hospitality and industrial sectors. We are designing futuristic, consumer\-friendly robotic enclosures using high\-grade ABS plastics.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior Mechanical/Product Designer who wants to break into the robotics industry. If you have strong 3D CAD skills and want to learn how to design complex plastic enclosures for mass production, we will train you. You will work directly on designing the outer shells of our robots, taking them from software concepts to physical 3D\-printed prototypes, and eventually to injection molding.

**What You Will Do (with training and guidance):**

* **3D CAD Modeling:** Create visually appealing, modern 3D models of robot enclosures using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Creo.
* **Prototyping:** 3D print scale models of your designs to test how they look and feel, and verify how internal components fit.
* **Hardware Packaging:** Learn how to design internal space and mounting points for electronics, screens, Lidar, and ultrasonic sensors so they fit perfectly inside the plastic shell.
* **Learn Plastic Engineering (DFM):** We will train you on the fundamentals of Design for Manufacturing—teaching you how to add draft angles, maintain uniform wall thickness, and design snap\-fits for ABS injection molding.
* **Renderings:** Create realistic product renders (using KeyShot, Blender, or CAD built\-in tools) for design approvals.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or Product Design. (Freshers are welcome!).
* **Software Skills:** Strong foundation in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Creo. (Knowledge of surface modeling is a huge plus).
* **Passion for Design:** A strong interest in consumer electronics, automotive design, or robotics.
* **Portfolio Required:** You must submit a portfolio containing 3D CAD models you have designed (college projects, personal projects, or practice models are perfectly fine).

**What We Offer:**

* Hands\-on training in real\-world plastic product design and injection molding preparation.
* The rare opportunity to design complete hardware products from scratch in the robotics sector.

* Flexible schedule

title: Draftsman - SolidWorks
company: kinemach engineering and machines pvt ltd
description:
About Kinemach

Kinemach is a Pune\-based manufacturing technology company specializing in assembly automation, material handling and robotics, processing equipment, packaging machinery, and inspection/testing systems. We serve customers across automotive, pharmaceutical, food processing, and electronics industries.

Kinemach's portfolio includes two specialized product lines: Procer Mixing, our range of high\-shear mixers and homogenizers built for GMP\-compliant food, pharma, cosmetic, and chemical applications; and DynaScrew, our precision automatic screw\-feeding and screw\-driving systems used in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical device manufacturing.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Draftsman with strong hands\-on SolidWorks skills to support design and engineering across all three Kinemach product lines \- automation and material handling equipment, Procer mixing systems, and DynaScrew screw\-driving stations. This role converts design engineers' concepts into accurate, manufacturable 3D models, 2D drawings, and BOMs, and works closely with the shop floor to keep documentation current through the build and dispatch process.

Key Responsibilities

\- Create and modify 3D models and assemblies in SolidWorks for machines, sub\-assemblies, and fabricated/machined components across all product lines.

\- Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing drawings \- general arrangement (GA), fabrication, and machining drawings \- complete with dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T callouts.

\- Generate and maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) for assemblies and sub\-assemblies.

\- Work closely with design engineers to translate concepts, sketches, and design intent into detailed, production\-ready drawings.

\- Revise drawings promptly in response to design changes, engineering change notes (ECNs), and shop\-floor feedback.

\- Prepare drawings for sheet metal parts, weldments/fabrications, and precision\-machined components in line with drafting standards.

\- Create exploded views, assembly sequences, and reference layouts to support assembly and service documentation.

\- Maintain drawing revision control, numbering conventions, and documentation per Kinemach's drafting standards.

\- Coordinate with production, machining, and assembly teams to clarify drawings and resolve fit/interference issues.

\- Support new product development and design iterations for Procer and DynaScrew equipment, including GMP/hygienic design considerations and precision fastening system layouts where relevant.

Requirements

\- Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

\- 0\-5 years of hands\-on experience in SolidWorks \- 3D modeling, assembly design, and 2D drafting (freshers with strong SolidWorks fundamentals are welcome to apply).

\- Solid working knowledge of GD\&T and standard engineering drafting practices (ISO/ASME).

\- Experience drafting sheet metal parts, weldments/fabrications, and machined components.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GA drawings, and BOMs independently.

\- Strong attention to detail and accuracy under production timelines.

\- Good communication skills to coordinate effectively with design, production, and quality teams.

Preferred

\- Prior experience in capital equipment or custom machine\-building environments, rather than mass\-production drafting.

\- Exposure to GMP/hygienic equipment design for pharma, food, or cosmetic applications (relevant to Procer).

\- Familiarity with fastening/screw\-driving system layouts or electromechanical assembly drawings (relevant to DynaScrew).

\- Working knowledge of SolidWorks PDM or similar drawing/revision management tools.

What We Offer

\- The opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of automation, mixing, and precision fastening equipment.

\- A collaborative engineering environment with direct exposure to the full design\-to\-dispatch cycle.

\- Competitive compensation aligned with experience and skill.

\- Growth opportunities within a fast\-growing manufacturing technology company.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management and network offices, vendors, customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As an integral part of the Air Freight Operations Export Team, this role encompasses optimizing and enhancing the export of goods by air in alignment with organization’s goal. The key responsibilities include ensuring efficient and compliant export processes, collaborating with airline partners and network offices, and prioritizing customer satisfaction. The role also involves actively contributing to the organization's profitability goals through effective operational execution and adherence to regulatory standards.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Develop and enhance operational processes to ensure consistent volume growth.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity.
* Take charge of warehouse operations, ensuring seamless coordination between the warehouse and gateway.
* Manage end\-to\-end shipment processes from pick\-up to delivery, ensuring accurate file execution, timely invoicing, and dispatch as per SOP.
* Follow CW1 Best Practices, including milestone updating and effective utilization of CW1 tools.
* Accurately book costs and revenue, maintaining operational hygiene for a healthy P \& L.
* Be Proactive and Ensure Timestamp for Completeness \& Timeliness
* Handle carrier engagement to design solutions, improve profitability, and skillfully address claims, disputes, and customer complaints.
* Manage Complaints, Claims, Compliments \- be responsive and available.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the air freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Oversee overall billing quality and timeliness.
* Oversee end to end process for a specific set of customers from booking to delivery.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, and network partners.

  

**Customer and Network Support**


* Register complaints related to all export shipments.
* Execute and support day\-to\-day export operations deliverables.
* Reconcile and resolve network issues.
* Communicate frequently with sales and support functions.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.
  

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* Bachelor’s degree
* 2\-3 years of experience in the logistics, transport, airline or BPO industry for Executive/ Sr. Executive.
* 3\-4 years’ experience in the logistics, transport, airline or BPO industry for AM/DM.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.
* Efficiently manage tasks to meet deadlines and priorities.

**Preferred**


* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.

  

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

**BAKERY CHEF / BAKER**

**Company:** Grey Soul Coffee Roasters  
**Department:** Bakery / Kitchen  
**Designation:** Bakery Chef / Baker  
**Location:** \[Pune )  
**Reporting To:** Head Chef / Kitchen Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**1\. JOB SUMMARY**

The Bakery Chef / Baker will be responsible for the preparation, production, presentation, and quality of all bakery products served at Grey Soul Coffee. The role requires strong knowledge of baking techniques, consistency in product quality, proper food handling, cleanliness, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced café environment.

The Bakery Chef is expected to follow Grey Soul Coffee's recipes, SOPs, food safety standards, production schedules, and instructions from the Head Chef / Management.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Bakery Production**

* Prepare and bake breads, pastries, cakes, cookies, muffins, croissants, and other bakery products as per the approved menu.
* Follow standard recipes, measurements, preparation methods, and presentation standards.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, appearance, size, and portioning.
* Prepare doughs, batters, fillings, creams, frostings, and other bakery components.
* Monitor proofing, fermentation, baking temperatures, and baking times.
* Ensure products are prepared according to daily production requirements.
* Maintain proper production schedules to ensure timely availability of products.

**B. Quality Control**

* Check the quality and freshness of all ingredients before use.
* Ensure all finished products meet Grey Soul Coffee's quality and presentation standards.
* Identify and report any quality issues immediately to the Head Chef / Kitchen Manager.
* Minimize wastage, overproduction, and product rejection.
* Maintain consistency across every batch.

**C. Inventory \& Ingredients**

* Check and monitor daily bakery ingredient requirements.
* Inform the Head Chef / Kitchen Manager about low\-stock or required ingredients.
* Ensure proper storage and labeling of raw materials and finished products.
* Follow FIFO (First In, First Out) principles.
* Avoid unnecessary wastage of ingredients.
* Maintain proper portion control.

**D. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and food safety.
* Keep bakery workstations, equipment, utensils, refrigerators, and storage areas clean and sanitized.
* Follow all company hygiene, sanitation, and food safety SOPs.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of dairy, eggs, flour, chocolate, cream, and other perishable ingredients.
* Follow temperature\-control and food\-storage requirements.
* Immediately report any hygiene, safety, or equipment\-related concern.

**E. Kitchen Operations**

* Coordinate with the Head Chef, Commis Chefs, Kitchen Team, and Service Team.
* Ensure bakery production is completed within the required timelines.
* Support the kitchen team during busy operational periods when required.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the kitchen.
* Follow opening, closing, cleaning, and production checklists.
* Follow all instructions issued by the Head Chef and Management.

**F. Product Development**

* Assist in developing new bakery products and seasonal offerings.
* Suggest improvements to existing recipes and products.
* Conduct trials under the direction of the Head Chef / Management.
* Maintain proper recipe records for approved products.
* Support menu development while maintaining cost and quality standards.

**3\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Review the daily bakery production plan.
* Check availability and quality of ingredients.
* Complete required mise en place.
* Prepare and bake products according to production requirements.
* Maintain product consistency and presentation.
* Label and store finished products correctly.
* Record wastage where required.
* Clean and organize the bakery workstation.
* Complete the assigned closing / cleaning checklist.
* Report shortages, equipment issues, wastage, or quality concerns to the reporting manager.

**4\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Good knowledge of baking techniques and bakery production.
* Knowledge of dough preparation, proofing, baking, and finishing.
* Understanding of measurements and recipe accuracy.
* Good understanding of food hygiene and safety.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak hours.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to maintain consistency in production.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a kitchen team.
* Willingness to learn and follow company SOPs.
* Good communication and workplace discipline.

**5\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE**

**Education:**

* Diploma / Certificate in Bakery, Pastry, Culinary Arts, or a related field is preferred.

**Experience:**

* 1–3 years of relevant bakery / pastry experience preferred.
* Experience in a café, bakery, restaurant, or specialty food establishment will be an advantage.
* Freshers with relevant bakery training may also be considered based on skills.

**6\. WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Full\-time role in a professional café / kitchen environment.
* 6 working days per week.
* Shift\-based working as per business requirements.
* Employee must report to work on time and be ready to begin duties at the scheduled shift time.
* The role requires prolonged standing and physical movement during working hours.
* The employee may be required to work during weekends, public holidays, or peak business periods as per the roster.

**7\. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and consistency of bakery products.
* Timely completion of production.
* Hygiene and food safety compliance.
* Recipe and portion control.
* Reduction of wastage.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Teamwork and communication.
* Compliance with company SOPs and management instructions.
* Ability to maintain kitchen discipline and cleanliness.
* Customer and management feedback on product quality.

**8\. REPORTING \& ACCOUNTABILITY**

The Bakery Chef / Baker will report directly to the **Head Chef / Kitchen Manager** and will be accountable for the quality, quantity, hygiene, timely production, and proper handling of bakery products assigned to them.

The employee is expected to follow all **Grey Soul Coffee policies, SOPs, food safety standards, operational procedures, and reasonable instructions issued by Management.**

**9\. CONFIDENTIALITY \& COMPANY STANDARDS**

The employee shall maintain confidentiality regarding company recipes, production methods, costing, supplier information, internal processes, and other confidential business information.

The employee is expected to maintain the professional standards and values of Grey Soul Coffee at all times.

**Core Values:**  
**Discipline**  Integrity **Excellence**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Introduction**
 Plotline helps consumer apps create personalized in\-app and off\-app experiences without repeated engineering effort.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own key product modules end\-to\-end. This is a
 **1\-to\-n product role** 
 focused on improving, scaling, and driving adoption of existing and new capabilities.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers, designers, engineers, Customer Success, and founders to decide what to build, ship it, and ensure customers receive measurable value from it.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Own the roadmap for assigned in\-app and off\-app modules
* Speak regularly with customers and participate in QBRs
* Identify recurring customer problems and convert them into scalable product improvements
* Benchmark Plotline against competitors and close important product gaps
* Define requirements and problem statements for design and engineering
* Drive features from prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Measure whether shipped features improve customer value
* Help establish Plotline as an innovative, AI\-first, class\-leading product


****What Success Looks Like****
**First 3 Months**
* Develop a strong understanding of Plotline’s customers, products, and competitive landscape
* Build relationships with 5 to 6 customers and independently run product conversations
* Establish adoption and value metrics for assigned modules
* Identify and prioritize the most important product gaps
* Own at least one meaningful product improvement from problem definition to launch


**First Year**
* Get each assigned module adopted by at least five paying customers
* Improve adoption and meaningful usage after launch
* Deliver improvements that solve recurring problems across multiple customers
* Keep Plotline competitive with leading customer\-engagement platforms
* Build a clear, evidence\-based roadmap with explicit trade\-offs
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer value, retention, or expansion


**Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership**
* Own assigned modules from roadmap through adoption and continuous improvement
* Prioritize customer problems using customer evidence, usage data, commercial impact, competitive context, and engineering effort
* Make clear decisions about what to build, what to delay, and what not to build
* Define the smallest valuable version and reduce unnecessary scope


**Customer Insight**
* Speak regularly with customers and independently lead product discussions
* Participate in QBRs and understand how customers use Plotline
* Synthesize customer interviews, support issues, usage data, and commercial feedback
* Separate recurring product problems from one\-off feature requests
* Validate whether shipped solutions have resolved the original problem


**Competitive Benchmarking**
* Regularly evaluate competing products and emerging market trends
* Identify capabilities where Plotline must match or lead the market
* Translate competitive findings into practical product decisions
* Help ensure Plotline is perceived as innovative and AI\-first


**Product Delivery**
* Give designers clear problems, user context, constraints, and desired outcomes
* Partner closely with engineering on feasibility, trade\-offs, edge cases, and delivery
* Maintain clear scope, requirements, success metrics, and non\-goals
* Resolve ambiguity and unblock decisions during development
* Coordinate launches with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Support


**Adoption and Outcomes**
* Define success metrics before development begins
* Create rollout, enablement, and adoption plans for every major launch
* Track customer adoption, repeat usage, customer value, and retention signals
* Investigate why valuable features are not being adopted
* Improve, reposition, or stop investing based on evidence


****What we are looking for****
* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a comparable technology product
* Proven ownership of products or modules from prioritization through adoption
* Evidence of shipping and scaling features across multiple paying customers
* Strong examples of measurable adoption, usage, retention, or business impact
* Experience making prioritization decisions under limited engineering capacity
* Ability to independently run customer conversations
* Strong product judgment and customer empathy
* Experience working closely with product designers and engineers
* Comfort understanding APIs, SDKs, integrations, data flows, and analytics
* Strong written and verbal communication


****Strong Signals****
* You can explain what you personally decided, shipped, and improved
* You have taken a feature from low adoption to meaningful customer usage
* You have rejected attractive requests to protect a more important outcome
* You can identify patterns across conflicting customer feedback
* You benchmark competitors without blindly copying them
* You define success through customer outcomes, not launches
* You continue owning a product after it ships


****What This Role Is Not****
* It is not primarily a GTM, sales, or pipeline\-generation role
* It is not a project\-management or ticket\-writing role
* It is not limited to launching new features
* It is not a pure 0\-to\-1 discovery role
* It is not about building custom solutions for every customer


****Why Join Plotline?****
* Own strategically important products used by consumer businesses globally
* Work directly with customers, founders, designers, and engineers
* Shape the roadmap across in\-app engagement, off\-app communication, analytics, gamification, and AI
* See your work move from customer problem to shipped product and measurable adoption
* Operate with meaningful autonomy and clear outcome ownership


 If you enjoy understanding customers, making difficult product decisions, shipping with strong teams, and ensuring products create real value after launch, we would love to hear from you.
