title: Fibre splicer
description:
**Position Title: Fiber Optic Splicer**

**Department:** Technical / Field Operations

**Reports To:** Field Supervisor / Project Manager

**Location:** As Assigned

1\. Job Summary

The Fiber Optic Splicer is responsible for installation, splicing, testing, maintenance, and repair of fiber optic cables to ensure uninterrupted broadband, IPTV, and leased line services. The role requires technical expertise, accuracy, safety compliance, and timely execution of assigned projects.

2\. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Fiber Splicing \& Termination

· Perform fusion and mechanical splicing of fiber optic cables.

· Prepare, strip, clean, and cleave fiber cables before splicing.

· Terminate fiber cables in ODF, patch panels, and distribution boxes.

· Ensure splice loss remains within acceptable standards.

B. Installation \& Deployment

· Install underground, aerial, and indoor fiber optic cables.

· Assist in cable laying, routing, and ducting activities.

· Install joint enclosures, splitter boxes, and fiber distribution units.

C. Testing \& Troubleshooting

· Conduct testing using OTDR, power meter, and light source.

· Identify and rectify fiber faults, breaks, and signal losses.

· Perform preventive maintenance and emergency restoration work.

· Maintain proper documentation of test results.

D. Maintenance \& Repair

· Respond promptly to service complaints and fiber cut issues.

· Repair damaged fiber cables and restore connectivity.

· Coordinate with technical teams during network outages.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

· Maintain daily work reports and job completion reports.

· Record splice loss readings and maintain fiber route details.

· Update inventory usage of fiber cables and materials.

F. Safety \& Compliance

· Follow company safety policies and use proper PPE.

· Ensure work is completed as per industry standards and company guidelines.

· Maintain tools and equipment in proper working condition.

3\. Required Skills \& Competencies

· Knowledge of fiber optic splicing and testing equipment.

· Ability to read fiber network diagrams and route maps.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

· Basic knowledge of broadband and IPTV network infrastructure.

· Good communication and teamwork skills.

· Willingness to work in field conditions and extended hours if required.

4\. Educational Qualification

· ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, or relevant field.

· Certification in Fiber Optic Technology (Preferred).

5\. Experience

· 1–3 years of experience in fiber optic splicing (Preferred).

· Freshers with technical training may also apply.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

· Quality of splicing (minimum loss levels).

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quick fault resolution and restoration.

· Compliance with safety and reporting standards.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices


**Desirable Skills**
* Ability to Drive Agile Mindset \& Team Culture
* Understanding of Liquidity / Corporate Banking Domain
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Analyst Expectations**
 To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
   

  

 Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
   

  

 They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
   

  

 Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
   

  

**Partner With Other Functions And Business Areas.**
 Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
   

  

 Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
   

  

 Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
   

  

 Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
   

  

 Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
   

  

 Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
   

  

 Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
   

  

 Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
   

  

 Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Scrum Master based in India.**
 This is an opportunity to support technology teams in building stronger Agile practices and delivering work with greater consistency and predictability.
   

  

 You will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, maintain delivery discipline, remove impediments, and ensure teams remain focused on meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 The role is particularly suited to a Scrum Master who enjoys helping teams develop their Agile maturity and reducing process friction.
   

  

 You will use Jira to maintain healthy backlogs, track sprint progress, and provide stakeholders with accurate and timely delivery visibility.
   

  

 Your work will directly contribute to improving sprint predictability, resolving blockers, and creating sustainable delivery habits.
   

  

 You will collaborate with technology teams and stakeholders in an environment that values continuous improvement, transparency, and effective communication.
   

  

 You will also have the opportunity to use AI\-assisted productivity tools to streamline ceremony preparation, documentation, and reporting.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring ceremonies remain structured, time\-boxed, and focused on clear outcomes.
* Support team charters, kickoffs, working agreements, and delivery expectations for new or developing Agile teams.
* Document key decisions, action items, and commitments from Scrum ceremonies to ensure continuity between sprints.
* Coach and support teams that are still developing their Agile practices, helping them apply Scrum principles effectively in their day\-to\-day work.
* Identify impediments early, coordinate appropriate escalation, and follow through to help prevent blockers from affecting sprint commitments.
* Encourage open, constructive retrospectives and ensure agreed improvement actions are tracked through to completion.
* Maintain Jira boards, backlogs, sprint configurations, stories, and other delivery information for assigned teams.
* Monitor team\-level delivery metrics, including velocity, sprint completion, and open impediments, using Jira dashboards and established reporting practices.
* Provide concise, accurate, and timely delivery updates to stakeholders based on completed work and current team status.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to support ceremony preparation, meeting notes, documentation, and status reporting while reducing repetitive administrative work.
* Promote transparency, accountability, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration across technology teams.
* Help teams build consistent delivery habits that improve predictability and reduce day\-to\-day process friction.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an Agile delivery support role within a technology environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, ceremonies, roles, and Agile delivery practices.
* Hands\-on experience facilitating or co\-facilitating sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Practical experience using Jira for sprint tracking, story management, backlog administration, and basic dashboard configuration.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to keep teams aligned and follow through on commitments.
* Proven ability to identify, manage, and escalate delivery impediments effectively.
* Comfortable supporting teams that are developing or strengthening their Agile practices, with the ability to adapt your approach as teams mature.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the ability to communicate delivery status clearly and concisely.
* Experience facilitating constructive retrospectives and translating feedback into actionable improvements.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise technology teams.
* Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM I, or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Experience working within organizations with established Agile standards is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools or an interest in using automation to reduce repetitive administrative tasks is desirable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced technology environment.
* Willingness to work 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST to support relevant team and business requirements.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time opportunity based in India with a remote working arrangement.
* Flexible\-first working environment designed to support productivity and work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to work with technology teams operating at significant enterprise scale.
* Exposure to AI\-powered technologies and modern AI\-assisted productivity tools.
* Opportunities for professional growth through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development, and education support.
* Collaborative environment focused on Agile maturity, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Opportunity to develop deeper expertise in Scrum, Jira, Agile transformation, stakeholder management, and technology delivery.
* Well\-being resources and programs designed to support employees and their families.
* Paid volunteer time and additional employee\-focused initiatives.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to improving delivery predictability, team effectiveness, and technology outcomes.

description:
Fireflies is trusted by over
 **20 million people** 
 across more than
 **500,000 organizations** 
 from fast\-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Ramp ranks Fireflies the sixth most purchased AI platform in the US. Those numbers are useful for establishing that the work matters, and almost useless for describing what the work is, because the interesting thing about designing Fireflies is not the scale. It's the condition the person is in when they arrive.
   

  

 People arrive at Fireflies busy, distracted, and short on attention. They've just finished a meeting, have another in six minutes, and need to quickly find a decision, action item, notes, or catch up. Our job is to make the right things obvious, reduce cognitive load, and help them move forward with confidence.
   

  

 AI is changing how people work, and we're building the software that changes with it.
   

  

 Meetings were just the beginning. Today, Fireflies brings together context from meetings, email, Slack, CRMs, docs, and more to help people stay informed, make better decisions, and automate work. We're looking for
 **Product designers/builders** 
 excited to design
 **AI\-first experiences for mobile and wearable devices.**
**Design at Fireflies**
**Builders**
 Designers at Fireflies are product builders.
   

  

 They identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, prototype ideas, ship with AI tools, collaborate closely with engineers, stay close to customers, and continuously improve the product long after launch.
   

  

**Curious**
 AI gives us the opportunity to rethink how software works. We're excited by designers who are curious, experiment often, and help define new interaction patterns that make AI intuitive, trustworthy, and genuinely useful.
   

  

**Craft**
 People spend hours every day using Fireflies. Every interaction, animation, transition, piece of copy, and small detail contributes to how the product feels. We believe thoughtful craftsmanship creates products people enjoy coming back to.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Our best work comes from close collaboration between design, engineering, and product. We believe great ideas can come from anyone, and the strongest products are shaped together through open discussion, quick iteration, and shared ownership.
   

  

**Users**
 We spend time with customers, understand how they work, and use those insights to shape every product decision. Building products people love starts with understanding the people we're building for.
   

  

**Simplicity**
 We strive to make every experience simple, clean, and focused. We value designers who know what to simplify, what to prioritize, and what to leave out.
   

  

**Judgment**
 We care less about following a specific design process and more about your ability to ask thoughtful questions, make sound decisions, balance tradeoffs, and know when to go deeper or move faster.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own product surfaces end to end, from identifying opportunities to shipping polished experiences that people love.
* Build and ship prototypes, experiments, and production\-ready experiences using AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and whatever comes next.
* Improve Fireflies every day by spotting friction, refining workflows, and fixing the small details that make the product feel exceptional.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and product managers to turn ideas into thoughtful, high quality product experiences.
* Talk to customers regularly, develop a deep understanding of how they work, and turn those insights into better product decisions.
* Raise the quality bar across interaction design, visual design, motion, copy, and overall product craft.


 Design beautiful mobile experiences for iOS and Android, considering mobile interaction patterns, device ergonomics, touch targets, navigation, and the constraints of smaller screens.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 3\+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping mobile apps that customers love.
* Strong understanding of mobile design principles and ergonomics, with familiarity with Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines and Google’s Material Design.
* A portfolio that shows product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.
* Curiosity to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and rethink how AI changes the way people interact with software.
* A product builder mindset with a desire to own experiences from concept to continuous improvement.
* Curiosity about AI and excitement for designing products that don't yet have established patterns.
* An eye for detail and a relentless drive to improve the product, even when no one asks.


**Values that are important to us**
* You take initiative and improve things without waiting to be asked.
* You care deeply about quality and the details that make software feel effortless.
* You use tools to automate repetitive work so you can spend more time solving meaningful problems.
* You invest in getting better every week, whether that's design, AI, or how you work.
* You communicate openly, give thoughtful feedback, and care more about finding the best answer than being right.
* You have an internal compass and take accountability \& initiative.


**Perks And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation
* Work remotely anywhere in your respective country
* Ability to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly
* Paid time off and flexible leave policy
* No boss culture
* Flexible working hours
* LGBTQ\+ friendly
* Company offsites
* Tech reimbursements


**About Us**
 At Fireflies.ai, we’re revolutionizing the way teams interact with AI in their daily work. Our inclusive culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from top\-tier investors like Canaan, Khosla Ventures, and angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a passionate 100\+ member global team spanning 20\+ countries and every timezone. We’re building a world\-class, global\-first team, and we dogfood our product to do so.

title: Story writer
description:
**Role Overview**

PlotPix is building an AI native microdrama platform for mobile first, vertical storytelling. We create emotionally addictive, binge worthy fiction designed for short episode formats and fast audience payoff.

We are looking for a creative **Story Writer** who can create stories people feel compelled to continue. This is not a pure script formatting role. We already use AI heavily for speed and execution. What we need most is a strong creative mind with sharp instinct for storytelling, emotional progression, character build up, audience pull, narrative rhythm, and what makes a viewer care.

You should be someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into a compelling story engine. Someone who naturally thinks in terms of tension, reversals, chemistry, obsession, secrets, payoffs, emotional spikes, and binge flow.

This role is for people who are excited by new **storytelling formats, can adapt to new audiences quickly, and can use AI as a multiplier rather than as a crutch.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Create original microdrama story concepts with strong audience appeal
* Build lead characters viewers get emotionally invested in, root for, obsess over, hate, or can’t ignore
* Design high retention story arcs with clear emotional movement across episodes
* Shape narration flow, emotional flow, reveals, reversals, cliffhangers, and payoff moments
* Develop stories that feel highly bingeable in a short form vertical format
* Explore multiple creative directions for the same premise and identify the strongest one
* Adapt stories across genres, tones, and audience segments based on brief, platform need, or viewer response
* Work with AI tools to accelerate ideation, expansion, variation, and iteration
* Push past generic ideas and predictable beats to find fresher, sharper story turns
* Collaborate closely with directors, editors, and creative leads to refine stories from concept to final narrative
* Rewrite with intent, not just polish. Improve emotional impact, clarity, pace, and viewer pull
* Continuously learn what works for new formats, new markets, and changing audience tastes

**What We’re Really Looking For**

* Strong instinct for storytelling over scripting
* Strong sense of emotion over exposition
* Strong sense of viewer psychology over technical correctness
* Ability to create characters, conflict, tension, attraction, betrayal, longing, power shifts, and payoff
* Ability to judge whether a story feels flat, forced, repetitive, too safe, too slow, or not emotionally sticky
* High creative aptitude and fast pattern recognition
* Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and non traditional workflows
* Curiosity about what different audiences respond to and why
* Ability to use AI effectively while still bringing original taste and judgment

**Ideal Candidate** : 1\-2 years in MicroDrama

**What matters most is that you can:**

* Think of strong stories fast
* Build characters people care about
* Sustain emotional momentum
* Adapt to feedback without making the story bland
* Create for modern mobile audiences without sounding synthetic or derivative

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in short form fiction, web series, episodic storytelling, romance, thriller, drama, or youth content
* Understanding of Gen Z and young adult entertainment patterns
* Familiarity with cliffhanger design, binge loops, and retention driven storytelling
* Experience using AI tools for brainstorming, iteration, or story development
* Comfort working in a fast paced creative environment with frequent iteration

**What We Offer**

* Working with a highly skilled, motivated and passionate group of people.
* Exposure to the full product development process from ideation to launch.
* Our culture of experimentation and creativity allows everyone to explore new ideas and approaches and think outside the box.
* Building a product for the global audience.
* A full pantry of munchies.

===============================================================================================================

  

The National collections Head \- Litigation will be accountable for preparing strategies for time bound and cost\-effective legal actions and in ensuring that disputes concerned with company and other parties are properly resolved and settled. The incumbent will play key role in meeting recovery targets of entire retail portfolio through legal means.

 **2\) Dimensions:** Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.

* **Advising 4\+ National Collections Managers/NCHs.**
* **Advising head of legal and Head of collections on strategic changes in loan agreements, if any, on account of changing litigation environment.**
**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ((Max 3975 Characters)**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

  

Organization Context


Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India operating with several hundred of branches across India.

  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABFL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABFL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABFL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

  

Job Context:


Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.

  

The litigation vertical plays a crucial role in driving NPA recoveries and meeting ECL and recovery targets. National Litigation Head will drive all Collections Litigation for entire Retail Portfolio – both Secured \& Unsecured.

  

Given that the environment of regulatory \& legislative developments that the organisation operates in is very dynamic, the litigation department has constantly be up to date with changes, expected changes and prepare the organisation for the same. This position involves close association and coordination with business heads. He/she would be expected to have a thorough understanding of the company’s goals, strategy, business and products to perform effectively, think ahead and assess the legal implications of the same \& align legal function with business objectives.

  

Specific challenges—

* This role plays an important role in mitigating risk that may arise from litigation.
* In dealing with court matters, the individual must have persistency and a seamless understanding of the matter.
* Managing risks at the local level, including dealings with local law enforcement
* Ensuring the availability of the correct knowledge and talent for dealing with critical matters

=================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Devise strategy towards achieving favorable outcomes for the company in litigation matters**

  

* Strategize along with Regional Litigation Managers the approach for handling cases
* Review drafts for customer notices for recovery, lapses, defaults, covenant breaches

* Respond to notices from customer, statutory authorities \& regulatory bodies (RBI, ED, EOW, Income Tax, Police etc)

* Issue statutory notices and Provide replies to the notices received
* Facilitate re\-possession of assets

* Ensure there is compliance to policies \& guidelines for litigation management across the company
* Ensure SOPs are drafted for all litigation activities like settlements

* Provide oversight and be a coach and mentor for the team
* Ensure regular functional \& behavioral trainings of team members in collaboration with HR
* Participate in relevant talent management and people development activities to ensure a healthy pipeline and an engaged team
* Reduce dependence on external counsel by developing in\-house legal expertise
* Ensure department costs are within budgets
* Ensure development of robust knowledge management processes
* Ensure that the team keeps itself updated on changing legal environment

As we continue to grow our team, we are looking for a proactive and organised **HR \& Admin Intern** who can help us build strong people and operational processes while getting hands\-on exposure to a fast\-growing startup environment.

The Role

This is a **hands\-on HR \+ Administration internship** for someone who enjoys working with people, processes and execution.

You will work closely with the HR team and the Founder/leadership team across **recruitment, employee onboarding, HR operations, documentation, employee engagement and office administration**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of tasks, following up with people, maintaining records and ensuring that things actually get done.

This is **not a passive internship**. You will be expected to independently manage assigned HR and administrative responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Hiring

* Support the team in sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and other channels.
* Screen resumes against defined job requirements.
* Coordinate initial candidate communication and interview schedules.
* Maintain the candidate pipeline and recruitment tracker.
* Follow up with candidates and interviewers.
* Coordinate offer documentation and joining formalities.
* Maintain a structured database of candidates and hiring status.

2\. Employee Onboarding \& HR Operations

* Maintain employee master data and HR trackers.

* Maintain leave, attendance and basic employee records.
* Support exit formalities and documentation.

3\. Employee Engagement

* Help organise employee engagement activities, celebrations and team events.
* Coordinate birthday, work anniversary and other employee initiatives.
* Assist in collecting employee feedback.
* Help build a positive and engaging workplace culture.
* Support internal communication and HR announcements.

4\. HR Documentation \& Process

* Maintain HR policies, templates and employee documentation.
* Ensure HR records are organised and up to date.
* Help create and maintain SOPs for recurring HR processes.
* Support HR reporting and periodic management updates.
* Identify gaps in existing HR processes and suggest improvements.

5\. Administration \& Office Operations

* Support day\-to\-day office administration.
* Coordinate office supplies, vendors and basic facilities requirements.
* Maintain records of administrative expenses and purchases.
* Coordinate with housekeeping, office vendors and service providers.
* Support travel, meeting and event arrangements when required.
* Ensure the office is organised and operationally ready.

6\. Startup \& Founder's Office Support

Since Telosa is a growing startup, you will also get exposure to **Founder’s Office / business operations**.

You may be involved in:

* Creating trackers and reports.
* Following up on action items.
* Coordinating across teams.
* Supporting internal projects.
* Preparing basic presentations/documents.
* Helping implement new processes as the organisation scales.

What We Are Looking For

* Good organisational and follow\-up skills.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will get practical exposure to:

**Recruitment → Onboarding → HR Operations → Employee Engagement → HR Documentation → Administration → People Processes → Startup Operations**

You will work closely with the leadership team and understand how HR and people operations are built in a growing company from the ground up.

Performance \& PPO Criteria

This internship is designed as a **PPO\-track opportunity**.

At the end of the internship, the candidate may be offered a **full\-time position with Telosa**, based on performance and business requirements.

The PPO will primarily be evaluated on:

1\. Ownership

Does the intern take responsibility for tasks without requiring constant follow\-up?

2\. Execution

Are assigned tasks completed accurately and on time?

3\. Recruitment Effectiveness

Ability to source, screen and coordinate good candidates effectively.

4\. Process Discipline

Ability to maintain accurate trackers, documentation and HR records.

5\. Communication

Professional and timely communication with candidates, employees and stakeholders.

6\. Problem Solving

Ability to identify issues and independently find practical solutions.

7\. Initiative

Does the intern identify things that need to be done rather than waiting for instructions?

8\. Cultural Fit

Ability to work collaboratively and contribute positively to Telosa's startup culture.

Indicative 90\-Day Outcomes

By the end of the first 3 months, the intern should be able to:

* Independently maintain the **employee master tracker**.

The role involves supporting and managing day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, onboarding, HR documentation, employee engagement, and counselling session management.

Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

Employee Lifecycle Management

* Coordinate employee and intern onboarding and offboarding activities.

* Maintain accurate employee records, databases, and personnel files.
* Assist with attendance, leave, and other employee\-related records.
* Coordinate with employees and internal teams to ensure smooth HR operations.


Employee Engagement \& Coordination

* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Address routine employee queries and coordinate with the appropriate team for resolution.
* Support internal communication and HR initiatives.
* Help foster a professional and positive employee experience.


Counselling \& Daily Coordination

* Manage and align daily counselling sessions and schedules.
* Coordinate between counsellors, employees/interns, candidates, and relevant internal teams.
* Maintain appropriate records and trackers related to counselling activities.
* Ensure smooth scheduling and timely follow\-ups.


HR Administration \& Reporting

* Prepare HR reports, presentations, trackers, and operational updates.
* Maintain recruitment and employee\-related dashboards and databases.

* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive employee and candidate information.

REQUIREMENTS

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and people\-management skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment and basic HR processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Professional approach toward handling confidential information.
* Good problem\-solving and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Manage candidate sourcing through **LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, and other recruitment platforms**.

* Proactively reach out to potential candidates and build talent pipelines for current and future positions.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies regarding job requirements, candidate profiles, interview schedules, and follow\-ups.
* Evaluate and identify effective candidate\-sourcing channels based on hiring requirements.
* Maintain recruitment databases, candidate pipelines, and hiring trackers with accurate and timely updates.
* Drive regular follow\-ups with candidates and recruitment partners to ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Support the HR team in improving recruitment strategies, sourcing methods, and hiring processes.

* **Program Duration:** 6 Months
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid
* **Nature of Program:** Full\-Time

* Experience managing employee lifecycle processes.
* Exposure to employee engagement and HR administration.
* Experience coordinating counselling sessions and internal activities.
* Development of professional communication and people\-management skills.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced HR professionals and management.
* Certificate of completion upon successful completion of the program.
* Practical experience in the education management industry.

**Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM**


LOCATION

**Borivali East, Mumbai**

**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.

* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.

* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.

* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner

* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.

title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.


This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi\-tenant AKS operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Operations \& Service Ownership**

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.


Kubernetes Platform Management

* Oversee centralized multi\-tenant AKS environments supporting mission\-critical and non\-mission\-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self\-service capabilities.

### **Reliability Engineering \& Operational Excellence**

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation\-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.

title: Senior Manager - Revenue Operations
description:
**InMobi Advertising** is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150\+ countries and turns real\-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy\-first principles. Trusted by 30,000\+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.



Through **Glance AI,** we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery. Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first\-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi's global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.



Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company's Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.



At **InMobi Advertising**, you'll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com


#### **What is the role about?**



Reporting to InMobi Advertising's VP, Revenue Operations \& Chief of Staff, you will lead Revenue Operations — the operational engine of InMobi's Go\-To\-Market organization. You own three integrated pillars: Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. This role directly supports the global revenue organization, partnering with sales and services teams across every major global market.



You are accountable for ensuring the right people chase the right accounts, with the right tools, measured against the right goals. You will also lead AI transformation across the revenue organization, identifying where AI and automation create meaningful operational leverage and driving adoption end\-to\-end. The right candidate brings a bias for action, a 1:1 say/do ratio, and a demonstrated track record of holding teams accountable to their commitments.


**What will you be doing?**


#### **RevOps Area of Ownership**


* Sales Technology: Own the end\-to\-end GTM technology stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Einstein, Fireflies, Slack), ensuring system integrity, data accuracy, and a single source of truth. Own vendor relationships, tech\-stack audits, the technology budget, and new employee onboarding across all revenue systems.
* SalesOps: Own the operating system of the sales organization – sales process design, territory planning and segmentation, quota modeling and allocation, pipeline management and forecasting, and velocity and churn/retention analytics.
* Compensation: Own compensation policy design, quota structure, performance measurement, the GTM scorecard, and commission administration (accelerators, SPIFs, exceptions). Ensure on\-time delivery of actualized performance data to HR for payroll and model incentive scenarios each quarter.

#### **AI Transformation**


* Own the AI transformation roadmap for revenue operations: identify the highest\-impact opportunities across all three pillars, and drive initiatives from proof\-of\-concept through full\-scale implementation.
* Lead adoption of AI\-powered tools and workflows – intelligent lead scoring, automated deal analysis, pipeline forecasting, and customer health monitoring.
* Drive AI fluency across the revenue organization through structured enablement and change management.

#### **Operating Cadence**


* Annual: goal\-framework design, territory planning, tech\-stack audit, compensation policy refresh, vendor reviews, and budget.
* Quarterly: run the Actualize Plan Deliver cycle across all three pillars – close prior quarter, finalize forecasts and incentive models, and deliver quotas, comp plans, and system builds before quarter start.
* Weekly: pipeline reviews with sales leaders, activity reviews, hygiene enforcement, adoption monitoring, and support triage.

#### **Team Leadership**


* Lead a multi\-function team spanning Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. Build a high\-performance culture where commitments are honored and outcomes take precedence over activity.
* Set quarterly OKRs for all team members with clear accountability for deliverables and timelines. Report on outcomes with measurable business impact.
* Be a leader within the Bangalore HQ office, leading cross functionally and using influence to drive outcomes.

#### **What is expected from you?**


* 10–15 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations within digital advertising, B2B SaaS, or technology.
* Demonstrated success leading a multi\-pillar revenue operations function spanning sales technology, sales operations, and compensation.
* Experience owning the full revenue lifecycle: sales process design, territory planning, quota modeling, pipeline management, forecasting, velocity analytics, churn/retention, and compensation administration.
* Track record leading AI or automation transformation initiatives within a revenue or go\-to\-market organization, from evaluation through adoption.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce, HubSpot, Looker, and revenue intelligence platforms (Einstein, Gong, Clari, Fireflies).
* Proven leadership of cross\-functional teams at a global scale with documented business impact and a track record of holding teams to deliverables.

#### **Skills \& Attributes**


* Bias for action: You move decisively, prioritize execution, and course\-correct as needed.
* 1:1 say/do ratio: Your commitments are reliable. You deliver what you promise, when you promise it.
* Accountability\-driven: You set clear expectations and hold yourself and your team to them as an operating principle.
* Solution\-oriented: Every problem comes with a proposed path forward.
* Analytical rigor with the ability to translate complex data into business decisions.
* Strong project management discipline across multiple concurrent functional areas.
* Excellent communication skills with an emphasis on clarity, directness, and follow\-through.
* Experience in high\-growth, fast\-paced technology environments. Familiarity with revenue recognition principles, financial planning, and tools such as Excel, SQL, or Tableau.

**The InMobi Culture**



At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.



We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.



We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.



InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.



Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

With a shared focus on refining processes and enhancing technology, while spearheading strategic growth initiatives, we seamlessly contribute to our collective success.

 **We are growing our fleet Team and seeking passionate professionals interested to join our team, as a Fleet Key Account Manager ( hunter \& farmer), to manage business relations with our Taxi and Limousine Fleet Partners network within several cluster countries in the region. The role is fully remote in India.**

* Relationship Management:
	+ Develop and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with key fleet partners.
	+ Act as the main point of contact for all account\-related matters, ensuring effective communication and understanding of fleet requirements.
* Strategic Account Planning:

	+ Identify opportunities for account growth and expansion, ensuring alignment with the company's overall business objectives.

	+ Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market changes to identify opportunities and potential risks.

**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills with intercultural experience.

* Salary structure: monthly salary base \+ commission.
* Business Travel expenses reimbursement.
* Discounts for Talixo services.

**Recruitment process:**

* 2nd stage Google Meet interview with Hiring Manager and COO \+ Case Study (only selected candidates)

title: Manager, HR Technology
description:

Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The Manager, HR Technology owns the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of OpenGov’s HR technology stack, ensuring the systems and integrations that manage employee data across the employee lifecycle are reliable, compliant, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce. Based in Pune, India and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this role leads a team of HR application administrators and partners with stakeholders across the US and India — HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace — to maintain and streamline the systems that support the full employee lifecycle, from hire to retire and onboarding to offboarding.


We are looking for a seasoned HR technology leader with deep, hands\-on domain expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and general HR operations — spanning both US and India geographies, and ideally complemented by experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP. This is a player\-coach role: the individual stays hands\-on across the Workday stack and the broader application portfolio while leading, mentoring, and growing the team and building depth and backup coverage across critical domains. The Manager owns the technical relationship with Ashby (ATS), oversees the employee engagement survey platform, and maintains a functional understanding of NetSuite/ERP as it ties into HRIS data flows. They partner closely with the HRIS/HR Systems Architect on integration architecture and share responsibility for HR data governance.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of HR application administrators — setting priorities, developing technical and functional skills, and building depth and backup coverage across critical domains.
* Operate as a player\-coach: remain hands\-on across the Workday stack and broader application portfolio while coaching the team and providing techno\-functional guidance across HR domains.
* Manage team intake, workload, and prioritization across a broad portfolio of projects and day\-to\-day support, adhering to deadlines and communicating status to stakeholders and leadership.


HR Systems Administration \& Domain Support

* Provide administration, configuration, support, and maintenance across OpenGov’s HR and Payroll systems, including the full Workday suite (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security).
* Deliver hands\-on techno\-functional expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, and general HR operations — for both US and India geographies.
* Support India\- and US\-specific processes and regulatory requirements, including localized absence, compensation, and payroll configurations.
* Own the technical relationship with Ashby (ATS) — integration health, configuration, and offer workflows — and provide strategic guidance on the talent acquisition technology stack.
* Administer and support the employee engagement survey platform (e.g., CultureAmp), including survey launches, configuration, and data management.
* Perform regular audits to ensure proper functioning of system processes and data integrity across HR applications.


Projects \& Stakeholder Partnership

* Partner with client groups and stakeholders globally to evaluate business needs and recommend system\-based solutions.
* Consult with stakeholders to identify system gaps and opportunities addressed through configuration changes, deployment of undeployed functionality, and new feature releases.
* Lead projects end to end — leading meetings, providing regular updates, and adhering to project deadlines.
* Assist in the development of materials and delivery of system training for end users.
* Maintain documentation of functional requirements and system specifications.


Data, Reporting \& Governance

* Design, develop, and deploy reports and dashboards to support business initiatives, including Workday report writing and data extracts.
* Share responsibility for HR data governance, partnering with the HRIS/HR Systems Architect and IT on data structures, security, and downstream data flows (e.g., BI / data\-warehouse integrations).
* Regularly evaluate HR technology processes and methodologies to identify, recommend, and align them to best practices.


Integrations \& Vendor Management

* Provide functional support for integrations across the HR ecosystem (e.g., ADP, Ashby, engagement survey, SSO/identity, ERP, and downstream data platforms) to ensure successful execution.
* Maintain a functional understanding of NetSuite or a comparable ERP and how it ties into HRIS data flows.
* Partner with the HRIS/HR Systems Architect on integration architecture and manage third\-party vendor and implementation\-partner relationships.


Compliance \& Best Practices

* Ensure HR systems and processes support compliance requirements across the US and India, including audits, policy acknowledgements, and mandatory training (e.g., compliance/harassment training platforms).
* Conduct research to identify best practices and stay current on system releases and industry trends.
* Exhibit sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data.

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 8\+ years of progressive HR technology / HRIS functional and technical experience.
* 2\+ years of direct people\-management experience leading a technical or functional team; this is not an entry\-level management role.
* Broad, hands\-on domain expertise across multiple HR areas — payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, employee engagement, and general HR operations.
* Experience supporting HR systems across multiple geographies, ideally including both India and the US.
* 3\+ years of Workday administration/configuration experience with strong depth across the module stack (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Reporting, Security, Talent, Time Tracking) — not limited to one or two specialties.
* Proficiency with Workday report writing.
* Experience administering an applicant tracking system (Ashby preferred) and an employee engagement survey platform (CultureAmp preferred).
* Working knowledge of HR system integrations and how HRIS data flows into ERP (NetSuite or comparable) and downstream systems.
* Experience with NetSuite or comparable ERP administration a plus.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and growing technical/functional team members and building backup coverage across critical domains.
* Strong understanding of HR compliance and data governance/privacy considerations across regions.
* Excellent problem solving, collaboration, time management, and organization skills.
* Familiar with agile methodologies and the Atlassian tech stack (Jira, Confluence).
* Ability to communicate clearly through verbal, written, and non\-verbal methods to all levels of the organization, and to partner effectively with globally distributed stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented team player able to handle multiple projects and priorities.
* Workday certifications or training courses/seminars preferred.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
Job Overview\- 4years\-5years experience

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **HR / Talent Acquisition Executive** who can manage recruitment activities, coordinate interviews with candidates and multiple MNC clients, and build strong relationships with companies to identify new job openings.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong follow\-up abilities, and experience in recruitment coordination, client communication, and candidate management.

Key Responsibilities

* Connect with **MNCs, corporate companies, and HR/recruitment teams** to identify current and upcoming job openings.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with company HRs, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Source and collect job requirements from multiple companies.
* Understand job descriptions, eligibility criteria, experience requirements, salary ranges, and hiring timelines.
* Source suitable candidates through job portals, databases, LinkedIn, references, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen candidates based on job requirements and shortlist suitable profiles.
* Coordinate **multiple interview schedules** between candidates and company HR/recruiters.
* Manage interview calendars, confirmations, rescheduling, and follow\-ups.
* Communicate interview details clearly to candidates, including date, time, location/online meeting link, and required documents.
* Follow up with candidates and companies regarding interview results and next steps.
* Maintain accurate records of candidates, interviews, job openings, and hiring status.
* Follow up on offers, joining dates, and candidate closures.
* Develop new corporate clients and generate additional recruitment opportunities.
* Regularly contact companies to understand their manpower requirements and upcoming vacancies.
* Maintain a database of active clients, job openings, candidates, and interview status.
* Prepare daily/weekly recruitment reports and provide updates to management.
* Ensure a positive candidate and client experience throughout the recruitment process.

Required Skills

* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-management skills.
* Good negotiation and convincing abilities.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle **multiple clients, candidates, and interviews simultaneously**.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and hiring processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and email communication.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms is an advantage.
* Ability to work with targets and meet recruitment deadlines.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Experience in **HR recruitment, staffing, placement consultancy, or talent acquisition**.
* Experience communicating with MNC HR teams or corporate recruiters will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong communication and business\-development skills can also be considered.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in recruitment may be considered for an entry\-level position.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

JR112035**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**

  

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

 **IT Services Specialist – Job Description**

 **Summary:**


Genesys IT is currently seeking an IT Services Specialist to join our EMEA team. This is a rare opportunity for an individual who can build strong relationships, earn trust across the business, and represent IT with professionalism while managing ServiceDesk incidents and requests at an advanced level.

  

The IT Services Specialist (L2/L3\) serves as a key technical resource within the region, providing hands\-on support and delivering high\-quality customer service to employees across EMEA—including executive leadership. The role is responsible for resolving escalated issues from the Global Helpdesk and junior Desktop team members, managing Tier 2/3 troubleshooting across hardware, software, operating systems, network connectivity, collaboration tools, and all deployed end\-user technologies.


In addition to advanced incident resolution, this position supports employee onboarding and offboarding, contributes to device lifecycle operations, and assists in the training and oversight of junior Desktop Specialists under the direction of the team manager. Issues requiring deeper technical expertise will be escalated to L4 subject\-matter teams, with the Senior Specialist maintaining ownership for follow\-up and ensuring service levels are achieved.

  

As IT Services evolves with AI\-assisted diagnostics, automation, and modern endpoint management, the Senior Specialist will help drive adoption of these tools to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. The role demands a disciplined approach to process execution and strict adherence to regional compliance requirements, including Sarbanes\-Oxley, ISO9001:2008, and ISO27001 frameworks.


This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role requiring strong technical proficiency, exceptional communication skills, and the maturity to operate independently. The successful candidate will demonstrate a commitment to continuous improvement while delivering a reliable, frictionless technology experience for users across the region.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**Advanced Support (L2/L3\)**

* Serve as the escalation point for complex incidents that cannot be resolved by the Global Helpdesk or junior Desktop Specialists.
* Troubleshoot, configure, and repair computer hardware, printers, software, operating systems, and network connectivity issues.
* Provide hands\-on and remote support to users across EMEA, including delivering VIP and executive support with discretion and urgency.
* Coordinate with L3/L4 global teams for advanced troubleshooting and ensure timely incident resolution.
* Perform installations, maintenance, and repair work on client computing hardware and software.

 **Operational Service Delivery**

* Support end\-user device lifecycle: deployment, operations/support, updates, and retirement.
* Manage onboarding/offboarding tasks including device preparation, account setup, and new hire orientation support.
* Maintain accurate asset and software inventory within ServiceNow.
* Support mobile devices (iOS, Android) including management via Intune Endpoint Management.
* Configure, maintain, and support Dell PCs, MacBooks, peripherals, and related hardware.
* Support and maintain audio/visual equipment and meeting room technologies (Zoom, Teams).
* Perform routine administrative tasks in ServiceNow, Active Directory, Azure AD, and SharePoint.
* Provide on\-site support as needed, including assisting with IT equipment moves and office relocations.
* Participate in after\-hours or on\-call rotations based on business needs.
* Manage hardware order processing, invoice coding, and charge\-back procedures in the financial system.

 **Team Support \& Leadership**

* Provide guidance and support to junior Desktop team members on ticket prioritization and handling.
* Assist with onboarding and training of new team members, supporting skill development and process adherence.
* Act as deputy when the team manager is unavailable.

 **Compliance, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Adhere to SOX, ISO9001:2008, ISO27001, and corporate compliance requirements.
* Maintain up\-to\-date documentation for support processes, workflows, and operational procedures.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to improvements in processes, knowledge articles, and service workflows.
* Drive improvements in MTTR, SLA compliance, and first\-time resolution through disciplined troubleshooting.

 **AI \& Modern Support Enablement**

* Use AI\-powered diagnostic tools, automated scripts, and virtual agents to accelerate issue resolution.
* Provide feedback to enhance automated knowledge content and chatbot\-driven deflection.
* Support zero\-touch and modern provisioning workflows (Autopilot, Intune) under guidance from engineering teams.
* Review and interpret endpoint analytics dashboards to help identify emerging support trends.

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Global IT, Security, HR, and Facilities to ensure smooth service delivery across the region.
* Support regional IT initiatives, infrastructure deployments, and business events requiring IT presence.

 **Minimum Requirements:**

* 4\-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting, configuring, and repairing computer hardware, printers, software, network connectivity and operating systems.

description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26097972

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**


**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**


**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.


* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).
