title: Government Tender & Manpower Contract Manager
description:
Government Tender \& Manpower Contract Manager

**Company:** Moonlight Placement Services  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 3–7 years  
**Salary:** ₹35,000 – ₹60,000 per month, depending on experience

About the Role

Moonlight Placement Services is expanding into **Government Manpower Outsourcing Contracts** and is looking for an experienced **Government Tender \& Manpower Contract Manager** who can independently handle the complete tender\-to\-execution process.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with **Government manpower outsourcing tenders**, preferably through GeM, CPPP/eProcure and State Government e\-tender portals.

Key Responsibilities

* Search and identify suitable Government manpower outsourcing tenders.
* Study tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work and payment terms.
* Evaluate whether the company is eligible and commercially capable of bidding.
* Prepare and coordinate **technical and financial bids**.
* Handle GeM, CPPP/eProcure and relevant State Government tender portals.
* Calculate manpower costs, statutory costs, service charges and overall project profitability.
* Handle EMD, Performance Security/PBG and other tender requirements.
* Coordinate preparation of tender documentation, affidavits, declarations and certificates.
* Coordinate with government departments regarding tender queries and clarifications.
* Manage awarded manpower contracts from onboarding through completion.
* Coordinate employee deployment, attendance, replacements and contract requirements.
* Ensure compliance with **PF, ESIC, Bonus, Minimum Wages and applicable labour regulations**.
* Prepare and coordinate monthly invoices and supporting documents.
* Track government payments, deductions, recoveries and contract renewals.
* Maintain tender records, work orders, agreements and compliance documentation.
* Work closely with the recruitment team to ensure timely manpower deployment.

Mandatory Experience

Candidates must have practical experience in **Government manpower outsourcing / staffing tenders**.

Experience with the following will be strongly preferred:

* GeM manpower outsourcing
* CPPP / Central Government e\-tenders
* State Government e\-tender portals
* Government staffing/manpower contracts
* Labour compliance
* Government billing
* EMD / PBG / Performance Security
* Tender costing and commercial bidding

Who We Are Looking For

We are **not looking for a general HR executive or a person who only knows how to upload tenders**.

We need someone who understands the complete business:

**Tender Search → Eligibility → Costing → Bid Submission → Contract Award → Manpower Deployment → Compliance → Billing → Payment → Contract Renewal**

Candidates who have previously worked with **manpower agencies, facility management companies, staffing companies or contractors handling Government contracts** are preferred.

Interview Requirement

Shortlisted candidates may be given an actual Government manpower tender and asked to explain:

* Whether we are eligible to bid
* Documents required
* Estimated manpower cost
* Statutory compliance requirements
* Recommended commercial/service charge
* Expected profitability
* Working\-capital requirement
* Major risks or disqualification points

**Candidates with proven hands\-on Government manpower tender experience are encouraged to apply.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands\-on experience do you have in Government manpower outsourcing tenders?
* Which Government tender portals have you personally used?
* What was the highest\-value Government manpower contract/tender you personally handled? Please mention approximate tender value and manpower count.
* Please describe your hands\-on experience in Government Manpower Outsourcing Tenders. Mention the Government departments/organizations you have worked with, tender portals you have used (GeM/CPPP/eProcure/State portals), approximate number and highest value of tenders you personally handled, manpower deployed, and explain how you independently handle tender eligibility, costing (minimum wages, PF, ESIC, bonus, service charge \& GST), bid submission, EMD/PBG, contract execution, manpower deployment and government billing.

title: HRSD Operations Lead - APAC
description:
We believe in a world where growth thrives across borders and cultures. Our mission is to guide companies on their journey by providing services and technology that enables global talent management and delivers a human experience.

  



As an Employer\-of\-Record (EOR) provider, we offer the HR and compliance infrastructure essential for companies to expand internationally. We take care of the complex, behind\-the\-scenes work, allowing companies to focus on the strategies that drive their success. We are For People, By People.

  



The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values, they are who we are.

  



We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

  



If you are interested in working in a people\-centric, global organization, apply below.

 **About the Role**



The Regional HR Service Delivery Lead is responsible for the end\-to\-end performance, governance, and execution integrity of HR service delivery across assigned countries within APAC and/or Middle/East.



This role owns service delivery outcomes, escalation management, compliance adherence, and operational controls, ensuring HR services are delivered accurately, consistently, and in accordance with local employment laws, contractual obligations, and internal policies.



The Lead serves as the primary escalation point for complex HR matters, including direct engagement with Workers (WSEs) and Clients, and is accountable for resolving issues prior to escalating to senior leadership. This role acts as the first line of escalation before Sr. Manager involvement, ensuring all matters are resolved with clear documentation, appropriate judgment, and compliance validation.



This role provides direct leadership to Regional HR Service Delivery Specialists (Tier 2\) and ensures alignment with the global service delivery model, including SLAs, controls, and service standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Regional HR Service Delivery Oversight \& Execution Governance**


* Assist in oversight end\-to\-end HR service delivery operations across assigned countries, ensuring adherence to SLAs, service catalog, and operating model
* Review and validate case resolution quality, including accuracy of decisions, policy application, and completeness of documentation
* Ensure HR cases and lifecycle actions are supported by documented approvals, audit trails, and system records
* Monitor and enforce case management standards, including response times, resolution timelines, and escalation protocols
* Ensure consistent execution of HR processes aligned with global standards and regional legal requirement


**Escalation Ownership, Decision Authority \& External Engagement**


* Act as the primary and first line escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high\-risk HR matters
* Engage directly with WSEs (Workers) and Clients to investigate issues, provide guidance, and communicate resolutions
* Conduct case review and risk assessment, determining appropriate resolution actions in alignment with policy and legal requirements
* Provide final decision\-making and approval on Tier 2 escalations, including non\-standard or exception\-based scenarios
* Escalate only high\-risk, legally sensitive, or business\-critical matters to the Sr. Manager, with a clear summary, risk assessment, and recommended action
* Ensure all escalations are fully documented, including facts, analysis, decision rationale, actions taken, and final resolution


**Regional Compliance \& Risk Management**


* Drive compliance with country\-specific employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across the region. This role supports the MEA/APAC regions.
* Validate that HR lifecycle activities (e.g., hires, changes, terminations) are executed in compliance with local regulations and contractual obligations
* Establish and enforce HR control frameworks, including approval requirements, documentation standards, and validation checkpoints
* Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and compliance risks, including policy misapplication and data integrity issues
* Ensure readiness for internal and external audits, including provision of documentation and explanation of decisions


**Team Mentorship, Performance Management \& Capability Building**


* Mentor a team of Employee Relationship Consultants, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and expectations
* Allocate and manage workload to ensure balanced case distribution, SLA adherence, and timely resolution
* Review team output for accuracy, completeness, and compliance adherence
* Monitor and manage performance against KPIs, SLAs, and quality standards, implementing corrective actions as needed
* Provide guidance on complex case handling, policy interpretation, and compliance application


**Operational Excellence, Process Standardization \& Transformation**


* Standardize HR processes across countries by defining and enforcing consistent workflows, controls, and documentation requirements
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce variability, increase efficiency, and minimize risk
* Drive adoption of automation, self\-service tools, and workflow optimization in partnership with internal teams
* Establish and monitor KPIs and SLAs, using performance data to drive continuous improvement
* Lead or support transformation initiatives to scale HR service delivery and improve employee and client experience


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Dependency Management**


* Partner with Shared Services to ensure proper intake, triage, and escalation of HR cases
* Collaborate with Payroll, Benefits, Legal, and Finance to ensure accurate and compliant execution of HR processes
* Act as a key point of contact for Worksite employees and Clients on complex HR matters requiring advanced support
* Ensure alignment between upstream inputs (HR data, approvals) and downstream impacts (payroll, benefits, reporting)
* Drive resolution of cross\-functional issues by enforcing accountability, timelines, and clear ownership across teams


**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**


* Support relationships with regional vendors (e.g., benefits providers, local partners), where applicable
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, accuracy standards, and compliance requirements
* Conduct performance reviews, including issue tracking, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans
* Represent HR Service Delivery in client\-facing discussions, including escalations, service reviews, and issue resolution
* Communicate service performance, risks, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and stakeholders


**Controls, Documentation \& Audit Readiness**


* Ensure all HR processes are supported by current SOPs, knowledge articles, and control documentation
* Maintain audit\-ready records for HR cases, lifecycle actions, and compliance activities
* Enforce data privacy and confidentiality requirements (e.g., GDPR where applicable)
* Ensure all decisions, approvals, and actions are traceable, documented, and aligned with governance standards


**Qualifications \& Experience**


**Required**


* 7\+ years of experience in HR operations or HR service delivery, including multi\-country scope in APAC
* Demonstrated experience leading HR service delivery teams and managing escalations
* Strong knowledge of regional employment laws and HR compliance requirements
* Proven experience managing case operations with defined KPIs and SLAs
* Experience operating in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Fluency in English; additional regional language(s) preferred


**Preferred**


* Experience in shared services, EOR, or global HR operating models
* Familiarity with HRIS and case management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Workday, Zendesk, Salesforce)
* Experience leading HR transformation, automation, or system implementations
* Professional certification (e.g., CIPD, SHRM, PHR/SPHR)


This position description may not describe all duties, responsibilities, and skills associated with this position. It is intended to portray the major aspects of the job. Other duties or skills may be required.

  


**What We Offer**


* The opportunity to work with a purpose — simplifying global expansion across borders and cultures
* A diverse and inclusive environment

* Your birthday off and a day for you to volunteer and give back to the organization of your choice

description:
*We at Yara are part of a global network, collaborating to profitably and responsibly solve some of the world's key challenges \- resource scarcity, food insecurity and environmental change.*


**About the Unit**
------------------


For over a century, Yara has worked to feed the world and protect the planet, and our mission is to do this in aresponsible and sustainable way. Yara delivers solutions for sustainable agriculture and the environment. Their fertilizers and crop nutrition programs help produce the food required for the growing world population. Yara’s industrial products and solutions reduce emissions, improve air quality and support safe and efficient operations.


Founded in Norway in 1905, Yara has a worldwide presence with production and sales and services operations across countries i.e. America, Europe, Africa and Asia, with more than 17,000 employees, sales to 150 countries and sales revenue of more than 14 billion USD. Safety is always the top\-most priority.


Yara Fertilizers India Pvt Ltd is a 100% subsidiary of Yara International ASA. Yara has supplied fertilizers as well as fertilizer raw materials to the Indian market for over two decades. Yara India has continuously strengthened its footprint in Western and Southern India by providing Crop nutrition solutions with combination of Premium products and Knowledge through unique Farmer centric approach.


Yara’s philosophy is to connect with thousands of farmers at the grass root level and has a strong commitment to serving the agriculture sector in India, thereby improving the livelihood of Indian farmer.To leverage on this and to expand into the northern \& eastern geographies of India, Yara acquired Tata Chemicals’ 1\.2 MN MT Urea plant in UP, Northern India. With this acquisition Yara India’s scale of operation has grown significantly.


**Role \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------


* Plan, supervise and monitor maintenance, inspection, repair and testing of control valves, ON/OFF valves, relief/safety valves and pneumatic actuators in the plant and workshop.

* Ensure availability and proper use of tools, spares, testing equipment and workshop facilities required for maintenance activities.
* Provide technical guidance and on\-the\-job support to technicians and maintenance personnel, ensuring adherence to established maintenance procedures.
* Drive maintenance improvement, equipment reliability and preventive/predictive maintenance initiatives to minimize downtime and improve plant reliability.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety procedures, permit\-to\-work and isolation requirements, statutory standards and applicable safety practices, and ensure completion of required technical and safety training.
* Coordinate with contractors/vendors for maintenance activities and provide technical support/evaluation, wherever required.

* Proficiency in instrumentation troubleshooting, calibration and valve diagnostics.
* Good understanding of pneumatic and digital control systems.
* Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, instrument datasheets, valve manuals and technical drawings.
* Strong problem\-solving, maintenance planning and team coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of process safety, maintenance standards and safe work practices.

title: Senior Executive - Process
description:
**Job Description :**

**Job Title\-**


Senior Executive \- Process

 **About the Function:**


Supply Chain \& Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.


With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large\-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.


It’s fast\-paced and hands\-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

 **About the role:**

**Position:** Senior Executive – Malt \& Distillation  

**Function:** Manufacturing / Operations  

**Department:** Malt \& Distillation  

**Level:** L6B  

**Reporting To:** Manager / Senior Manager – Malt \& Distillation

**1\. Job Purpose**


To manage and support day\-to\-day operations of the **Malt and Distillation process**, ensuring safe, efficient, consistent and compliant production while meeting quality, productivity, yield and cost objectives.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Malt Operations**

* Monitor and manage malt production activities including **raw material handling, cleaning, steeping, germination, kilning and malt storage**.
* Ensure optimum process parameters are maintained for consistent malt quality.
* Monitor raw material consumption, process losses, yield and productivity.
* Coordinate with Quality and Laboratory teams for testing and release of malt.
* Identify process deviations and implement corrective actions.

**B. Distillation Operations**

* Monitor and control distillation operations as per defined SOPs and process parameters.
* Ensure efficient operation of **fermentation, distillation, spirit recovery and related processes**.
* Monitor alcohol yield, recovery, energy consumption and process losses.
* Ensure effective utilisation of plant equipment and minimise downtime.
* Support troubleshooting of process and equipment\-related issues in coordination with Engineering.

**C. Production Planning \& Performance**

* Execute daily production plans in line with business requirements.
* Track key production KPIs including **yield, productivity, quality, OEE, energy consumption and process losses**.
* Analyse deviations from production targets and initiate corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate production records, logbooks and MIS reports.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives for productivity, yield and cost optimisation.

**D. Quality \& Process Control**

* Ensure adherence to defined process standards, SOPs and quality specifications.
* Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Investigate process deviations, quality issues and customer/internal complaints.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

**E. Safety, Compliance \& Sustainability**

* Ensure strict adherence to **EHS standards, statutory requirements, SOPs and work permit systems**.
* Promote safe working practices and identify potential hazards in the process area.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **Excise, environmental and statutory requirements**.
* Drive initiatives related to water, steam, energy and other resource optimisation.
* Participate in safety audits, inspections and implementation of action plans.

**F. People \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with **Quality, Engineering, EHS, Stores, Utilities and Supply Chain** teams for smooth operations.
* Guide operators and workmen in effective execution of process activities.
* Support skill development, training and competency building of team members.
* Promote a culture of ownership, discipline, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**G. Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities for improvement in **yield, productivity, quality, energy efficiency and cost**.
* Participate in Lean / CI projects and implement best practices.
* Support automation and digitalisation initiatives in manufacturing processes.
* Benchmark processes and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

**3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Production plan achievement
* Malt yield and quality
* Distillation yield / alcohol recovery
* OEE and equipment utilisation
* Process losses and material efficiency
* Steam, water and energy consumption
* Product quality compliance
* Safety performance / incident reduction
* Excise and statutory compliance
* Cost reduction and productivity improvement
* Continuous improvement / CI projects
* Training and competency development

description:
**About the Role**

Marconix Sales Solutions is looking for a hands\-on HR \& Recruitment Manager to own end\-to\-end HR and Talent Acquisition for our Bangalore office. This is a high\-ownership, generalist role suited to someone who enjoys both the strategic and operational sides of HR — from full\-cycle recruitment and stakeholder management to HR operations, compliance, employee engagement, and building a strong workplace culture from the ground up.

You'll be the single point of contact for HR in the office, working closely with department heads and leadership to hire the right talent, keep employees engaged, and ensure HR processes run smoothly and compliantly.

**What You'll Do**

**Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle: requirement intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, define candidate profiles, and set hiring timelines
* Source active and passive candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, IIMJobs), employee referrals, and professional networks
* Conduct screening interviews to assess skills, experience, communication, and culture fit
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for current and upcoming hiring needs
* Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in the ATS/HRMS
* Deliver a strong candidate experience at every touchpoint, from first contact to day one

**HR Operations \& Compliance**

* Drive onboarding and induction for new hires, and manage exit formalities and full \& final settlements
* Maintain employee records, HR documentation, and HRMS data accuracy
* Support statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, labour law adherence) and coordinate with payroll for accurate, timely processing
* Track and report on headcount, attrition, and key HR metrics on a monthly basis
* Establish and maintain HR dashboards/reports for leadership review

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries, concerns, and grievances; escalate and resolve issues professionally
* Design and drive employee engagement initiatives to improve satisfaction and reduce attrition
* Support performance management cycles, including goal\-setting, appraisals, and feedback processes
* Partner with leadership on workforce planning aligned to business growth
* Help build a positive, high\-performance culture within a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred)
* 3–6 years of experience in HR \& Recruitment, ideally in a generalist or HR Business Partner capacity
* Strong hands\-on experience with full\-cycle recruitment and sourcing tools (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms)
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity)
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Proficiency with HRMS/ATS tools and MS Excel/Google Sheets for HR reporting
* Prior experience supporting employee engagement or culture\-building initiatives is a plus

**Why Join Marconix**

* High\-visibility role with direct exposure to leadership and business decision\-making
* Opportunity to build and shape HR processes and culture from an early stage
* Fast\-paced, growth\-oriented work environment

Our differentiation begins with our values, lived through our employees and aligned to the needs of our customers and communities. Learn more about our global enterprise, our values, and who we are, here.
  
  

**ABOUT THE JOB:**  

The Sales Compensation Analyst is responsible for the administration and operational support of sales compensation plans. This role ensures accurate calculations, timely payouts, and continuous system improvement. The ideal candidate will be highly analytical and collaborative, playing a key part in decision\-making through data reporting and compensation effectiveness analysis.
  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**  

Administer and maintain the commission management tool (e.g., Spiff), ensuring accurate commission calculations and timely payouts.
  
Manage and validate sales data in Spiff and Salesforce to ensure data integrity. Work closely with HRIT to implement system enhancements and upgrades.
  
Generate regular and ad\-hoc reports (from multiple data sources) to support leadership decision\-making and forecasting
  
Analyze compensation plan performance and payout effectiveness
  
Provide data support for governance meetings
  
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Finance, and HR to ensure alignment on compensation practices.
  
Perform regular audits of sales compensation data to ensure accurate and timely payments. Identify discrepancies, resolve issues proactively, and handle exceptions in a timely manner, in compliance with compensation policies.
  
Provide ongoing support by researching and resolving sales compensation program calculation\-related inquiries.
  
Assist with special projects and initiatives.
  
  

**EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS:**  

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of working experience in the related field.
  
Experienced professional with 5\+ years of expertise in compensation, sales operations, finance or similar roles.
  
Minimum 3 years’ experience with using, administering or configuring Incentive Compensation Software, i.e. Xactly, SAP Callidus or SPIFF
  
Knowledge of Salesforce and ability to create and run reports for ad hoc business needs.
  
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, vlookups, etc.)
  
Analytical mindset with excellence attention to details with emphasis on accuracy, and problem\-solving skills.
  
Effective communication skills to explain complex compensation concepts to stakeholders.

Team members may be required to perform duties outside normal responsibilities from time to time as needed.

The team currently consists of 30 members supporting 50\+ highly critical client accounts across two distinct functions \- MSP Specialists (Client Delivery) and MSP Admin. title: UI/UX Design Intern
description:
**About Us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organisations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you will be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As a UI/UX Design Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with designers, product managers, business analysts, and developers to create intuitive, user\-centric digital experiences for web and mobile applications.

You will contribute to real\-world projects — designing wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and interaction flows — while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into thoughtful design solutions.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end product design, design systems, UX research, and AI\-assisted design workflows. You will contribute to real design cycles while learning how fast\-growing product teams build scalable, structured design processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong visual thinking, attention to detail, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles, design thinking, and user\-centred design.
* Familiarity with Figma — components, auto layout, variants, and prototyping.
* Knowledge of user flows, wireframing, information architecture, and responsive design.
* Basic familiarity with FigJam, AI\-powered design tools, and accessibility best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Freshers and students are welcome. Academic projects, personal UI/UX work, or a portfolio are a strong plus.
* Interest in SaaS, AI, Healthcare, or startup products is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

UX Design \& Wireframing

* Assist in creating wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and document user flows, web flows, and interaction flows.
* Create user\-centric designs that focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive experiences.
* Contribute to solving user and business problems through thoughtful design solutions.

UI Design \& Design Systems

* Support UI design activities across web and mobile platforms.
* Assist in developing and maintaining design systems and reusable components.
* Create and maintain design documentation using Figma and FigJam.

Research \& Collaboration

* Participate in user research, competitor analysis, and design discussions.
* Work with product and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into design solutions.
* Participate in design reviews and improve designs based on structured feedback.

AI\-Assisted Design

* Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, and wireframing.
* Explore opportunities to integrate AI\-powered design tools into existing workflows.

**Work Style Expectations**

* Takes ownership from wireframe to final handoff — no step\-by\-step hand\-holding needed.
* Thinks in systems, not just screens; cares about design rationale, not just aesthetics.
* Communicates design decisions clearly with developers, product managers, and founders.
* Proactively identifies gaps, asks clarifying questions, and improves workflows without waiting for instructions.
* Handles multiple tasks in parallel with consistent attention to detail and visual quality.
* Disciplined with documentation, component libraries, and version control.
* Comfortable with fast feedback cycles, tight timelines, and shifting priorities.
* Curious about AI tools, automation, and making design workflows more efficient.
* We value design quality, ownership, and structured thinking — more than credentials alone.
* Candidates who copy templates without understanding context may struggle in this role.

**This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If**

* You prefer repetitive production work with fixed instructions for every design task.
* You struggle with iteration, design feedback, or maintaining visual and interaction consistency.
* You are uncomfortable with fast\-paced startup environments where product requirements can evolve quickly.
* You dislike structured design documentation, component systems, or process\-oriented design work.
* You prefer low\-ownership environments with limited accountability over design outcomes.

**Internship Structure**

* **The duration of the internship is 3 months.**
* Interns who demonstrate strong performance, design ownership, learning ability, and meaningful contribution may be considered for internship extension

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work closely with the Design, Product, and Engineering teams at V7 AI Solutions. You will gain hands\-on exposure to cross\-functional collaboration, real product cycles, and the end\-to\-end workflow of building digital products in a fast\-moving startup environment.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* End\-to\-end product design workflow
* UX research and requirement analysis
* User flow and web flow creation
* Design systems and component\-based design
* Real\-world collaboration with product and engineering teams
* AI\-assisted design processes
* Product thinking and problem\-solving approaches

**What Success Looks Like**

* Design deliverables are completed on time, with high quality and clear rationale.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
  

Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

**ABOUT EIGENDYNE**

EigenDyne is a Tamil Nadu\-based deep\-tech robotics startup building adaptive, vision\-driven robotic scanning systems for manufacturing and automotive OEM customers. We are recognized under the Startup India (Deep Tech) initiative and are building next\-generation classical computer\-vision\-based robotic platforms for industrial inspection and quality automation.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a motivated Robotics Engineer Trainee to join our core engineering team. This role is ideal for a recent graduate with a foundational understanding of ROS who is eager to build hands\-on experience with real robotic hardware, sensor integration, and scanning platforms in a fast\-paced startup environment. You will work closely with senior engineers on live projects and receive structured mentorship.

* Assist in developing and testing ROS\-based nodes and packages for robotic scanning applications
* Support integration of sensors (cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors) with robotic platforms
* Help set up, calibrate, and troubleshoot robot hardware in the lab and on the shop floor
* Write basic scripts in Python/C\+\+ for data logging, testing, and automation of routine tasks
* Participate in debugging and validation of robot motion and scanning workflows
* Document test procedures, results, and technical learnings
* Collaborate with the mechanical, electronics, and software teams during builds and trials

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics, Computer Science, or related field (recent graduates or final\-year students)
* Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2 fundamentals (nodes, topics, services, launch files) through academic or personal projects
* Basic programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+
* Understanding of basic robotics concepts: kinematics, sensors, and control
* Willingness to work hands\-on with hardware and learn on the job
* Good problem\-solving attitude and eagerness to learn in a startup environment

**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**

* Exposure to Linux/Ubuntu environment
* Familiarity with Git version control
* Prior project or internship experience involving robots, drones, or automation
* Basic exposure to Gazebo or other robotics simulators

**EDUCATION**

B.E./B.Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics \& Communication, or Computer Science (or equivalent).

title: Junior Recruiter/ Talent Acquisition Executive- Full Stack Hiring
description:
*Saleshandy* *is a SaaS platform helping sales teams at thousands of companies reach more prospects and close more deals. We are growing \- and growing means hiring. Not hiring for the sake of headcount, but bringing in people who raise the bar. We have 50\+ open roles across tech, product, sales, marketing, and Customer Success. This is not a role for someone who wants to "manage the process."*  

  

*This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes \- and understands that every great hire is a direct contribution to our growth story.*  

  

**We're Not Looking for a Traditional Recruiter. We're Hiring Someone Who Owns the Pipeline and Treats Every Hire as a Growth Decision.**  



**What You'll Actually Own**


*End\-to\-End Recruitment*

* Own the full hiring pipeline for each role \- sourcing, screening, coordination, and offer roll\-out
* Hire across functions: technical (engineering, QA, product, data) and non\-technical (sales, marketing, operations, customer success)
* Hire across seniority: freshers to senior\-level, and everything in between
* Ensure zero drop\-offs in pipeline \- every candidate has a status, every role has momentum  

  

*Sourcing \& Candidate Experience*
* Go beyond job boards \- LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, boolean search, referrals, alumni networks, campus connects
* Build real relationships with candidates, not transactional pipelines
* Ensure every candidate who interacts with Saleshandy leaves with a positive impression \- regardless of outcome  

  

*Hiring Operations \& Data*
* Keep Gohire updated, accurate, and insightful \- hiring data should tell a story, not just track stages
* Maintain hiring dashboards, pipeline reports, and offer documentation with precision
* Track your own metrics: time\-to\-hire, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance rate \- before anyone asks you to  

  

*SaaS Hiring Intelligence*
* Develop a deep understanding of the B2B SaaS talent landscape
* Know what a great SDR looks like vs. a great AM, what a backend engineer from a product startup brings vs. a services background
* Stay plugged into where the right people are \- and go find them

**What You Bring**

* 1\-2 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a SaaS or tech startup environment
* Demonstrated ability to hire across functions \- tech and non\-tech, junior and senior
* Genuine curiosity about the SaaS industry \- you follow the space, you understand the roles
* Hunter mentality in sourcing \- you are not waiting for applications
* Strong interpersonal skills \- you build relationships, not just pipelines
* Data\-driven by default \- you track your numbers without being asked
* High energy and resilience \- recruiting is emotionally complex and fast\-moving, and you handle it professionally

**Why This Role Matters**


You will be the engine behind Saleshandy's growth \- ensuring every team gets the right people, fast. With 50\+ roles open and a mandate that only grows, your work directly shapes who we become as a company.

description:
**About Milliman**
 Independent for over 70 years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation. Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance, and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Milliman is undertaking a major business transformation program to replace and modernize our HRIS, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services Automation systems. As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Data \& Application Integration Engineer to support the integrity, quality, and migration of data throughout this transformation. This role will work alongside senior engineers and business/technical teams, contributing to data mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms. This is a great opportunity for someone early\-to\-mid in their integration engineering career to grow their skills on a large\-scale enterprise transformation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the design, development, and implementation of application integrations under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist with A2A (application\-to\-application) integrations, including cloud\-to\-cloud, cloud\-to\-on\-premise, and on\-premise\-to\-on\-premise scenarios.
* Help migrate legacy integration processes into a centralized, standardized platform.
* Assist in gathering and documenting reference data sources, supporting strategies for managing reference and master data (MDM).
* Build data integration pipelines using modern data engineering tools and practices, with support from senior engineers.
* Develop and maintain data workflows, and help automate recurring processes.
* Build data processing solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Boomi, Snaplogic, Workato, or similar tools.
* Follow established data governance, data privacy, and security standards.
* Support CI/CD pipelines for integration and deployment of data solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in application integration, data engineering, or systems engineering.
* Exposure to data/application integration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Boomi, Snaplogic, Workato, or similar.
* Working proficiency with SQL and Python, and experience with relational databases.
* Foundational experience with data analysis, data profiling, data mapping, and ETL processes.
* Basic familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools.
* Good analytical skills with the ability to help translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, with willingness to collaborate across business and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced project environment, with a comfort level asking questions, seeking guidance, and learning quickly as part of a larger transformation team.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Azure Fabric or other cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Some exposure to HRIS, Finance, Legal, or Professional Services Automation systems.
* Familiarity with data governance or master data management (MDM) concepts.
* Interest in or coursework related to insurance, risk management, or financial services.

**Position: Support Executive**

**Location:** Gurgaon

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled Support Executive to provide technical assistance and operational support to customers and internal teams. The ideal candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting software and hardware issues, managing database\-related queries, coordinating with technical teams, and ensuring timely resolution of customer concerns. The role requires strong analytical skills, technical knowledge, and a customer\-centric approach.

**Customer \& Technical Support**

* Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and other communication channels.
* Provide first\-level technical support for software, hardware, and network\-related issues.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot application, system, and database\-related problems.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant teams and monitor resolution progress.
* Follow up with customers to ensure complete issue resolution and satisfaction.

**Database \& Server Management**

* Monitor and maintain SQL and MySQL databases.
* Perform database backups, restoration, and routine maintenance activities.
* Execute database queries and generate reports as required.
* Troubleshoot database performance and connectivity issues.
* Support the management and maintenance of database servers and application servers.

**Operations \& Documentation**

* Record and track support requests, issues, and resolutions.
* Maintain technical documentation, service reports, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ensure compliance with service standards and response timelines.

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Good knowledge of **SQL and MySQL**.
* Understanding of **Database Management Systems (DBMS)**.
* Experience in managing and troubleshooting **Database Servers**.

* Ability to write and execute SQL queries.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

description:

We're OakNorth, and we embolden entrepreneurs to realise their ambitions, understand their markets, and apply data intelligence to everyday decisions to scale successfully at pace. We go beyond finance to empower our people, encourage professional growth, and create an environment where everyone can thrive.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**


The Corporate Finance team sits at the heart of OakNorth's financial operations, covering reporting, planning, and control across our UK and international entities. The team works closely with FP\&A, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and the business to ensure robust financial governance and continuous process improvement.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an experienced Finance Controllership professional to join our Corporate Finance team. In this role you will own end\-to\-end accounting and reporting across both internal and external requirements — working under IFRS and Indian GAAP — while leading a broad array of planning projects and process improvement initiatives that directly support OakNorth's growth ambitions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own day\-to\-day accounting, month\-end closing, and periodic reporting in accordance with IFRS and Indian GAAP.
* Manage end\-to\-end accounting, valuation, and bank reconciliations for complex financial instruments including Investments, Borrowings, Loans, Deposits, and Derivatives (hedging compliance).
* Prepare Balance Sheet and P\&L items including prepayments, accruals, depreciation runs, intercompany entries, and other month\-end journals.
* Lead Fixed Assets and Intangible accounting, related schedules, and physical verifications; maintain General Ledger, vendor, and bank reconciliations.
* Support Statutory and Internal audits, preparing schedules, responding to auditor queries, and drafting internal notes/memos for approvals and audit evidence.
* Drive process standardisation and automation using data tools and AI\-enabled solutions in treasury and accounting workflows; draft and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (FP\&A, Operations, Legal, Credit/Portfolio Monitoring, Treasury, and the business) to identify process improvement opportunities and enhance the control environment.
* Prepare test scenarios and perform testing for system automation projects; assist with ad hoc projects as required.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* CA (Fresher)/CPA/MBA in Finance with 4–5 years of progressive experience demonstrating strong accounting expertise and advanced financial analytical skills.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and MS Office skills with a focus on reporting automation; ability to prioritise and manage multiple workflows simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience working across multiple functions and geographies in a fast\-paced organisation.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement outlook; comfortable operating at scale with a hands\-on attitude and big\-picture thinking.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in the banking or financial services sector.
* Experience with or interest in data automation tools such as Python/Pandas or VBA for automating reconciliations and reporting processes.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Health \& Protection:** Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* **Wellbeing:** Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* **Time Off:** Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* **Life Milestones:** Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* **Growth \& Development:** Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* **Our Workplace:** Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

**About Caarabi:**

Caarabi is a specialty coffee brand built on the belief that good coffee doesn't need to shout. We roast, we serve, we ship — across a growing network of outlets and a direct\-to\-consumer business. Our brand is quiet, considered, and unmistakable. Nothing about it is over\-designed or try\-hard.

We're looking for someone who gets that — and can carry it forward.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an enthusiastic, organized, and detail\-oriented **Customer \& Dispatch Coordinator** (Entry\-Level / Fresher) to join our operations team. In this role, you will assist in day\-to\-day order processing, coordinate with logistics partners, track shipments, and serve as the primary link between our customers and our fulfilment backend. If you have exceptional communication skills, a proactive attitude, and an eager interest in e\-commerce and customer operations, this is a great opportunity to build your career in a growing brand.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Order Fulfilment \& Processing**

* Assist in processing daily D2C (Shopify) and B2B orders.
* Assist in Print shipping labels, verify invoices, and coordinate with the warehouse team for accurate packing.
* Ensure daily dispatch target timelines are met.

**2\. Shopify Backend Support**

* Assist in updating order statuses, tracking numbers, and fulfillment records in the backend system.
* Assist with maintaining clean daily logs for dispatched and pending orders.
* Assist with basic inventory updates and stock alignment.

**3\. Logistics \& Dispatch Tracking**

* Liaise with courier partners to schedule daily pickups and resolve handover delays.
* Monitor live shipments, track transit status, and assist in identifying non\-delivery reports (NDR).
* Follow up on delayed or stuck packages to ensure prompt delivery.

**4\. Customer Communication \& Support**

* Respond promptly to customer inquiries via WhatsApp, email, and phone regarding order status, delivery timelines, and product information.
* Provide proactive delivery updates and handle basic customer concerns with warmth and empathy.
* Coordinate return/exchange requests with the warehouse team.

**5\. Process \& Administrative Assistance**

* Assist in maintaining daily operational spreadsheets and delivery tracking sheets.
* Assist seniors in preparing basic logistics and dispatch reports.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* **Technical Skills:** Basic proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and comfort learning software tools (Shopify, courier portals).
* **Attributes:** High attention to detail, strong problem\-solving mindset, punctuality, and a customer\-first attitude.
* **Interest:** Keen interest in direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) operations, logistics, or the specialty coffee industry.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Reduction in order Return to Origin (RTO) percentage
* Amount of failed delivery (NDR) shipments successfully rescued
* Number of non\-delivery alerts called within 3 hours
* Timeliness and accuracy of daily order dispatches
* Speed and consistency of customer call/chat responses
* Accuracy of master tracking sheet and backend inventory logs

Please send your resume to **careers@caarabicoffee.com** with the subject line: **"Customer \& Dispatch Coordinator \- \[Your name]"**.

title: ETP Operator
description:
ETP \& BIOFILTER OPERATOR

**Company:** Collagen Marine Products  
**Location:** Kakkadampoyil Plant  
**Department:** ETP \& Environmental Management  
**Position:** ETP \& Biofilter Operator  
**Reporting To:** ETP / Production In\-Charge or Production Manager

1\. Job Purpose

The ETP \& Biofilter Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation, monitoring, and basic maintenance of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Biofilter system. The operator shall ensure that wastewater and odour\-control systems are functioning properly and that treatment activities are carried out as per company procedures, environmental requirements, and Pollution Control Board norms.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Operate and monitor the ETP and Biofilter systems on a daily basis.
* Start, stop, and monitor pumps, blowers, aerators, agitators, dosing systems, filters, clarifiers, and other ETP equipment.
* Monitor important operating parameters such as **pH, flow, temperature, dissolved oxygen (DO), TDS, COD/BOD\-related readings**, as applicable.
* Ensure proper chemical preparation, dosing, and safe handling of treatment chemicals.
* Monitor biological treatment processes and maintain suitable operating conditions for effective treatment.
* Operate and monitor the Biofilter system to control and reduce odour generated from the production/effluent treatment areas.
* Check blower operation, air flow, spray/nozzle systems, moisture levels, media condition, and other Biofilter parameters.
* Regularly inspect tanks, pipelines, valves, pumps, blowers, filters, and other equipment for leakage, blockage, abnormal noise, or malfunction.
* Collect wastewater and treated\-water samples as instructed and assist in laboratory testing.
* Maintain daily ETP and Biofilter **log sheets, operating records, chemical consumption records, and maintenance records**.
* Record abnormalities, breakdowns, process deviations, and corrective actions taken.
* Ensure proper handling, dewatering, storage, and disposal of sludge as per company procedures.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of the ETP and Biofilter areas.
* Carry out routine preventive maintenance and minor operational adjustments where authorized.
* Immediately report major equipment failures, unusual odour, leakage, overflow, abnormal discharge, or treatment problems to the concerned supervisor.
* Ensure treated effluent is maintained within applicable statutory and company requirements before discharge/reuse.
* Support Pollution Control Board inspections, environmental audits, sampling, and compliance activities.
* Assist in maintaining statutory/environmental records required for inspections and compliance.
* Follow all SOPs, safety instructions, PPE requirements, and chemical\-handling procedures.
* Coordinate with the Production, Maintenance, Quality, and EHS teams whenever required.
* Perform any other ETP/environment\-related duties assigned by the Production Manager or management.

3\. Biofilter\-Specific Responsibilities

* Monitor the Biofilter continuously during operation.
* Ensure adequate airflow through the Biofilter system.
* Monitor moisture/wetting of the Biofilter media as required.
* Check for clogging, channeling, excessive pressure drop, or deterioration of filter media.
* Ensure proper operation of associated pumps, blowers, spray systems, ducts, and valves.
* Monitor odour\-control performance and immediately report abnormal odour conditions.
* Maintain records of Biofilter operation, inspection, cleaning, and maintenance.
* Assist in replacement or servicing of Biofilter media when required.

4\. Safety \& Environmental Responsibilities

* Wear appropriate PPE while operating the ETP and handling chemicals.
* Follow chemical storage, dilution, dosing, and emergency procedures.
* Never bypass or alter treatment systems without authorization.
* Prevent chemical spills, untreated effluent discharge, and environmental contamination.
* Keep emergency equipment and access areas clear.
* Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.
* Maintain good housekeeping around the ETP and Biofilter area.

5\. Required Skills \& Qualifications

**Minimum Qualification:**  
10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma in a relevant technical, environmental, chemical, mechanical, or related field.

**Experience:**

* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may be considered.
* Experience in ETP/STP/WTP/Biofilter operation or industrial wastewater treatment will be preferred.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of wastewater treatment processes.
* Basic knowledge of pumps, blowers, valves, aerators, filters, and dosing systems.
* Ability to take and record plant readings accurately.
* Basic understanding of pH and water\-quality parameters.
* Ability to identify abnormal operating conditions.
* Basic maintenance and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to work in shifts, if required.
* Good discipline, housekeeping, and safety awareness.

6\. Performance Expectations

The operator is expected to:

* Maintain continuous and stable ETP operation.
* Ensure proper functioning of the Biofilter and effective odour control.
* Maintain accurate daily operational records.
* Minimize equipment downtime through timely reporting and basic preventive maintenance.
* Ensure safe chemical handling and proper housekeeping.
* Support compliance with applicable environmental and Pollution Control Board requirements.
* Immediately escalate any abnormality that may affect treatment efficiency or environmental compliance.

description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream

 Join us as a

**Your Impact at Brevo:**
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable backend services using Go
* Build scalable APIs and services for high\-volume, production\-grade applications
* Contribute to system design, technical decisions, and architectural improvements
* Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well\-tested code
* Work with databases, caching systems, messaging platforms, and external services
* Improve application performance, scalability, reliability, and security
* Investigate and resolve production issues through effective logging, monitoring, and debugging
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices
* Collaborate with other development teams and business units to deliver integrated solutions
* Work closely with Product, QA, Platform, DevOps, and SRE teams
* Identify technical debt and contribute to its prioritisation and resolution
* Create and maintain technical documentation for services and processes
* Continuously learn and share knowledge with other members of the engineering team


**Who you are:**
* 2\-4 Years of professional experience developing backend applications and services
* Strong proficiency in Go/Golang
* Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs or other service interfaces
* Good understanding of microservices and distributed systems
* Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar
* Understanding of caching technologies such as Redis
* Familiarity with messaging and event\-driven systems such as Kafka
* Experience writing unit tests and integration tests
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern software development workflows
* Understanding of monitoring and observability tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, or similar


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in a high\-scale SaaS or B2B email/marketing technology
* Familiarity with AI tools and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI\-assisted development workflows); strong integration of these tools into daily workflow is a plus


**Our candidate journey:**
* Round 1 \- Technical Interview \- Virtual (60mins)
* Round 2 \- Technical Interview \- Virtual (60 mins)
* Round 3 \- BU Head Interview (in person, 60 mins)
* Round 4 \- HR Round (30mins)


**Why people love working at Brevo:**
* A place to grow, together: Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas
* Practical perks for everyday balance: Cab Facility and per\-day meal vouchers; Employee\-friendly salary structure; 1\.4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high\-value gift options (e.g., bike, flight tickets)
* Learning, every step of the way: Over 1,55,000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator\-led sessions, and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
* Flexible for life: A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
* A culture that cares: Annual company off\-sites, inter\-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA\+ communities, along with festive celebrations \- all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace


 Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 At Brevo, we’re proud to be an AI\-first company. Still, every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our team.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
