With its strong 55\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2025\.

title: Junior Software Engineer - Backend and Optimisation
description:
**About Benchmark Construction Technology**
 Benchmark (formerly BotBuilt, Y Combinator W21\) is building the next generation of technology behind American homebuilding. We’re starting with one of the hardest parts of the stack: reliably turning messy, real\-world construction plans into structured, usable data.
   

  

 Our systems translate architectural drawings into detailed digital representations of homes — including framing systems, materials, and structural components — that can drive downstream automation, analysis, and construction workflows.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve the backend APIs and mathematical systems behind our design engine. You’ll contribute to optimization models, geometric algorithms, and simulation systems that translate plan information into physically valid 3D building structures.
   

  

 This is an early\-career role for someone with strong programming and mathematical fundamentals who wants to grow through hands\-on work on real engineering systems.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build and improve well\-scoped APIs and backend services using Python and FastAPI
* Support the development and testing of optimization models using techniques such as constraint programming, linear programming, and mixed\-integer programming (MIP)
* Contribute to computational geometry systems that convert plan\-derived data into structured 3D building representations
* Help implement simulation and constraint systems that capture construction rules, structural relationships, and material layouts
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable Python code for numerical and algorithmic systems
* Debug model behavior, investigate failures, and help improve performance through profiling, testing, and solver tuning
* Work closely with senior software, ML, and platform engineers to integrate optimization systems into the broader plan ingestion and design pipeline
* Document your work, communicate progress and blockers clearly, and learn engineering practices for reliability, deployment, and production support


**Who We’re Looking For**
* 1–2 years of professional, internship, research, or equivalent project experience in software engineering, optimization, computational mathematics, or a related area
* Strong Python fundamentals and experience building non\-trivial software or numerical projects
* Coursework or practical experience in operations research, optimization, algorithms, numerical methods, or a closely related field
* Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity
* Some exposure to computational geometry, geometric modeling, simulation, or spatial algorithms
* Familiarity with Linux and Git, with a willingness to learn production development and deployment practices


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* You take ownership of well\-scoped tasks while knowing when to ask for guidance
* You enjoy translating messy real\-world rules into clear logic, algorithms, or mathematical formulations
* You care about correctness, readability, and understanding why a system behaves the way it does
* You are eager to learn from experienced engineers and steadily take on more responsibility
* You communicate clearly and collaborate well with engineers across disciplines


****Bonus Points****
* Experience with OR solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, SCIP, or OR\-Tools
* Academic, internship, or personal project experience in computational geometry, geometric modeling, or spatial algorithms
* Experience building APIs with FastAPI or another Python web framework
* Exposure to profiling, numerical performance optimization, or simulation workloads
* Familiarity with the construction, CAD, manufacturing, robotics, or engineering domains


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity
* Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision)
* Professional development budget (courses, conferences, research exploration)

title: Mechanical Engineer Modeler
description:
**Who We Are**
 Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting\-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Bangalore,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a motivated 3D Modeler to create high\-fidelity, real\-time 3D assets used in immersive Virtual Reality (VR) training experiences and also to create VR content on simple plate\-form. This role sits at the intersection of mechanical engineering and modern real\-time / game\-engine pipelines. The successful candidate will convert complex engineering inputs—such as CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and technical specifications—into accurate, optimized, and visually clear 3D assets suitable for interactive VR training environments.
   

  

 This position works closely with VR developers, instructional designers, and engineering subject\-matter experts to ensure all assets are technically correct, performant on target hardware, and aligned with instructional intent.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering\-to\-VR Asset Creation**
* Translate complex mechanical drawings, CAD models, and specifications into accurate, VR\-ready 3D models and assemblies.
* Maintain correct scale, tolerances, interfaces, and part relationships consistent with engineering intent.
* Interpret incomplete or ambiguous engineering data and collaborate with subject\-matter experts to resolve issues.
* Build assemblies and sub\-assemblies suitable for interactive training, including exploded views and service\-oriented breakdowns.


**Real\-Time Optimization for VR**
* Create real\-time\-ready geometry using best practices for VR and game engines, including clean topology, efficient UV layouts, and appropriate polygon budgets.
* Generate and manage Levels of Detail (LODs) to ensure stable frame rates in VR environments.
* Bake high\-poly detail into low\-poly assets using normal maps and supporting texture maps.
* Optimize assets for draw calls, texture memory usage, and shader complexity based on VR performance constraints.


**Texturing, Materials, and Visual Clarity**
* Create high\-quality Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials using metal/roughness workflows.
* Produce textures, decals, and material variants that enhance realism while supporting training clarity.
* Develop visual variants such as simplified models, cutaways, highlights, and color\-coded components to support instructional goals.
* Ensure materials respond correctly across varied lighting conditions used in VR training scenarios.


**Workflow, Reviews, and Delivery**
* Follow a consistent end\-to\-end modeling pipeline from CAD ingestion through mesh preparation, optimization, texturing, review, and final polish.
* Prepare assets with clean hierarchies, pivots, naming conventions, and documentation for seamless integration into VR applications.
* Participate in design and technical reviews, incorporating feedback from engineers, developers, and instructional designers.
* Maintain organized source files and documentation to support reuse, updates, and long\-term asset maintenance.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of professional experience creating real\-time 3D assets for VR, games, simulation, or interactive training.
* Strong proficiency with at least one major DCC tool such as Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max.
* Demonstrated experience with real\-time asset optimization, including LODs, baking, and texture optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with PBR texturing workflows and material creation.
* Mechanical engineering background (degree or equivalent practical experience) with the ability to interpret technical drawings and CAD data.
* Portfolio demonstrating hard\-surface and mechanical modeling with evidence of real\-time optimization.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**
* Experience developing assets for industrial equipment, manufacturing tools, or technical training content.
* Familiarity with Unity or Unreal Engine for validating scale, lighting, and performance.
* Experience working with CAD\-to\-real\-time conversion pipelines.
* Understanding of VR\-specific usability considerations such as scale perception, visual comfort, and interaction clarity.


**Tools \& Technologies**
* Modeling / DCC Tools: Blender, Maya, 3ds Max (ZBrush optional for high\-detail sculpting)
* Texturing \& Materials: PBR workflows, Substance Painter or equivalent tools
* Optimization Techniques: LOD generation, texture atlases, normal map baking, polygon and draw\-call optimization
* Real\-Time Platforms: Unity and/or Unreal Engine (for asset validation and integration support)
* File Formats \& Delivery: Real\-time optimized formats such as FBX and glTF, with clean hierarchies and documentation


**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Employee Type:**
 Assignee / Regular
   

  

**Travel:**
 No
   

  

**Relocation Eligible:**
 Yes
   

  

 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, I.T, Engineering, or a related field
 




  





**About HabotConnect FZCO** 




  






 HabotConnect is a Dubai\-based, bootstrapped, 100% remote company building a digital platform that connects parents with Learning Support Assistants (LSA) for children with learning difficulties. We operate in a high\-ownership, accountability\-driven remote culture where quality, structural clarity, and architectural precision come before speed.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 Are you highly logical, detail\-oriented, and obsessed with clean mobile architecture? As our
 
**Flutter Mobile App Developer** 

 , you will bring mobile\-first experiences to life using our standardized Flutter component library, implementing strict stateless architecture rules, and maintaining absolute fidelity to our Figma designs.
 




  





**A Day in the Life:** 






  





 Your day revolves around writing modular, atomic code blocks ("Byts") in Flutter. You will translate Figma source designs into pixel\-perfect interfaces, map backend REST API endpoints directly to UI fields, enforce strict data lineage standards, and ensure fail\-closed security mechanisms across every mobile build .
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




**Your daily deliverables include:** 




  





**1\. Core Development \& Architecture** 




  




* Build, scale, and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications primarily using Flutter and Dart.
* Adhere strictly to a stateless paradigm, ensuring no critical data resides in volatile memory to align with our Cloud Run backend infrastructure.
* Write modular, highly maintainable code following our internal "Byt" boundary standard.
* Implement robust fail\-closed security mechanisms where any logic error or null response in compliance checks immediately halts data movement.



  





**2\. Design System \& UX Integration** 




  




* Lead application flow development with a Mobile\-First priority before scaling to larger layout views.
* Leverage our Universal Component Library and strictly adhere to standardized Google Material Design templates.
* Translate designs from Figma (our official Source Document) into high\-fidelity code.
* Implement automated friction logging systems to capture user UI hesitations (stalls lasting $\> 5$ seconds).



  





**3\. API \& Data Governance** 




  




* Map API endpoints provided by the backend team directly to designated UI fields according to integration protocols.
* Enforce data integrity standards by ensuring no write operation occurs without a valid predecessor\_id to eliminate orphan data.
* Ensure all outbound data packets inject required Metadata Headers (trace\_id, logic\_hash) for full lineage tracking.



  





**4\. Quality \& Release Management** 




  




* Validate applications across a defined matrix of target physical devices and OS versions.
* Conduct pre\-release audits checking both Feature Status (e.g., Auth screens) and Integration Status.
* Secure the mandatory Endorsement Document (ED) prior to registering or deploying builds to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.



  





**Core Competencies** 




  





**Technical Skills \& Tools:** 




  




* **Flutter \& Dart:** 

 Cross\-platform mobile development using atomic "Byt" logic.
* **Figma:** 

 High\-fidelity Figma\-to\-code translation.
* **Google Material Design:** 

 Implementation of standardized UI component libraries.
* **REST APIs \& Cloud Run:** 

 Endpoint\-to\-field mapping, predecessor\_id write validation, and stateless integration.
* **GitHub Actions:** 

 CI/CD automation, device matrix testing, and release gatekeeping.



  





**Soft Skills:** 




  




* Meticulous attention to detail and zero tolerance for UI or logic ambiguity.
* Extreme structural discipline and system\-focused execution .
* Clear, system\-focused communication without relying on subjective guesswork.



  





**Onboarding \& Success Path** 




  






 Selected candidates must successfully complete a mandatory structured onboarding and training program. Engagement and progress during onboarding are closely monitored and form part of the probation evaluation. Failure to complete required training or demonstrate sufficient involvement may result in the offer being withdrawn or contract termination.
 




  





**What This Role Is NOT** 




  




* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a backend Python or Node.js server coding position .
* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a creative UI/UX graphic design role .
* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a role for guessing or improvising logic; precision and strict adherence to rule guidelines are mandatory .



  





**Application Process** 




  






 Interested candidates are invited to apply. As part of our evaluation process, you will be required to complete a short
 
**Hiring Project Form (HPF)** 

 simulating the analytical and technical tasks of this role.
 




  




* **Project Link:** 
 https://forms.gle/i7SumEJ7NefmLfiD9
* **Submission Link:** 
 https://forms.gle/W2BhpHjmoUzRAmSG9
* **Submission Deadline:** 

 17\-August\-2026



  





**Note:** 

 You only have one chance to submit. We are looking for quality of implementation and clarity of impact. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a virtual panel interview.
 




  





**Final Self\-Screening Checklist** 




  





**Apply ONLY if:** 




  




* You have
 
**6 months to 1 year** 

 of professional mobile development experience with Flutter \& Dart.
* You are comfortable with the exact salary bracket of
 
**18,000 INR to 21,000 INR per month** 

 .

**immediately**

 Role Overview
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Game Designer I** 
 to help craft engaging features, live events, and economy experiences for
 **Golf Clash** 
 . In this role, you will own small to mid\-sized assignments, contribute to live\-service feature development, and help improve the player journey through clear design thinking, strong documentation, tuning, and cross\-discipline collaboration.
   

  

 You will work closely with leads and partner teams to design and iterate on systems such as live events, progression, rewards, economy flows, and player\-facing feature improvements. You will play the game regularly, understand how players engage with Golf Clash, and use feedback, data, and competitive insights to create accessible, rewarding, and friction\-light experiences.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own and deliver small to mid\-sized features, content, live ops elements, and tuning tasks for Golf Clash.
* Support the design of self\-contained live events, including event rules, reward structures, progression, pacing, and player\-facing requirements.
* Contribute to systems and economy design work across areas such as coin wagering, Club Cards, rewards, progression, and new\-to\-mid game player experience.
* Build clear design documentation with goals, requirements, dependencies, edge cases, tuning values, and implementation notes.
* Partner with leads to ensure feature goals, success criteria, player motivations, and technical constraints are clearly understood.
* Use internal tools and GameData structures to implement, tune, validate, and iterate on features and content.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, analytics, UX, art, production, and QA/QV teams throughout development.
* Support playtests, UX reviews, feedback loops, and tuning passes to improve feature quality before and after launch.
* Review telemetry, player feedback, and qualitative playtest results to identify issues and propose practical improvements.
* Research comparable mobile F2P and casual games, including event structures, leaderboards, matchmaking flows, reward loops, and surfacing patterns.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, unclear requirements, and player experience concerns, escalating them with recommended next steps.
* Play Golf Clash regularly to build deep familiarity with its systems, meta, economy, player journey, and live\-service expectations.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years of game design experience.
* Experience working on mobile F2P games from concept through live service.
* Proficiency in at least one core design domain, with developing skills across systems, economy, content, features, or live ops.
* Ability to prototype, tune, and iterate features or content to meet design goals, quality standards, and KPIs.
* Familiarity with Game Data systems, internal tools, design documentation, and design\-to\-engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of player motivations, progression, pacing, game balance, and live\-service content expectations.
* Ability to analyze player experience, identify friction points, and propose practical design solutions.
* Comfort working with metrics, telemetry, playtest feedback, and qualitative insights to guide iteration.
* Strong communication, documentation, prioritization, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to own work independently while partnering with leads for alignment, feedback, and escalation.
* Curiosity for competitive research and a willingness to learn from modern mobile, casual, and live\-service games.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience working on systems or economy design for mobile F2P games.
* Experience designing live events, reward loops, leaderboards, progression systems, or matchmaking\-adjacent systems.
* Experience with sports, skill\-based PvP, or competitive multiplayer games.
* Familiarity with Unity, Perforce, scripting, XML, or proprietary game data tools.
* Interest in golf, mobile sports games, competitive casual games, and long\-running live services.

description:

**Job title:** 
 Embedded Firmware Intern

 Pune, Maharashtra

 6 Months
   

  

**Department:** 
 Product Development
   

  

**About Growloc**
 Growloc is a leading Agri\-Tech company in India specialising in IoT solutions for farm
   

  

 management. We empower farmers with innovative technology to optimise resource usage,improve yields, and ensure consistent quality produce. We are looking for a passionate
   

  

 Embedded Firmware Intern to join our team and help build the next generation of smart
   

  

 agriculture devices.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As an Embedded Firmware Intern, you will work closely with our senior engineers to developand test firmware for IoT edge controllers, smart irrigation systems, and industrial\-grade sensorgateways. This is a hands\-on role where you will gain practical experience with highperformance STM32 microcontrollers and real\-time operating systems (RTOS).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Firmware Development: Assist in developing and testing firmware on STM32 H\-Series (H7/H5\) and F\-Series (F4/F7\) microcontrollers.
* Hardware Bring\-up: Support the bring\-up and testing of peripherals (UART, I2C, SPI, ADC, PWM)on new hardware revisions.
* Toolchain Usage: Work with STM32CubeIDE, HAL, LL drivers, and CMSIS.
* RTOS Implementation: Support the implementation of multitasking using FreeRTOS.
* Peripheral Integration: Help integrate communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, and RS485 (Modbus RTU).
* IoT Connectivity: Assist in working with LoRaWAN, MQTT/MQTTS, and BLE for device provisioning and data transmission.
* Debugging: Use JTAG/SWD, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes to debug firmware and hardware issues.
* Optimisation: Support efforts in memory (Flash/RAM) and CPU utilisation optimisation.


**Required Skills**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Electronics, E\&TC, Computer Engineering,


 or a related field.
   

  

* Strong foundation in C programming for embedded systems.
* Exposure to STM32 (HAL/LL) or ESP32 (Arduino/ESP\-IDF) development.
* Basic understanding of STM32 microcontrollers and peripheral interfacing.
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS preferred).
* Strong debugging mindset and a "hands\-on" approach to hardware.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and a willingness to learn in a fast\-paced environment.


**Good to Have**
* PCB Design Familiarity: Basic knowledge of KiCad or Altium for hardware understanding.
* Prior experience with STM32CubeMX and HAL libraries.
* Basic knowledge of LoRaWAN or other wireless communication protocols.
* Experience with PCB debugging and hardware\-level troubleshooting.
* Passion for agricultural or industrial automation systems


**What You’ll Gain**
* Practical exposure to production\-grade firmware development.
* Hands\-on experience with high\-performance MCUs and industrial IoT protocols.
* Direct mentorship from experienced hardware and firmware engineers.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world products that impact Indian agriculture.
* Potential for a full\-time role based on performance


 If you love building real\-world hardware products and solving deep embedded challenges, we’d love to connect!

title: Robotics AI/ML Engineer : 3rd Team Member
description:
We are building a robotics company focused on creating robots that can perform useful real\-world physical tasks.
 



 We are an experienced founding team with IIT alumni, and we are looking for our
 **3rd team member, a hands\-on Robotics AI/ML Engineer** 
 who can help us build our first working POC and become a core member of the technical team.
 



 Your primary focus will be on the
 **intelligence layer of the robot : perception, learning, planning and control using AI/ML \+ ROS.** 




 This is not a conventional engineering role. You will work directly with the founders, build from scratch, experiment rapidly and have significant ownership over how the robot learns and executes physical tasks.
 


 Your first mission
 
**Help us build a working robotic POC that can see its environment, understand objects, control a robotic arm and learn to execute defined physical tasks reliably.** 



 What you will work on
 * ROS / ROS2 based robotic systems
* Computer vision and object detection
* Robotic arm manipulation and motion planning
* Camera \+ sensor perception
* AI/ML models for robotic task execution
* Teleoperation and demonstration data collection
* Imitation learning / learning from demonstrations
* Robot control and autonomous execution
* Integrating AI models with real robotic hardware


 What we're looking for
 
 Strong hands\-on experience with:
 


* Python
* ROS / ROS2
* Computer Vision / OpenCV
* AI/ML
* Robotic arms or manipulation
* Hardware\-software integration



 Experience with some of the following would be a strong plus:
 


* PyTorch
* MoveIt / MoveIt 2
* NVIDIA Jetson
* Depth cameras / RealSense
* Reinforcement Learning
* Imitation Learning
* Vision\-Language\-Action models
* Robotic foundation models



 You don't need to be an expert in everything.
 



 We are primarily looking for someone who understands
 **AI/ML \+ ROS and can make algorithms work on an actual robot, not just in simulation.** 



 Why join now?
 
 You won't be joining a large robotics team to work on one small component.
 



 You'll join as
 **person \#3** 
 , work directly on our first robot and have the opportunity to influence the architecture, technology and product from day one.
 



 We care much more about
 **what you have built** 
 than your degree or credentials.
 



 📍
 **Location: Pune** 




 💰
 **Competitive compensation \+ meaningful ESOP opportunity** 




 🚀
 **Stage: POC \| 3rd Team Member** 




**Apply with your profile \+ GitHub/videos/photos of robotics, ROS, computer vision or AI/ML projects you have actually built.**

title: Assistant Professor - Robotics
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





 Position: Assistant Professor/Associate Professor
 



 Location: Sonepat, NCR of Delhi.
 



 Mode: Full Time, On\-Campus
 



 Programme: B. Tech CS and Data Science
 



  





**ABOUT US** 




  





***Rishihood University***




  





 Rishihood University (RU) has been established under The Haryana Private Universities (Amendment) Act, 2020 and is empowered to award degree as specified in section 22 of UGC Act, 1956\.
 



  





 Rishihood University is India’s first and only impact university. ‘Impact’ is the living spirit of Rishihood. The purpose of education envisioned by the thought leaders of our civilization and that which has motivated the founders to build Rishihood University is beyond just awarding degrees and jobs. The purpose of education is to achieve the highest potential in a learner i.e., Rishihood. Rishihood University provides a unique mix of globally relevant education that is rooted in Indian ideas, quality education that is affordable, and a multi\-disciplinary exposure with cutting edge skills of a specialist. To achieve this outcome, education cannot be limited to within the classrooms. RU is a fully residential campus where living and learning seamlessly integrate throughout the day. RU faculty and learners have an active participation with society, industry, researchers, entrepreneurs, and policy makers. This keeps the learning at RU focused on solving the biggest challenges faced by humanity and prepares our learners for the real world. It is time India builds universities driven by a higher purpose, that have a strong committed board to back it, that redefine the way education is imparted both within and outside the classroom. Rishihood is a bold initiative to fulfil this idea. Hence, we are looking for like\-minded founding faculty members at Rishihood University.
 



  





**About Position** 




  





 Track \|
 
 Robotics \& Mechatronics
 



  





 Kinematics \& Dynamics • Control Systems • Autonomous Systems • Mechatronics
 



  





 Someone once taught you why a linked list beats an array in certain conditions, and something clicked. That moment of clarity, when the why behind the code finally lands, is exactly what we are trying to create at scale for every student who walks through our doors. We need the person who can make that happen.
 



  





 You will join Rishihood as a Faculty with full teaching ownership of the Core Software Engineering track. This is the bedrock of the programme. As you grow, you will take on Track Lead responsibilities: defining curriculum direction, building the faculty team, and connecting with industry to bring real problems into the classroom. You will not be executing someone else's vision. You will be building your own.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Teach kinematics, dynamics, and control theory, going deep on the why and not just the what



  




* Design and lead lab sessions where students implement forward and inverse kinematics, tune controllers, and build working robotic systems from the ground up



  




* Bridge theory and practice: connect Lie group formulations to ROS implementations, screw theory to physical manipulator behaviour



  




* Run structured project critiques and demo days that build honest engineering judgment



  




* Mentor students on capstone and thesis work in robotics, autonomous systems, or mechatronics



  




* Own the Robotics curriculum as Track Lead, hire junior faculty, and set the academic standard for this track



  




* Work closely with the Lab Lead to ensure laboratory infrastructure, robotic platforms, and practical sessions are tightly integrated with theory instruction



  





**Job Specifications** 




  





 You should hold an PhD or MTech (or equivalent in Robotics, Mechatronics, or Control Engineering), or equivalent in a relevant field. Beyond the degree, here is what we care about.
 



  





**Technical Depth** 




  




* Expert command of core robotics theory: forward and inverse kinematics, Denavit\-Hartenberg parameters, Jacobian analysis, and workspace characterisation



  




* Deep fluency in dynamics: Newton\-Euler and Lagrangian formulations for robotic manipulators, and how these translate to real hardware behavior



  




* Strong grounding in control systems: PID, computed torque, state\-space methods, and at least one advanced approach such as sliding mode, MPC, or impedance control



  




* Working knowledge of modern robotics formulation: screw theory, product of exponentials, and Lie group representations (SO(3\), SE(3\))



  




* Familiarity with probabilistic robotics and autonomous systems: SLAM, Bayesian estimation, sensor fusion, and motion planning algorithms



  




* Hands\-on experience with robotic platforms, sensors, actuators, and embedded systems; comfort with ROS, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent practical environments



  





**The Person** 




  




* You treat teaching as a craft, take ownership proactively, and are comfortable with structured critique of your students' work and your own



  




* You can explain screw theory to a second\-year student who has never seen a Lie group, and make it land



  




* You have the patience for a student genuinely struggling with the maths, and the honesty to push the one who is coasting on intuition



  




* You are equally at home with a whiteboard full of derivations and a lab bench full of wires



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Familiarity with the Modern Robotics textbook (Lynch \& Park) or equivalent graduate\-level treatment



  




* Background in parallel robots, cable\-driven systems, compliant mechanisms, or soft robotics



  




* Experience with computer vision in robotics: epipolar geometry, visual odometry, or vision\-based control



  




* Exposure to reinforcement learning or formal methods applied to robotic autonomy



  




* Academic writing, course material development, or research publication track record



  




* Industry experience with robotic systems integration, automation, or autonomous vehicles



  





 This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. The employee may be expected to perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Research
description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 Robotics is an industry that has been gestating for 70 years yet it has never arrived.
 



  





 Every time, its perceived moment arrived, it was always an "Use\-Case" for some other technology, including now \- an Use\-Case for \#LLM/VLA. Intelligence is a Slave of Data\-\> Slave of Signal \-\> Slave of Sensor. Not Action. Robotics is Formfactor and action obsessed, but autonomy begins from Sensing.
 



  





 Robotics is often mistaken for a problem that's just lacks Savvy Engineering to put together current technology in a meaningful way. In reality \- Robotics lacks \& needs foundational and fundamental technology \& tools needed to Build it. This is a Foundational research problem.
 



  





 Robotics has a problem of Building a Car with Cycle Wheels. None of the technology or the components that we use for robotics were developed for Robotic Manipulation.
 



  





 Beyond the dancing mannequins, Robotics is a Foundational \#Research problem, and it begins from Sensing by Action to Force Controlled Motion than just Position Control to Multi\-Arm Action Planning to Foundations of \#ML that Mirrors \#Neuroscience of Cognition \& Motion.
 



  





 𝐑𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧! 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐨𝐧𝐞.
 



  





 If you are a researcher, a PHD student, Post doc or a Research scientist/ Faculty and if you connect with the Constraints of Current Approach to Intelligence, Sensors, Compute and Robotics and is eager to dive deep into the Rabit hole \- Apply.
 



  





 https://lnkd.in/gDCNtJnw
 



  





  





**Research Topics \& Domains:** 




  





***Vision and Algorithms***



* Dynamic Vision \- Vergence, Motion Imaging \& Dynamic depth – Hierarchical Depth Construction, Imaging, Optics \& sensors – Building intelligence into Sensing
* Exploring primitive Neural layers/ Pathway of Human vision
* Object Composition – Texture, contours, grasp mapping, force field – process of learning an object \- Primitive Visual Patterns and stitching of contours into an object
* Process of Colour Construction
* Understanding Reflections, Attention \& Priority of Feature Selection
* Visual Models \- breaking down scenes into Action models
* Involuntary \& Voluntary Imaging



  





***Manipulation \& Sensing***




  




* Skin Transducers for Touch – RF, Capacitive, etc \- Modular Tactile Design for the shape and format of Fingers \& Arms
* Convergent Camera Design \& Image sensor design , Autofocus Liquid Lens Optics Design
* Neuromorphic Image Sensor pipeline \- FPGA
* Sensing Primitives\- Creating Sensor Physics in Simulation Environment to map Sensor’s signal response for different object interactions
* Alternate Modes of Actuation for Robots \& Motion Control – Tendon, Tendon \+ Joint Actuation
* Motor \& motion Design for Wrist and Ball joints



  





**Machine Learning** 



* Neuromorphic NN designs \- Neural morphology \- Breaking down neural patterns and their Functions
* MPC \& RL Design
* On\-the\- Fly Learning process \& Live weight modelling
* Signals to senses, closed loop architectures in Neurons
* Adaptive Learning Architectures – Dynamic Weights, Static \& dynamic neural patterns
* Neural memory \& temporal neurons
* Dimensionality of physical actions encoding into neural pathways
* Auto Object learning Setup for Robots



  





**Robot Control** 



* Multi arm Kinematics Multi Arm\- task Scheduling and Task sequencing
* Grasp Models And Force Modelled Grasping Algorithm Library for
* Gripper Design \& Construction
* Multi\-Finger Trajectory \& Grasp Planning
* Action primitives – Action models
* Data (Signal) Model of Objects
* Dynamic Collision planning

 including IISC \& EPFL. You will be responsible to coordinate the research activities between CynLr \& the Partner Research Institutions. And manage outcomes out of the engagements.

 CynLr

 , just like a human baby fiddles with objects. CynLr calls this stack as Object Intelligence (OI).

 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots
 *intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly,* 
 eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories* 
 that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.

**Tools**

*Specific tools are not the primary filter. Sound engineering judgment and first\-principles thinking matter more.* 




  





**Team Structure \& Growth** 




 You will be part of a

 , working alongside

 .
 



 The role is

 As CynLr grows, you will have opportunities to

**Why This Role Matters** 




 Object manipulation has remained unsolved because

 Your work will turn cutting\-edge capability into

The company focuses on providing salon\-quality care without the stress of traditional grooming environments by offering groomers on demand, often within 30 minutes. Ultimutt™ uses premium, imported grooming products and works exclusively with trained, background\-checked professionals to ensure safety and trust.
 



 Its mission is to make pet services convenient, instant, and stress\-free so pet parents have peace of mind and pets receive the care they deserve.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Ultimutt is building India's fastest at\-home pet care platform \- instant grooming today, with walking and a broader pet services stack on the roadmap. This role owns product end\-to\-end across our three surfaces: the Partner App (used daily by our grooming partners in the field), the Consumer App (where pet parents book and manage services), and the Website (our primary acquisition and trust\-building surface).
 



  





 The Product Manager at Ultimutt™ will lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of core products, from discovery and requirements gathering to launch and continuous improvement. This full\-time, on\-site role in Gurgaon involves collaborating closely with operations, engineering, design, and marketing to define product vision, prioritize roadmaps, and deliver features that enhance booking experiences, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Partner App** 




 • Booking assignment, routing, and job\-status flows for on\-ground groomers
 



 • Earnings visibility, payout tracking, and incentive/tier logic surfaced in\-app
 



 • Onboarding, training (LMS\-style modules), and verification flows for new partners
 



 • Safety and SOP compliance features (checklists, photo/video proof of service)
 



**Consumer App** 




 • Booking flow \- instant vs. scheduled, multi\-pet booking, slot and address selection

**Website**

**Day to Day** 




 • Own the product roadmap across all three surfaces, prioritising ruthlessly against a small eng team
 



 • Write clear PRDs, wireframe flows, and work directly with design and engineering to ship
 



 • Dig into operational data (fulfillment %, partner churn, booking drop\-offs) to find the next problem to solve

 • Strong data instincts: SQL or willingness to get there fast; comfortable in dashboards, not just reports
 



 • Bias to ship fast and learn, over long specs and long roadmaps

**Job Description**

**The Opportunity**




 As Product Manager \- Merchant Experience, you will own the discovery, definition, and delivery of Xplor's self\-serve merchant portal: the place where merchants see their transactions and payouts, understand their fees, pull reports, and manage their account. It is the everyday face of Xplor's payments platform, and your job is to make it clear, trustworthy, and genuinely useful across global markets. This portal also acts as the internal platform our own teams use to support and configure those merchants.
   

  





 You will sit at the intersection of product craft, payments, and data \- turning information owned by the billing, payout, and financials teams into an experience that answers a merchant's most important questions at a glance: have I been paid, what did it cost me, and is my account set up the way I need? You will partner closely with design and research, and with the upstream teams whose data you surface.
   

  





**What You'll Do**




**Merchant Portal Strategy \& Roadmap**



* Own and evolve the strategy and roadmap for Xplor's self\-serve merchant portal across global markets.
* Define a vision for a merchant experience that is clear, trustworthy, and reduces the need to contact support.
* Prioritise ruthlessly against merchant impact, adoption, and support deflection, and present priorities to the VP of Product.
* Align your roadmap with the billing, payout, and financials teams whose data the portal surfaces.



**Transactions, Payouts \& Reporting**



* Own the surfaces where merchants view transactions and payouts.
* Define clear, accurate reporting and statements that merchants can pull themselves, without raising a ticket.
* Make fees and deductions transparent, so merchants understand their cost of payments.
* Ensure the money shown to merchants is accurate and reconciled with the underlying platform data.



**Account Management \& Self\-Serve**



* Own merchant self\-service: managing account details, users and permissions, and settings without contacting support.
* Identify the highest\-volume support reasons that the portal should be able to deflect, and design self\-serve flows to remove them.
* Build in\-product help and guidance that meets merchants where they are.
* Track and reduce support contact rates for portal\-addressable issues as a core metric.



**Merchant Configuration \& Enablement**



* Own the configuration portal the BMS team uses to set up and maintain merchants: pricing, fees, product configuration, and account settings.
* Own and drive the capabilities of our configuration portal to remove work out of engineering and into the hands of the team closest to the merchant, with the guardrails that money\-affecting changes require.
* Define validation, approvals, and change history for pricing and fee changes, so a mistake is hard to make and easy to trace.
* Work with the billing, payout, and financials teams to make sure configuration set internally is reflected accurately in what the merchant sees and is charged.



**Experience, Craft \& Adoption**



* Partner closely with design and engineering to ship intuitive, well\-crafted experiences grounded in real merchant needs.
* Run discovery with merchants to understand their jobs\-to\-be\-done and validate solutions before building.
* Use product analytics to understand behaviour, find friction, and measure the impact of what you ship.
* Drive adoption and engagement of the portal, improving task success and merchant satisfaction over time.



**AI\-Augmented Product Practice**



* Embed AI tools into every stage of the product lifecycle: use LLMs for rapid synthesis of merchant interviews and support\-ticket themes, competitor teardowns, and PRD first drafts; use AI assistants to prototype portal flows and copy without full engineering overhead.
* Champion AI adoption across the product team \- document effective prompting patterns, share workflows, and upskill peers.
* Use AI\-powered analytics to surface friction and anomalies in portal usage data and generate plain\-language summaries for stakeholders.
* Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape relevant to product management, operating at a higher output cadence than a traditional PM.



**Delivery \& Stakeholder Management**



* Drive agile delivery with engineering, design, and data using clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies with the billing, payout, financials, and data teams whose information the portal surfaces.
* Coordinate with support and partner teams to make sure the portal reflects what merchants actually need.
* Monitor product health via metrics such as adoption, task success, support deflection, and merchant satisfaction.

**Required**



* 3\-4 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building B2B SaaS, dashboard, portal, or self\-serve products.
* Strong product craft: discovery, design partnership, and a track record of shipping intuitive self\-serve experiences.
* Experience presenting complex or financial data clearly to non\-technical users (for example transactions, payouts, or reporting).
* A track record of improving adoption, engagement, or support\-deflection metrics.
* Comfort working with product analytics to understand behaviour and measure impact.

**Preferred**

description:
**Support tendering processes in global grid solutions projects**
 Join NKT’s Grid Solutions team as a Junior Tender Project Manager in Chennai, supporting tender activities across Germany, the UK, and India. This role offers the opportunity to work on pre\-qualifications, proposals, cost estimation, and process improvement within complex energy projects contributing to the green transition. You will collaborate with international stakeholders while developing your role into more client\-facing responsibilities over time. Are you ready to build your career in global tender project management?
   

  

**Support tender preparation and improve proposal processes**
 In this role, you will assist Tender Project Managers and Key Account Managers by preparing documentation, analysing specifications, and supporting pricing activities. You will help improve tender processes by centralising tasks and maintaining tools, allowing teams to handle a higher number of tenders efficiently. Over time, the role offers scope to take full ownership of tenders and contribute directly to client interactions.

* Prepare pre\-qualification documents and proposal deliverables

* Support cost estimation and prepare price indications

 You will work closely with global teams across Germany, the UK, and Chennai, reporting to the Director, Premium \& Standard Projects. Occasional travel (1–2 trips per year, 3–4 weeks) may be required. The role is based in Chennai.
   

  

**Analytical and collaborative professional with structured approach**
 You are detail\-oriented and take a structured approach to tasks, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. You are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across locations and maintain clear communication in a remote environment. You show initiative, are open to learning new processes, and can work effectively with revised priorities and timelines. You value collaboration and demonstrate accountability in handling complex and sensitive information.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering or related field
* 2–3 years of experience in tendering and cost estimation
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with cost calculation or tender tools
* Experience with Power BI, Qlik Sense, or similar


**Contribute to efficient tendering in energy transition projects**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We have a clear goal of establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international team working on complex grid solutions. You will gain exposure to global tender processes, develop your technical and commercial skills, and grow within a structured career path. The position offers the opportunity to expand into more responsibility over time while contributing to efficient delivery of energy projects.
   

  

 "As a leader, I value team members who are curious, structured, and committed to delivering reliable tender solutions while learning and growing in an international environment," says Hiring Manager, Florian Krull.
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than
 **31st August 2026\.** 
 Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*Join a diverse and international team within NKT’s Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems.*
*At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world’s transition to renewable energy \- and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today.*
*NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3\.6 billion in 2025\. NKT \- We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Consultant – High-Potential Students
description:
**About The Programme**
 About the job Consultant – High\-Potential Students
   

  

 India’s school education system serves \~25 crore children. Many of these students come from underserved communities and face systemic gaps in identification and support. With most interventions beginning only after Grade 10, much of this potential remains untapped and underdeveloped.
   

  

 To bridge this gap, CSF introduced a new workstream, High Potential Students (HPS), in 2025 to support India’s bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers, and leaders. By 2030, we aim to transform the learning journeys of 1 lakh students by equipping them with the skills, support and exposure needed to thrive in higher education and high\-growth careers. Through this work, we are committed to advancing equity and excellence, empowering young minds from every corner of India to realise their full potential.
   

  

 As part of this workstream, CSF is launching a one\-year initiative in Gujarat, in partnership with the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, to strengthen the state’s STEM learning ecosystem. The initiative works across two connected strands. The first strengthens the capacity of Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) trainers across the state through a statewide diagnostic study, a digital learning hub, regional training workshops and a Master Trainer network. The second is a statewide STEM Excellence Challenge that identifies and nurtures high\-potential student innovators across residential model schools, taking them from school\-level innovation workshops through a multi\-stage selection process to a state\-level finale. Designed as a pilot, the initiative aims to generate evidence and a replicable model for statewide and multi\-state expansion.
   

  

**Job Description**
 HPS is looking for a motivated early\-career professional to anchor data, reporting and coordination for the Gujarat STEM initiative. The consultant will build and run the programme’s monitoring and reporting systems, and coordinate day to day across government stakeholders, implementation partners and participating schools to keep delivery on track.
 **The role requires thoughtful problem\-solving, critical engagement with information and a high degree of ownership.**
*Please note that this role will be based in Gujarat and will require close, day\-to\-day coordination with the Education Department, Government of Gujarat and other relevant government stakeholders, along with regular travel to schools and districts across the state.*
**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain the programme’s monitoring and tracking systems across both strands, including gender\-disaggregated indicators
* Collect, clean and analyse implementation data from partners, schools and the field, and synthesise it into actionable insights
* Prepare regular progress reports, review decks and documentation for internal teams, government stakeholders and partners
* Coordinate on a day\-to\-day basis with the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, district officials, implementation partners and participating schools
* Support delivery of the STEM Excellence Challenge, including school onboarding, workshop scheduling, tracking of student submissions, shortlisting and finale logistics
* Support the ATL strand, including the diagnostic study, teacher onboarding and uptake tracking on the learning hub, and coordination of regional workshops
* Undertake field and monitoring visits to schools and labs, and document observations and agreed follow\-up actions
* Conduct secondary research and support case documentation, storytelling and knowledge creation for the programme


**Eligibility \& Requirements**
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Law, Public Policy, Education, Social Work or related fields
* 0–4 years of experience, including exposure to working with or alongside government stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable working with data to generate actionable insights (Proficiency in MS Excel)
* Proficiency in creating structured, visually clear presentations (PowerPoint/Google Slides)
* Ability to synthesise complex information into concise, well\-structured narratives
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to be based in Gujarat and travel regularly to schools and districts across the state


**Desirable Qualities**
* Prior exposure to the Indian education sector (internships/projects included)
* Interest in or exposure to STEM education, tinkering labs, or student innovation programmes
* Familiarity with major Indian education datasets (e.g., UDISE\+, NAS, ASER)
* Basic understanding of tools like Power BI for data analytics
* Working proficiency in Gujarati


**What We Are Looking For**
* Works independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating intellectual honesty and strong ownership
* Curious and quick to learn; able to work across multiple projects
* Comfortable working in the field and coordinating with a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage timelines


**Duration Of The Consultancy**
 Contract term through March 2027, with continuation subject to performance review.
   

  

**About Central Square Foundation (CSF)**
 Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non\-profit philanthropic foundation working on the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We are driven by our mission to transform the school education system with a focus on improving learning outcomes of children, especially from low\-income communities.
   

  

 We believe that ensuring Universal, Early, Conceptual and Procedural Mastery of Foundational Skills is absolutely essential for the overall success of the education system. In order to achieve this, we partner with individuals and social impact organizations to bring innovative solutions in education, as well as work with the government to drive systemic impact. We collaborate with the ecosystem to leverage knowledge, build evidence and create proven tools around critical issues such as early learning, EdTech, classroom instruction methods and governance.
   

  

 We also support exceptional social entrepreneurs with powerful ideas, undertake application\-oriented research, provide a platform for sharing of innovation, and collaborate with other stakeholders in the ecosystem to find policy solutions \- all towards enabling sustained change in India’s educational system.
   

  

 CSF’s team members bring a deep sense of commitment and passion towards our collective vision that every child deserves quality education. We strive for excellence in everything we do and collaborate to create an impact as we move closer to achieving our mission. We encourage an entrepreneurial outlook that evokes new and bold ideas along with taking smart risks. CSF provides a dynamic, learning and positive environment that is driven by our strong sense of values.

title: Project coordinator (Hardware Automation)
description:
**Skills**
* Good in communication and interpersonal skills.
* Working understanding of warehouse operations and material flow (receiving, sorting, dispatch, conveyor\-based movement, etc.).
* Ability to understand the basic architecture and working principles of automation hardware (conveyors, dispensers, sensors, PLC/control systems) — a purely non\-technical background is not sufficient for this role.
* Prior experience in project coordination, implementation, or customer\-facing technical roles is preferred, ideally in automation, material handling, or industrial equipment.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively across customer operations teams, and internal hardware and software development teams.
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to diagnose operational issues and coordinate timely resolutions.
* Willingness to travel to customer warehouse sites for installation, commissioning, and operational support visits.
* Familiarity with software integration concepts (APIs, data exchange between machines and software systems) is an added advantage.


 Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

 Experience required:\- 3\-4 years
   

  

* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather and document initial automation requirements (e.g., telescopic conveyor, OCR conveyor, auto dispenser, vending machine, incline conveyor, POS, thermal printer systems).
* Translate customer and warehouse operational requirements into clear technical inputs for the hardware and software development teams.
* Coordinate integration requirements where machines need to interface with different third\-party or customer\-specific software systems (WMS, ERP, POS, or custom platforms).
* Track project progress across design, development, assembly, and testing stages, ensuring timelines and specifications are met.
* Coordinate on\-site installation and commissioning activities, liaising between the Ethics technical team and the customer's operations/facility team.
* Observe and monitor daily operation of installed machines post\-commissioning, identifying performance issues or gaps.
* Act as the primary liaison between the customer's operations team and Ethics' hardware/software development teams to discuss operational challenges, troubleshoot issues, and drive resolution.
* Coordinate machine upgrades or modifications in response to new or evolving customer requirements.
* Maintain documentation of requirements, installation records, issue logs, and resolutions for each project/site.
* Own the coordination responsibility end\-to\-end — from requirement gathering through product development, installation, commissioning, and daily operational support — as the single point of accountability for each project.


**Requirements**
 Office Hours: 09:30 am to 7 pm
   

  

 Working Days: Mon – Sat
   

  

 Weekly Off: 1st, 3rd \& 5th Sat
